items.topic_zh: 生物年龄测试的意义
items.claim_zh: 目前进行生物年龄测试的动机应仅基于好奇心。
items.article_body:
Thinking about taking a biological age test? Here’s what it can and can’t tell you. If you've scrolled Instagram lately, you've probably seen the pitch. Spit in a tube, mail it off, get back a number that supposedly reveals how fast your body is actually aging. Katy Perry recently told her followers hers came back at 33, and she's far from the only celebrity turning the results into content.
The science behind biological age testing is real. What the number can actually tell you about your health is more complicated than the marketing lets on.
Chronological age is just birthday math. Biological age tries to estimate how fast or slow your body is aging compared with other people your age. A 60-year-old who tests at 55 is, in theory, aging like an average 55-year-old.
"Biological age is real. There's a difference between your chronological age and your biology, that's for sure, and we can measure it by various means," David Furman, a professor at the Buck Institute for Research on Aging, told Forbes .
Geriatrician Luigi Ferrucci, scientific director at the National Institute on Aging, was more restrained when he spoke to NPR . "At this point, if you want to do it, it must be based on curiosity," he said.
Most biological aging clocks rely on a process called DNA methylation. As we age, chemical tags known as methyl groups latch onto DNA, and the pattern of those tags can indicate biological age. Methylation changes the C, or cytosine, in the four-letter alphabet of DNA.
Steve Horvath, the scientist who pioneered the aging clock and developed the GrimAge test, told NPR that "you can use methylation to measure time in all cells that contain DNA." Some of those changes are protective, he said, while others can lead to adverse consequences. A higher proportion of methylated DNA in certain locations tends to correspond with a more accelerated biological age.
Horvath spent more than a decade as a UCLA professor studying the molecular biomarker. "We spent over 10 years trying to understand what factors accelerate your epigenetic clock," he told NPR. Smoking, unhealthy eating, a sedentary lifestyle and "pretty much any lifestyle factor that is bad for you" all push the clock forward, he said.
Not every test measures the same thing, which matters if you're deciding where to spend your money. GrimAge, named after the Grim Reaper, measures DNA methylation in blood and predicts higher risk of cognitive decline. iAge tracks chronic inflammation and predicts greater vulnerability to heart disease and frailty. GlycanAge measures biomarkers reflecting immune function, and microbiome clocks estimate the aging of the gut.
Each test captures one facet of aging rather than the full picture.
You get back a tidy number , but researchers say don't build your whole wellness identity around it. No test can predict how long you'll live. What it can do is estimate how fast or slow you appear to be aging compared with your peers.
Bradley Elliott, a researcher at the University of Westminster and a trustee of the British Society for Research on Ageing, put the limits bluntly to Forbes. "Aging is something that happens to all of us. Even if we optimize everything, it's [only] the rate of change which is modifiable," he said. A 50-year-old's immune system or gut health might be better than expected, but the body is still changing and losing function.
Results also swing more than you'd think. Biological age estimates can fluctuate throughout the day, so if you retest, do it at the same time. Exercise moves the number too. A 2025 study of professional German soccer players found they appeared biologically much younger when tested right after a match, possibly because of intense exercise. Hours later, their measurements returned to normal.
This article was created by content specialists using various tools, including AI.
items.title_zh: 生物年龄测试：数字背后的真实含义
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了生物年龄测试的动机和意义。科学家指出，目前进行生物年龄测试的主要原因应仅基于好奇心，而非其他目的。尽管这些测试可以提供关于个体生物状态的信息，但其结果的解读和实际应用仍需谨慎。文章强调，生物年龄（biological age）并不总能准确反映健康状况或预期寿命，因此在使用这些测试时，消费者应保持理性和批判性思维。
items.l1_lead: 生物年龄测试主要出于好奇心，其结果需谨慎解读，不能准确反映健康状况或预期寿命，消费者应保持理性。
items.l2_summary:
生物年龄测试（biological age）近年来引起了广泛关注，本文探讨了其背后的动机和意义。科学家们指出，目前进行生物年龄测试的主要原因应仅基于好奇心，而非其他目的。尽管这些测试能够提供个体生物状态的信息，但其结果的解读和实际应用仍需谨慎。生物年龄并不总能准确反映一个人的健康状况或预期寿命，这一点在研究中得到了强调。因此，消费者在使用这些测试时应保持理性和批判性思维，以避免对结果的误解或过度解读。

生物年龄测试的结果可能会让人感到惊讶，甚至引发焦虑，但科学家提醒我们，这些测试的结果并不是绝对的健康指标。生物年龄的计算通常基于多种生物标志物的评估，这些标志物可能受到遗传、环境和生活方式等多种因素的影响。因此，单一的生物年龄测试结果并不能全面反映一个人的健康状况。

在实际应用中，生物年龄测试的结果可能会被误用，导致消费者对自身健康的错误判断。文章强调，尽管生物年龄测试可以作为了解自身生物状态的一种工具，但它并不是评估健康的唯一标准。科学家建议，消费者在解读这些测试结果时，应该结合其他健康指标和专业医疗建议，以获得更全面的健康评估。

总之，生物年龄测试的确提供了一种新的视角来理解个体的生物状态，但其结果的解读需要谨慎。保持理性和批判性思维是消费者在面对这些测试时应有的态度，以确保对自身健康的正确理解和管理。

items.title: PCN-700: A Model Platform for Crystallographic Probing of Coordination Behavior in Metal-Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Coordination chemistry plays pivotal roles across a broad range of chemical, biological, and materials fields. Crystalline coordination materials provide unique opportunities for investigating coordination phenomena because their long-range structural order enables atomic-resolution characterization of coordination environments and structure-property relationships. Among them, metal-organic frameworks have greatly expanded the scope of coordination chemistry through their highly tunable compositions and spatial arrangements. To simplify the complexity associated with framework construction, post-synthetic modification has emerged as an effective strategy for systematically tailoring existing frameworks while preserving their networks. Nevertheless, conventional modification approaches remain limited in installation efficiency and coordination investigation. The discovery of PCN-700 together with the linker installation strategy has largely overcome these limitations. Owing to its highly uncoordinated zirconium clusters, predefined installation sites, and exceptional framework flexibility, PCN-700 enables efficient installation while maintaining crystallinity, allowing atomic-resolution visualization. Besides, linker installation decouples coordination from crystallization, transforming framework construction into controllable events at predefined crystallographic sites. In this review, we discuss linker installation pathways, host-guest interactions, and structure-enabled applications in PCN-700, highlighting the role of linker installation in establishing PCN-700 as a model system for elucidating fundamental coordination chemistry, quantitatively correlating coordination events with material properties, and guiding the rational design of functional materials.
items.authors: Han Z, Huo J, Zhou HC.
items.title_zh: PCN-700：金属有机框架中配位行为的晶体探测模型平台
items.summary_zh: 配位化学在化学、生物和材料领域中发挥着关键作用。晶体配位材料因其长程结构有序性，为研究配位现象提供了独特机会。金属有机框架（MOFs）通过其高度可调的组成和空间排列，极大地扩展了配位化学的范围。后合成修饰作为一种有效策略，能够系统性地调整现有框架，同时保持其网络结构。然而，传统的修饰方法在安装效率和配位研究方面仍然有限。PCN-700的发现及其连接体安装策略在很大程度上克服了这些限制。由于其高度不配位的锆簇、预定义的安装位点和卓越的框架灵活性，PCN-700实现了高效安装，同时保持晶体性，允许原子分辨率的可视化。此外，连接体安装将配位与结晶解耦，使框架构建转变为在预定义晶体学位点上的可控事件。
items.l1_lead: PCN-700通过其独特的连接体安装策略和框架灵活性，显著提高了金属有机框架中配位化学的研究效率和可视化能力。
items.l2_summary:
配位化学在化学、生物和材料科学中具有重要的作用，而晶体配位材料因其长程结构的有序性，为研究配位现象提供了独特的机会。金属有机框架（MOFs）因其高度可调的组成和空间排列，极大地扩展了配位化学的应用范围。然而，传统的后合成修饰方法在安装效率和配位研究方面存在一定的局限性。为了解决这些问题，PCN-700的发现及其连接体安装策略提供了一种新的解决方案。

PCN-700的独特之处在于其高度不配位的锆簇、预定义的安装位点以及卓越的框架灵活性，这使得其在配位体的安装过程中表现出高效性，同时保持了晶体的完整性。这种特性允许研究者在原子分辨率下对其进行可视化，进而深入理解其配位行为。此外，连接体的安装将配位过程与结晶解耦，使得框架的构建转变为在预定义晶体学位点上的可控事件。这一创新方法不仅提高了配位体的安装效率，也为后续的配位化学研究提供了新的思路和工具。

总的来说，PCN-700的研究展示了金属有机框架在配位化学中的潜力，尤其是在后合成修饰方面的应用，为科学家们提供了一个新的模型平台，推动了配位化学的进一步发展。通过这种方式，研究者能够更系统地探索和利用配位现象，从而在材料科学和其他相关领域中开辟新的研究方向。

Sign up YOUR GO-TO HUB FOR DAILY NEWS, INSIGHT AND RESOURCES FOR PRACTICE LEADERSHIP MAGAZINES News Management Health & Patient Care Health Tech Practice Operations Recruit and Retain Legal & Compliance Live it News Management Health & Patient Care Health Tech Practice Operations Recruit and Retain Legal & Compliance Live it England’s Obesity Gap Widens Obesity levels in England have reached record highs, with almost one in three adults now living with the condition and new cases increasing most rapidly among younger age groups CREDIT: This is an edited version of an article that originally appeared in Pharmaphorum Drawing on NHS England data covering more than 54 million people between 2019 and 2025, researchers found that obesity rates accelerated following the COVID-19 pandemic and continue to rise unevenly across regions and socioeconomic groups. The findings also suggest that obesity has now become more prevalent than high blood pressure in the UK.
Adults aged 30 to 39 recorded the largest increase, with rates of new obesity cases rising by almost 20%, while adults aged 20 to 29 experienced a 16% increase. In contrast, rates declined among adults aged 60 to 79. Researchers noted that rising obesity among younger adults is particularly concerning due to the associated long-term health implications and the potential impact across future generations.
Growing Regional and Socioeconomic Inequalities
The analysis revealed significant inequalities linked to geography and deprivation. People living in the most socioeconomically disadvantaged communities – characterised by lower income levels, higher unemployment and poorer housing conditions – experienced obesity rates substantially above those seen in more affluent areas. Overall, new obesity cases were found to be 35% higher among the most deprived populations.
Among women, the disparity was even more pronounced. Women from the most deprived backgrounds experienced obesity rates 54% higher than those in the least deprived groups.
Regional variation was equally striking. In northeast England, 48% of adults were affected by obesity compared with 8.5% in central London.
Long-Term Health and Intergenerational Risks
Obesity is associated with increased risks of chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease and certain cancers. It is also linked to infertility, pregnancy complications and a greater likelihood of childhood obesity.
The researchers suggested these patterns may contribute to ongoing cycles of health inequality that extend across generations if underlying drivers are not addressed.
Professor Naveed Sattar, Professor of Cardiometabolic Medicine at the University of Glasgow and Chair of the UK’s Obesity Health Care Goals Programme, said the findings reinforce that obesity is influenced by environmental and structural factors rather than individual willpower alone. He highlighted the importance of expanding access to effective treatment options while also redesigning food and physical activity environments to make healthier choices more accessible and achievable.
Researchers warned that without coordinated intervention, rising obesity rates could lead to increasing levels of multimorbidity, additional pressure on NHS services and wider economic consequences.
While new treatments may form part of the response, researchers emphasised that lasting progress would depend on addressing the underlying conditions that contribute to obesity. Without broader action, the health and social consequences are expected to continue expanding in the years ahead.

items.title_zh: 英格兰肥胖差距加大 - 商业实践
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了英格兰肥胖现象的加剧，强调肥胖不仅仅是个人意志力的问题，而是受到环境和结构因素的深刻影响。研究结果表明，改善肥胖问题需要扩大有效的治疗选择，并重塑食品和体育活动环境，以使健康选择更加可及和可实现。文章指出，单靠个人努力无法解决肥胖问题，必须采取系统性措施来应对这一公共健康挑战。
items.l1_lead: 英格兰肥胖问题加剧，需通过系统性措施改善环境与结构因素，以实现更可及的健康选择，单靠个人努力无法解决。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了英格兰肥胖现象的加剧，指出肥胖问题不仅仅是个人意志力的结果，更是受到环境和结构性因素的深刻影响。研究表明，肥胖的成因复杂，涉及社会经济状况、食品可及性以及体育活动的环境等多重因素。因此，单靠个人的努力和自我管理无法有效解决这一问题。为了应对肥胖这一公共健康挑战，文章强调需要采取系统性措施。

具体而言，改善肥胖问题的关键在于扩大有效的治疗选择，并重塑食品和体育活动的环境，以使健康选择更加可及和可实现。研究结果显示，许多地区的居民面临着健康食品获取困难和缺乏适当运动设施的问题，这使得他们在选择健康生活方式时受到限制。因此，政策制定者和公共卫生专家应关注这些结构性障碍，推动相关政策的实施，以改善整体健康状况。

文章还提到，肥胖的流行不仅影响个体的健康，还对社会经济造成了负担，增加了医疗成本和生产力损失。因此，解决肥胖问题不仅是个人的责任，更是社会的共同任务。通过综合考虑环境因素和社会结构，制定出切实可行的干预措施，才能有效地减少肥胖差距，提升公众的健康水平。总之，面对日益严重的肥胖问题，必须采取全面的、系统的策略，以实现真正的改善。

Advertise Inquiries Subscribe ▼ × About us Events Instagram Facebook LinkedIn GENE ONLINE | News & Opinion Blog 2026-09-21 | APAC Transformative Biological and Environmental Frontiers: Synthesizing the 2026 Tang Prize Science Laureates by Michelle Jessica Share To The 2026 Tang Prize in Sustainable Development and Biopharmaceutical Science honors Susan Solomon, Steven Rosenberg, Michel Sadelain, and Carl June for groundbreaking discoveries in atmospheric chemistry and CAR-T living cell therapies. Image: Courtesy of Tang Prize Foundation T he Tang Prize in Sustainable Development and Biopharmaceutical Science honors pivotal scientific advances that improve global health, restore damaged ecosystems, and deliver transformative medical treatments. The 2026 science laureates, Professor Susan Solomon for Sustainable Development, along with Dr. Steven A. Rosenberg , Dr. Michel Sadelain , and Dr. Carl H. June for Biopharmaceutical Science, demonstrate how disciplined empirical research and precise molecular design can overcome seemingly insurmountable challenges. By uncovering the specific chemical pathways behind the destruction of atmospheric ozone and constructing custom living cellular therapies that eliminate late stage cancers, these researchers have established essential scientific foundations for modern medicine and ecological conservation.
Professor Susan Solomon’s landmark contributions to atmospheric physics and chemistry established the scientific foundation for modern environmental monitoring and international climate policy. In 1986, Professor Solomon led an expedition to Antarctica to investigate the rapid, unexplained depletion of stratospheric ozone over the South Pole. Her research yielded definitive empirical proof that active chlorine chemical species, derived from human made chlorofluorocarbons, were reacting on the frozen surfaces of polar stratospheric clouds. These heterogeneous chemical reactions converted benign reservoir compounds into highly reactive free radicals, which liberated chlorine upon exposure to spring sunlight and rapidly destroyed ozone molecules through catalytic chain reactions.
This definitive mechanistic proof provided the scientific backing required for the 1987 Montreal Protocol, forcing a global phaseout of ozone depleting substances. Decades later, observational data confirmed the first measurable signs of Antarctic stratospheric ozone healing in 2016, proving that international industrial phaseouts guided by rigorous chemical physics can successfully reverse global environmental damage. Building on her stratospheric research, Professor Solomon now advocates for a unified global moonshot framework to tackle climate change, combining fundamental physical science, advanced industrial engineering, and aggressive public policy to accelerate carbon neutral transition strategies across global industrial sectors.
The revolution in cancer immunotherapy began with Dr. Steven A. Rosenberg’s pioneering work on cellular transfer and genetic modification at the National Cancer Institute . Dr. Rosenberg demonstrated that the human immune system could be harnessed to treat established malignancies by administering systemic interleukin 2 to stimulate endogenous T cells, achieving sustained complete regressions in patients with metastatic melanoma. Recognizing that tumor reactive lymphocytes were concentrated within malignant tissues, he isolated Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes from surgical specimens, expanded them ex vivo, and reinfused them into patients alongside interleukin 2 conditioning regimens. This marked the first successful clinical deployment of autologous living cells to eradicate solid tumors in humans.
In 1990, Dr. Rosenberg pushed cellular medicine further by conducting the first authorized human gene transfer protocol in history. By using a retroviral vector to introduce a marker gene into tumor infiltrating T cells prior to patient infusion, his team tracked the long-term migration, persistence, and tissue homing of modified immune cells inside the human body. This milestone disproved widespread safety concerns regarding retroviral insertion into human cellular DNA, proving the feasibility of genetic reprogramming and directly opening the door for engineered T-cell receptors and synthetic chimeric antigen receptors.
While early cell therapies relied on naturally occurring T cells, Dr. Michel Sadelain advanced the field into synthetic biology by designing custom molecular receptors capable of reprogramming immune cell specificity and function. Natural T-cell receptors require major histocompatibility complex molecules to recognize target peptides, a restriction that allows tumor cells to evade detection by downregulating antigen presentation. To overcome this limitation, Dr. Sadelain constructed Chimeric Antigen Receptors, recombinant proteins fusing an extracellular single-chain variable fragment antibody domain directly to intracellular T-cell signaling chains, enabling histocompatibility independent recognition of cell surface antigens.
First generation receptors containing only the CD3-zeta signaling chain failed to sustain T-cell proliferation and effector function inside the body. In 2003, Dr. Sadelain engineered second generation receptors incorporating a costimulatory domain, specifically CD28, in tandem with CD3-zeta. This dual signaling architecture provided the requisite secondary signal to trigger robust T-cell activation, rapid cellular proliferation, prolonged survival, and potent targeted cytotoxicity. Dr. Sadelain identified the surface molecule CD19 as an ideal target for B-cell malignancies, demonstrating in preclinical models that genetically modified human T cells could systematically eliminate leukemias and lymphomas. His architectural blueprint established single infusion curative living therapies, a platform now actively expanding into autoimmune conditions, solid malignancies, and senescence associated tissue pathologies.
Translating synthetic receptor constructs from laboratory bench concepts into widespread clinical therapeutics required solving immense manufacturing and physiological hurdles, a task led by Dr. Carl H. June. Dr. June invented the anti-CD3/CD28 magnetic bead cell culture protocol, providing the essential bioprocess foundation to reliably activate, expand, and engineer billions of patient derived T cells ex vivo within clinical grade manufacturing facilities.
To optimize cellular performance, Dr. June incorporated the 4-1BB costimulatory signaling domain into the chimeric receptor structure. Unlike CD28 costimulation, which drives rapid effector responses, 4-1BB signaling enhances mitochondrial biogenesis, promotes central memory T-cell differentiation, and prevents cellular exhaustion, resulting in sustained T-cell persistence in patients for years. In clinical trials treating pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia, Dr. June achieved unprecedented durable complete remissions in patients who had failed all conventional chemotherapies. During these early trials, his team characterized and developed clinical management protocols for Cytokine Release Syndrome—a severe, systemic inflammatory cascade triggered by massive in vivo T-cell expansion—by targeting the interleukin 6 signaling pathway. This landmark translational work directly led to the 2017 FDA approval of Kymriah, the world’s first commercial chimeric antigen receptor cell therapy, permanently establishing cellular engineering as a pillar of modern oncology.
The impact of these scientific breakthroughs extends beyond individual laboratories into global academic forums and collaborative research networks. During the Tang Prize master classes and university forums, the laureates emphasized the necessity of interdisciplinary translation in solving complex biological and atmospheric challenges. Bridging fundamental chemical kinetics with planetary scale environmental policy demonstrates how physical sciences directly inform international regulatory frameworks. Similarly, converging synthetic biology, viral vector engineering, and clinical oncology illustrates the continuous feedback loop required to transform benchtop genetic concepts into standardized, life saving therapeutics.
Looking toward the future, the integration of computational genomics, automated cellular bioprocessing, and high throughput functional screening promises to further accelerate these fields. Environmental scientists continue to refine predictive atmospheric models to evaluate emerging industrial pollutants, ensuring the lessons learned from stratospheric ozone restoration inform contemporary climate mitigation strategies. Meanwhile, biopharmaceutical researchers are extending chimeric antigen receptor architectures beyond hematological malignancies, designing next generation multi-specific cell therapies to target heterogeneous solid tumors and autoimmune disorders. The collective achievements of the 2026 Tang Prize science laureates provide both the empirical foundation and the intellectual roadmap for these ongoing global endeavors.

items.title_zh: 2026年唐奖科学奖得主的生物与环境前沿探索
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了2026年唐奖科学奖得主在癌症免疫疗法领域的开创性工作。该科学家通过系统性施用白细胞介素2（interleukin-2）来刺激内源性T细胞，成功治疗了转移性黑色素瘤患者，标志着癌症免疫疗法的革命性进展。他的研究成果推翻了关于逆转录病毒插入人类细胞DNA的广泛安全性担忧。为此，他从手术标本中分离肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，进行体外扩增，并在患者体内重新注入，以增强免疫反应。这一里程碑式的研究为癌症治疗提供了新的思路和方法。
items.l1_lead: 2026年唐奖科学奖得主通过白细胞介素2刺激T细胞，成功治疗转移性黑色素瘤，推动癌症免疫疗法的革命性进展。
items.l2_summary:
2026年唐奖科学奖得主在癌症免疫疗法领域的研究取得了显著进展，尤其是在治疗转移性黑色素瘤方面。该科学家通过系统性施用白细胞介素2（interleukin-2），成功刺激了患者体内的内源性T细胞，显著增强了免疫反应。这一方法不仅为转移性黑色素瘤患者提供了新的治疗选择，也标志着癌症免疫疗法的革命性突破。研究中，科学家从手术标本中分离出肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，并在体外进行扩增，随后将这些细胞重新注入患者体内，以增强其免疫系统对癌细胞的攻击能力。

此外，该研究还推翻了关于逆转录病毒插入人类细胞DNA的广泛安全性担忧，为癌症免疫疗法的进一步发展提供了重要的理论支持和实践依据。这一里程碑式的研究成果不仅为癌症治疗开辟了新的思路和方法，也为未来的临床应用奠定了基础，展现了免疫疗法在癌症治疗中的巨大潜力。通过这一系列创新性的研究，科学家们为癌症患者带来了新的希望，推动了生物医学领域的前沿探索。

items.title: Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption - Healthcare Asia Magazine
items.body:
原话：“We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact.” / “A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted.”
论点：医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。
items.authors: Yu Han

quotes: We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact.
A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted.
items.topic_zh: 医疗技术采纳中的挑战
items.claim_zh: 医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。
items.article_body:
Published: 12 days ago Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption Medtech companies face commercial barriers when new products fail to integrate with hospital systems or add complexity to clinical practice.
Healthcare technology companies risk losing adoption if products cannot fit existing clinical workflows, regardless of how advanced the underlying technology may be.
Speaking during Medical Fair Asia 2026, Yu-Han, Project Manager at Taiwan Excellence, said healthcare products are assessed across research and development, design, marketing and quality, with emphasis on whether they address practical needs.
“We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact,” Yu-Han said.
The real test comes when healthcare technology moves from development to deployment. Hospitals must consider whether new tools can be integrated into existing systems without creating additional administrative or operational burdens for clinicians.
“A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted,” Yu-Han said.
Regulation adds another layer of complexity. Navigating different local policies and requirements can lengthen implementation and complicate market entry across healthcare systems.
For medtech companies, commercial success therefore depends not only on technical performance but also on workflow compatibility, regulatory readiness and ease of implementation.
Technologies that reduce friction for clinicians and integrate more easily into existing hospital processes are more likely to move from pilot or development stages into routine use.
items.title_zh: 医疗技术采纳受限于临床工作流程缺口
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中面临的挑战，特别是其与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管技术解决方案在实验室中可能表现出色，但如果它们增加了医生日常工作的复杂性或无法与医院系统无缝对接，就不会被广泛采纳。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生影响是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。
items.l1_lead: 医疗技术的成功应用依赖于其与临床工作流程的兼容性，若增加医生工作复杂性则难以被广泛采纳。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中所面临的挑战，特别是与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管一些技术解决方案在实验室环境中表现出色，但在实际应用中，如果这些技术增加了医生日常工作的复杂性，或者无法与医院的现有系统无缝对接，就会导致其难以被广泛采纳。这一现象反映出医疗技术采纳的一个重要障碍，即临床工作流程的缺口。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生积极影响，是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。

在医疗行业，医生的工作流程通常是高度复杂且繁忙的，任何可能导致额外负担的技术都可能被抵制。因此，医疗技术的设计和实施必须充分考虑临床工作流程的实际需求，确保技术能够与现有系统有效整合，以减少对医生工作的干扰。作者呼吁研发团队在技术开发阶段就应与临床医生密切合作，了解他们的需求和痛点，从而设计出更符合实际使用场景的解决方案。

此外，文章还指出，成功的医疗技术不仅需要在技术层面上具备先进性，更需要在实际应用中展现出其对临床工作的积极影响。只有当医疗技术能够真正解决临床医生面临的实际问题，并在日常工作中提供便利时，才能获得医生的认可和采纳。因此，推动医疗技术的成功应用，关键在于如何有效地缩小技术与临床工作流程之间的差距，确保技术的实用性和可操作性。

items.title: Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics for therapeutic grade interventions.
items.body: Optogenetics, a biotechnology that combines optical and genetic strategies to regulate cellular and tissue functions with high spatial and temporal precision, serves as a powerful tool-level regulatory technology widely employed to investigate cellular processes and elucidate disease mechanisms. Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, which incorporates nanomaterials/nanostructures to improve the efficacy and broaden the applications of optogenetic systems, synergistically integrates the precision, tunability, and multifunctionality of nanotechnology with the spatiotemporal control inherent to optogenetics. The development not only enhances the flexibility and efficiency of optogenetic technology but also advances the field toward therapeutic-grade interventions. In this review, we summarize recent advances in nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, with a particular emphasis on three key areas: (1) nanostructured light sources for the precise activation of optogenetic systems, which include both externally light-stimulated systems and systems that operate independently of external light sources; (2) nanotechnology-enabled targeted delivery of light-sensitive proteins and genetic constructs to ensure efficient modulation of optogenetic pathways, which specifically involves the nanotechnology-assisted gene, protein, and recombinase enzyme delivery approaches; and (3) nanotechnology-driven therapeutic applications of optogenetics, including CAR T cell immunotherapy, cancer treatment, neurological interventions, and cardiac therapies. We further discuss the current challenges facing this emerging field and outline future research directions. This review aims not only to highlight recent breakthroughs but also to position nanotechnology-driven optogenetics as a promising tool for next-generation precision medicine.
items.authors: Chen X, Zhang X, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学在治疗干预中的应用
items.summary_zh: 光遗传学是一种结合光学和遗传策略的生物技术，能够以高空间和时间精度调控细胞和组织功能，广泛用于研究细胞过程和阐明疾病机制。纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过引入纳米材料/纳米结构，提高了光遗传系统的有效性并拓宽了其应用范围，结合了纳米技术的精确性、可调性和多功能性与光遗传学固有的时空控制。该发展不仅增强了光遗传技术的灵活性和效率，还推动了该领域向治疗级干预的进展。本文总结了纳米技术驱动的光遗传学的最新进展，重点关注三个关键领域：(1) 纳米结构光源用于精确激活光遗传系统，包括外部光刺激系统和独立于外部光源的系统；(2) 纳米技术促进的光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送，以确保高效调控光遗传通路；(3) 纳米技术驱动的相关应用。
items.l1_lead: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过提高系统有效性和灵活性，推动了治疗干预的进展，拓宽了其在疾病研究和治疗中的应用。
items.l2_summary:
光遗传学是一种结合光学与遗传学的生物技术，能够以高空间和时间精度调控细胞和组织的功能，广泛应用于细胞过程研究和疾病机制的阐明。近年来，纳米技术的引入极大地推动了光遗传学的发展，通过纳米材料和纳米结构的应用，显著提高了光遗传系统的有效性，并拓宽了其应用范围。纳米技术的精确性、可调性和多功能性与光遗传学的时空控制相结合，使得光遗传技术在灵活性和效率上得到了增强，进而推动了该领域向治疗级干预的进展。

在纳米技术驱动的光遗传学中，研究者们关注了三个关键领域。首先，纳米结构光源的应用使得光遗传系统的激活更加精确，这些光源包括外部光刺激系统和独立于外部光源的系统，能够在不同的实验条件下实现高效的光激活。其次，纳米技术促进了光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送，这一过程确保了光遗传通路的高效调控，使得研究者能够在特定细胞或组织中实现精准的基因表达调控。最后，纳米技术驱动的相关应用不断扩展，涵盖了从基础研究到临床治疗的多个领域，展现出光遗传学在生物医学中的广泛前景。

综上所述，纳米技术的引入为光遗传学提供了新的动力，使其在细胞功能调控和疾病治疗中展现出更大的潜力。通过精确的纳米结构光源和高效的靶向递送系统，光遗传学的应用范围得到了显著拓展，为未来的生物医学研究和临床干预开辟了新的方向。

A new, Kitchener-made traffic light technology has the answer If you've ever found yourself second guessing whether you should speed up to make a green light, a new traffic-light technology in Waterloo region may help. Kitchener-based company Miovision, a global intelligence transportation system vendor, launched vehicle to everything (V2X) in Kitchener a few months ago. Mispronunciations can occur. We are working with our partners to continually review and improve the results. Kitchener-based company Miovision, a global intelligence transportation system vendor, launched vehicle to everything (V2X) in Kitchener a few months ago. (Lauren Kuivenhoven/CBC) Social Sharing If you've ever found yourself second guessing whether you should speed up to make a green light, a new traffic light technology in Kitchener may help.
Kitchener-based company Miovision, a global intelligence transportation system vendor, launched vehicle to everything (V2X) in the city a few months ago.
It's a technology that connects traffic light information to cars, and lets drivers know when a light is going to be red or green by displaying a traffic light icon on the vehicle’s dashboard.
“Knowing what the signal is doing reduces your stress level dramatically … I know I don't need to rush because it's not going to do me any good,” said Thomas Bauer, the vice president of V2X at Miovision.
Thomas Bauer, the vice president of V2X at Miovision, explains how information from traffic lights is connected to cars. (Lauren Kuivenhoven/CBC) The traffic icon provides a countdown to green, the speed a driver must stay at to make a green light and a warning about when the light will turn red. Bauer says if a driver is going over the speed limit, the display will disappear.
The countdown to a green light will disappear four seconds before the light changes, “just to make sure that you are now looking out the window,” said Bauer.
He says the technology is meant as a driving assist for now, although it's a stepping stone toward autonomous driving.
Bauer says the technology offers both safety and environmental benefits. He says it’s especially valuable for heavy vehicles.
“They have a much longer braking distance. For them to know in advance if they're going to make a signal or not, this can be life or death.”
Bauer says knowing when to stop allows vehicles to save on fuel consumption, because they have more information on when to slow down for a traffic light.
Miovision started out by counting cars to help with transportation planning, and expanded to emergency vehicle pre-emption, which modifies the traffic signal to allow emergency vehicle or public transit through an intersection.
Miovision's V2X technology provides a countdown to a green light on a vehicle's dashboard. (Lauren Kuivenhoven/CBC) Now the company has launched V2X in Kitchener, which allows data from traffic lights to flow into vehicles over a cellular network.
“Kitchener is one of these cities in Canada where we have most of our equipment deployed. It's now available, I would say about 90 per cent of the intersections here,” said Bauer.
According to the Region of Waterloo, Miovision technology has been connected to traffic lights across the region since 2020.
In an emailed statement to CBC News, the region says the system uses cameras and other detection devices that are connected to the traffic signal controller.
Data is retrieved about cyclists, pedestrians and vehicles to "optimize the operation of the traffic signals,” said the statement, in part.
Kitchener-made tech connects cars to traffic light grid
September 1 | Duration closed caption 4:22 Miovision launched V2X in Kitchener a few months ago, a technology that connects traffic light information to cars. It lets drivers know when the light will turn red or green. Thomas Bauer, the vice president of V2X at Miovision, showed CBC K-W's Lauren Kuivenhoven how the technology works. With the new V2X technology, Bauer says instead of just collecting data about cars and intersections, the cars will be able to also receive data from the traffic lights.
"This is basically the reverse data flow. Instead of into the signal, it's from the signal back to the driver to influence the vehicle," said Bauer.
V2X currently covers more than 70,000 intersections across eight countries.
It’s available in VW Group cars, such as Audi, Bently and Porsche. Bauer says drivers can also download an app to connect the technology to their car, if they don't have a car brand from VW Group.

items.title_zh: 基于新技术的交通信号灯提升重型车辆安全性
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了一种由基奇纳（Kitchener）研发的新型交通信号灯技术，该技术旨在提高重型车辆的安全性。核心论点是，重型车辆由于其较长的刹车距离，提前获知信号灯变化对其行驶安全至关重要。研究表明，了解何时停车可以帮助车辆节省燃料消耗，因为驾驶员能够更好地掌握何时减速。此外，该技术实现了信号灯与驾驶员之间的反向数据流，从而影响车辆的行驶决策。通过这些创新，重型车辆在接近信号灯时能够更安全地行驶，减少事故发生的风险。
items.l1_lead: 新型交通信号灯技术通过提前通知重型车辆信号变化，提高行驶安全性并减少事故风险，同时帮助节省燃料消耗。
items.l2_summary: 本文探讨了一种由基奇纳（Kitchener）研发的新型交通信号灯技术，旨在提升重型车辆的安全性。重型车辆由于其较长的刹车距离，提前获知信号灯变化对其行驶安全至关重要。研究表明，了解何时停车不仅能够帮助驾驶员更好地掌握减速时机，还能有效节省燃料消耗。这一技术的核心在于实现了信号灯与驾驶员之间的反向数据流，使得信号灯能够向重型车辆传递信息，从而影响其行驶决策。通过这种创新，重型车辆在接近信号灯时能够更安全地行驶，显著减少事故发生的风险。总之，这项新技术不仅提升了重型车辆的行驶安全性，还在环保方面具有积极意义，推动了交通管理的智能化发展。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 与衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积的组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化。通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，我们阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。我们的研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这些损伤并不容易通过不足的韧性机制预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。
items.l1_lead: 炎症在心血管疾病中扮演核心角色，其上游驱动因素为与衰老相关的分子损伤，理解这一机制为疾病的预防和治疗提供新机会。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步以及对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症的角色逐渐被重新审视，不再被视为孤立的病因，而是对累积的组织损伤所产生的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在应对由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能出现失调，导致适应不良，从而促进病理变化的发生。

通过分析动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白质组学数据来支持这些概念模型。这些研究结果强调了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，而这些损伤往往难以通过不足的韧性机制进行有效的预防或修复。因此，理解这些反应的协调机制为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。

总之，本文的研究强调了衰老过程中分子损伤与心血管疾病相关炎症之间的复杂关系，提示我们在未来的研究和临床实践中，应更加关注如何调节和改善炎症反应，以降低心血管疾病的风险。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中涉及的双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）及其相关酶催化反应。研究表明，进化通常导致酶选择性地促进特定异构体的形成，而不是众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象显示了动态对选择性的影响，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多种产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。PTSB的存在使得选择性不能完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的体系中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应中双模态过渡态的最新进展，以及酶如何控制这些反应中的选择性。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了生物合成中双模态过渡态的进展，强调了多重后过渡态分叉现象对产物选择性的影响，挑战了传统过渡态理论的解释。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中涉及的双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）及其相关酶催化反应的最新研究进展与面临的挑战。研究表明，酶的进化通常会选择性地促进特定异构体的形成，而非众多其他潜在分子，这一现象在生物合成中具有重要意义。近期的研究发现了多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，揭示了动态因素对选择性的影响。具体而言，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多种产物，这一发现与传统的能量控制机制相悖，表明选择性不能仅仅通过过渡态理论来解释。

PTSB的存在使得研究者们面临新的挑战，尤其是在理解如何在包含分叉的体系中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性方面。计算化学家们正在积极开发新技术，以深入探讨这些复杂反应机制。通过对酶催化反应中双模态过渡态的研究，科学家们不仅能够更好地理解酶如何控制反应选择性，还可能为天然产物的合成提供新的思路和方法。

综上所述，双模态过渡态及其相关的PTSB现象为生物合成反应的选择性提供了新的视角，推动了对酶催化机制的深入理解，同时也提出了新的研究方向和挑战。

items.title: Exploring Splicing-Energy Axis Associations to Diet and Longevity.
items.body: There is increasing evidence that nutrient composition, even without lowering total calorie intake, can shape lifespan through mechanisms independent of mitochondrial regulation. Brandon and colleagues recently reported that a low-protein, high-carbohydrate (LPHC) diet enriched with non-digestible cellulose, extends lifespan in mice by shifting the liver proteome through altered RNA splicing, a response different from the mitochondrial improvements typically seen with caloric restriction. The authors' findings support the "energy-splicing resilience axis," which proposes that changes in splicing help cells adapt to energetic and nutritional stress. We discuss how diet influences spliceosomal components such as SRSF1, linking nutrient sensing, AMPK signaling, and tissue-specific resilience pathways. We also consider the splicing paradox in aging, where beneficial isoforms increase despite a concomitant increase in splicing errors. Understanding how dietary and pharmacologic interventions modulate splicing may shed light on strategies to maintain homeostatic proteomes and support healthy longevity.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 探讨剪接-能量轴与饮食及寿命的关系
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，营养成分的变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事最近报道，低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食，结合不可消化的纤维素，能够通过改变RNA剪接，改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命。这一反应与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善不同。作者的研究支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为剪接的变化帮助细胞适应能量和营养压力。文章讨论了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，如SRSF1，连接营养感知、AMPK信号传导和组织特异性韧性通路。同时，文章还考虑了衰老中的剪接悖论，即有益的异构体尽管伴随剪接错误的增加而增加。理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，低蛋白高碳水化合物饮食通过改变RNA剪接，能延长小鼠寿命，支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”理论，揭示饮食对细胞适应能量和营养压力的重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，越来越多的研究表明，饮食中的营养成分变化，即使在不降低总热量摄入的情况下，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事的最新研究发现，低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食结合不可消化的纤维素，能够通过改变RNA剪接，进而改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命。这一发现与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善机制有所不同，提示我们在研究寿命延长的机制时，不能仅仅依赖于线粒体的功能改善。

该研究支持了“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为RNA剪接的变化有助于细胞适应能量和营养的压力。文章深入探讨了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，例如SRSF1，这一过程连接了营养感知、AMPK信号传导以及组织特异性韧性通路。此外，研究还考虑了衰老过程中的剪接悖论，即尽管剪接错误的发生率增加，但一些有益的异构体却随之增加。这一现象提示我们，剪接的变化可能在衰老过程中发挥复杂的作用。

理解饮食和药物干预如何调节RNA剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新的策略。这一研究不仅为我们提供了新的视角去理解饮食与寿命之间的关系，也为未来的营养干预和衰老研究开辟了新的方向。通过进一步探索剪接机制与饮食的相互作用，科学家们或许能够找到更有效的方式来促进健康老龄化。

items.title: Genomic Perspective on Heterogeneity of Organs and Body Aging.
items.body: Aging is a heterogeneous process, with organ systems and individuals experiencing variable rates of decline that are not fully reflected by chronological age. This variability contributes to the complexity of system morbidity, which poses increasing challenges for clinical care and biomedical research. In this review, we discuss the heterogeneity of organ and whole-body aging and perspectives on genomics as possible mechanisms that relate to such heterogeneity. We discuss how static genomics, including nuclear genetic variants, and dynamic genetics, such as somatic mutations, epigenetic drifts, and mitochondrial DNA changes might explain the variable rate of aging across organ systems and the whole body. We discuss that the use of metrics that capture heterogeneity in organ and body aging is critical to identify genomic biomarkers of aging, clarifying mechanisms of adaptation versus decline.
items.authors: Salimi S, Raftery D, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 从基因组视角看器官与身体衰老的异质性
items.summary_zh: 衰老是一个异质性过程，器官系统和个体的衰退速率各不相同，这种差异并不能完全通过生理年龄来反映。本文评述了器官和全身衰老的异质性，以及基因组学（genomics）作为可能机制的视角。我们探讨了静态基因组学（static genomics），包括核遗传变异，以及动态遗传学（dynamic genetics），如体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化，如何解释器官系统和全身衰老速率的差异。我们认为，使用能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，这有助于阐明适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。
items.l1_lead: 衰老过程的异质性表明，器官和个体的衰退速率受基因组学因素影响，需通过特定指标识别衰老的基因组生物标志物。
items.l2_summary:
衰老是一个复杂且异质性的过程，不同器官系统和个体的衰退速率存在显著差异，这种差异并不能仅通过生理年龄来充分反映。本文从基因组学（genomics）的视角出发，评述了器官和全身衰老的异质性，探讨了静态基因组学（static genomics）和动态遗传学（dynamic genetics）在解释这些差异中的作用。静态基因组学主要关注核遗传变异，而动态遗传学则涉及体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化等因素。这些基因组学的变化可能是导致器官系统和全身衰老速率不同的重要机制。

研究表明，器官衰老的速度和个体的整体衰老状态并不总是呈现一致性，某些器官可能会表现出较快的衰老速率，而其他器官则可能保持相对年轻的状态。通过分析基因组的变化，尤其是体细胞突变和表观遗传的变化，研究人员能够更好地理解衰老过程中的适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。我们认为，识别能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于发现衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，这将有助于深入阐明衰老的生物学基础。

总之，本文强调了从基因组的角度理解衰老异质性的重要性，指出了静态和动态遗传学在这一过程中的关键作用，并呼吁进一步研究以揭示衰老的复杂机制。这些研究不仅有助于理解衰老的生物学，还可能为衰老相关疾病的预防和治疗提供新的思路。

items.title: Printing technologies for monitoring crop health.
items.body: Agricultural production requires low-cost sensors capable of delivering reliable, high-resolution data across large areas. Rising food demand, limited arable land, and severe soil degradation have accelerated the adoption of precision agriculture, which relies on real-time monitoring of soil, plant, and environmental conditions. Central to this shift is the development of scalable sensor technologies enabled by advances in materials science. Printing techniques, including inkjet, screen, aerosol jet, 3D printing, and direct laser writing, offer versatile routes to fabricate flexible, large-area, and plant-integrated sensors. This Review surveys recent progress in printable low-dimensional materials for agricultural sensing, examines their physicochemical properties in relation to sensor performance, and discusses key challenges and future opportunities requiring interdisciplinary integration.
items.authors: Panáček D, Kupka V, Nalepa MA, Dědek I, Álvarez-Diduk R, Olenik S, Flauzino J, Zdražil J, Jakubec P, Zdražil L, Spíchal L, Sonigara KK, Zbořil R, Pumera M, Merkoçi A, Wang J, De Diego N, Güder F, Otyepka M.
items.title_zh: 监测作物健康的打印技术研究进展
items.summary_zh: 农业生产需要低成本传感器，以提供可靠的高分辨率数据，覆盖大面积农田。随着食品需求上升、可耕地减少和土壤严重退化，精准农业的采用加速，这依赖于对土壤、植物和环境条件的实时监测。材料科学的进步推动了可扩展传感器技术的发展。打印技术，包括喷墨打印、丝网印刷、气溶胶喷射、3D打印和直接激光写入，提供了制造柔性、大面积和植物集成传感器的多样化途径。本文评述了可打印低维材料在农业传感中的最新进展，考察了其物理化学性质与传感器性能的关系，并讨论了需要跨学科整合的关键挑战和未来机遇。
items.l1_lead: 打印技术的进步为农业提供了低成本、高分辨率的传感器解决方案，促进了精准农业的发展，满足了对实时监测的需求。
items.l2_summary:
随着全球食品需求的不断上升、可耕地面积的减少以及土壤退化问题的加剧，精准农业的应用变得愈发重要。这一领域依赖于对土壤、植物和环境条件的实时监测，而低成本、高分辨率的传感器则是实现这一目标的关键。近年来，材料科学的进步为可扩展传感器技术的发展提供了新的动力，尤其是打印技术的应用，如喷墨打印、丝网印刷、气溶胶喷射、3D打印和直接激光写入等，为制造柔性、大面积和植物集成传感器开辟了多样化的途径。

在这一背景下，本文评述了可打印低维材料在农业传感器中的最新进展，重点考察了这些材料的物理化学性质与传感器性能之间的关系。研究表明，低维材料的独特性质，如优异的导电性和灵活性，使其在传感器应用中展现出良好的性能。这些材料的应用不仅提高了传感器的灵敏度和响应速度，还能够在大面积农田中实现高效监测，从而为精准农业提供支持。

然而，尽管取得了一些进展，当前的研究仍面临诸多挑战。跨学科的整合显得尤为重要，材料科学、农业科学和工程技术等领域的合作将有助于推动传感器技术的进一步发展。此外，如何在实际应用中实现低成本、高效能的传感器仍然是一个亟待解决的问题。

总的来说，打印技术在农业传感器的应用前景广阔，未来的研究应着重于优化材料性能、降低生产成本以及提高传感器的集成度，以满足日益增长的农业监测需求。通过不断的技术创新和跨学科合作，农业生产的可持续发展将得到更好的保障。

items.title: NZ is again being soaked this summer – record ocean heat helps explain it
items.body: Understanding what is happening deep beneath the ocean surface is key to understanding the weather patterns we are experiencing on land.
items.authors: Kevin E. Trenberth
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/kevin-trenberth-15259（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 新西兰今夏再遭暴雨，海洋热量创纪录助解释现象
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了新西兰今夏频繁降雨的原因，指出深海的变化对陆地天气模式的影响至关重要。研究表明，海洋表层温度的上升与气候变化密切相关，导致极端天气事件的增加。通过分析海洋热量（ocean heat）的记录，科学家们发现，海洋的温暖不仅影响了气候系统，还可能加剧降雨和风暴的强度。这一现象强调了海洋与气候之间的复杂关系，提示我们在应对气候变化时需关注海洋深层的动态变化。
items.l1_lead: 新西兰今夏暴雨频发与海洋热量上升密切相关，表明海洋深层变化对气候和极端天气事件的影响不可忽视。
items.l2_summary: 新西兰今夏遭遇频繁暴雨的现象引发了科学家的关注，研究表明，深海的变化对陆地天气模式的影响至关重要。随着气候变化的加剧，海洋表层温度的上升与极端天气事件的增加密切相关。科学家通过分析海洋热量（ocean heat）的记录发现，海洋的温暖不仅对气候系统产生了深远影响，还可能加剧降雨和风暴的强度。这一现象突显了海洋与气候之间复杂的相互关系，表明在应对气候变化时，必须关注海洋深层的动态变化。研究结果强调了海洋热量的变化如何直接影响天气模式，尤其是在新西兰这样的地区，极端天气事件的频发与海洋温度的升高之间存在明显的关联。因此，深入理解海洋的变化机制，对于预测和应对未来的气候变化及其带来的极端天气事件具有重要意义。
items.l3_translation:
对于许多人来说，尤其是在北地奥克兰和科罗曼德地区，这个夏天的阵雨和强降雨已经变得过于熟悉。

本周，已经饱和的土地上再次出现了强降雨，导致上北岛各地发布洪水警报和封路。这些是个别的天气事件，但它们发生在异常温暖的海洋上，这使得大气中充满了额外的湿气和能量。

理解海洋热量及其如何影响降雨、风暴和海洋热浪，对于解释我们在陆地上所经历的现象至关重要。

几十年来，科学家们一直认为海面温度是天气和气候的关键影响因素。更温暖的表面意味着更多的蒸发、改变的风和移动的风暴轨迹。

但表面温度只是一个更深层系统的表面。最终决定海面温度如何持续和演变的是储存在海洋上层的海洋热量。

随着在全球范围内部署测量温度和盐度至2000米的剖面浮标，2000年代初期开始出现更清晰的全球深层热量图景。

这些观测使得将海洋分析扩展到1958年成为可能；在此之前，测量数据过于稀疏，无法提供全球视角。

虽然海面温度对于日常天气仍然至关重要，但海洋热量为理解气候变异和变化提供了基础。它决定了温暖表面条件持续的时间以及它们与上方大气的相互作用。

我参与的一个国际团队最近的分析显示，2025年的海洋热量达到了创纪录的水平，比2024年上升了约23泽焦耳。这一增加相当于全球年电力使用量的200多倍，或者将280亿个奥林匹克游泳池从20摄氏度加热到100摄氏度所需的能量。

海洋热量代表了海洋的垂直集成热量，由于其他形式的海洋能量较小，它构成了海洋的主要能量储存。

海洋巨大的热容量和流动性意味着它已成为从上升的温室气体中吸收多余热量的主要汇。现在，超过90%的地球能量失衡最终进入了海洋。

因此，海洋热量是全球变暖的最佳单一指标，紧随其后的是全球海平面上升。

这不是一个被动的过程。进入海洋的热量提高了海面温度，这反过来又影响了与大气的热量和湿气交换，并改变了天气系统。由于海洋是稳定分层的，向下混合热量需要时间。

在1970年代末，全球范围内500米深度的加热是显而易见的；在1990年代初，500-1000米层的热量变得明显，1990年代末1000-1500米层的热量也显现出来，而1500-2000米层的热量大约在2004年被发现。全球范围内，表面热量渗透到2000米深处大约需要25年。

海洋热量并不是在所有地方均匀分布的。海洋热浪会发展、演变并移动，影响当地天气和海洋生态系统。热量通过蒸发、凝结、降雨和径流进行转移。

随着每年打破记录，观察和评估海洋热量的需求变得紧迫。

不仅仅是创纪录的海洋热量和上升的海平面重要，更重要的是它们带来的极端天气和气候的快速增加。

陆地上的额外热量增加了干旱和野火的风险，而更大的蒸发则使大气中水蒸气增加。这些湿气被卷入天气系统中，导致更强的风暴——尤其是热带气旋和大气河流，例如最近几天淹没新西兰的那场。

推动这些风暴的同样海洋温暖也在表面上创造了海洋热浪。

在新西兰及其周边的海洋中，这些海洋热浪通常受到厄尔尼诺-南方涛动的影响。这个太平洋气候循环在厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜和“中性”阶段之间交替，强烈影响新西兰每年的风、温度和降雨。

在2025年，弱拉尼娜与新西兰周围和东部的创纪录高海面温度结合，帮助维持了最近的不稳定模式。这种温暖的海洋使得大气河流和含水系统更有可能到达阿奥特罗阿，正如2023年初奥克兰周年周末洪水和加布里埃尔气旋所示。

因此，持续的观察——收集、处理和质量控制——是必不可少的，必须与质量、能量、水和海平面的物理限制相对照。

展望未来，海洋不仅对热量重要，也对水资源至关重要。通常，约40%的海平面上升来自于温暖海水的膨胀；其余大部分来自于冰川和格林兰及南极冰盖的融化。

海平面也受到降雨地点的影响。在厄尔尼诺期间，太平洋上方的降雨往往增多，通常伴随着陆地上的干旱或干旱期。在拉尼娜期间，降雨更多地落在陆地上——如2025年东南亚部分地区所见——而暂时储存在湖泊和土壤中的水分可以稍微减少返回海洋的量。

一个显著的例子发生在2025年的澳大利亚，当时从5月到年底的强降雨使埃尔湖重新注满，将沙漠盐滩转变为广阔的内陆海。这种现象暂时将水从海洋中抽出，减缓海平面上升。

因此，通过卫星测高监测海平面上升是跟踪海洋热量的一个重要补充。跟踪热量和水分对于理解变异性和长期趋势至关重要。

杰出学者，国家大气研究中心；奥克兰大学附属教员，怀帕帕·陶马塔·劳

items.title: Gut dysbiosis in oncology: a risk factor for immunoresistance.
items.body: The gut microbiome is recognized as a determinant of response to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies in cancer. However, the clinical translation of microbiome science has been hampered by inconsistent definitions of dysbiosis, inadequate biomarker frameworks, and limited mechanistic understanding. In this review, we synthesize the current state of knowledge on how gut microbial composition and function influence ICI efficacy, highlighting both correlative and causal evidence. We discuss computational approaches based on α-diversity or taxonomic abundance and argue for more functionally and clinically informative models, such as the topological score (TOPOSCORE) and other dysbiosis indices derived from machine learning. Using retrospective analyses of metagenomic datasets from thousands of patients and healthy controls, we examine microbial patterns that distinguish responders from non-responders. We also explore how dysbiosis perturbs immunoregulatory pathways, including bile acid metabolism, gut permeability, and mucosal immunomodulation. Finally, we assess emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at correcting microbiome dysfunction - including dietary modification, bacterial consortia, and fecal microbiota transplantation - and describe how they are being deployed in multiple clinical trials. We conclude with a brief discussion of the ONCOBIOME initiative, which works with international partners to incorporate microbiome science into oncology workflows. By refining our understanding of gut-immune interactions and translating it into action, microbiome-informed oncology may unlock new therapeutic potential for patients previously resistant to immunotherapy.
items.authors: Almonte AA, Thomas S, Iebba V, Kroemer G, Derosa L, Zitvogel L.
items.title_zh: 肠道微生物失调在肿瘤学中的免疫耐药风险
items.summary_zh: 肠道微生物组被认为是癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法反应的决定因素。然而，微生物组科学的临床转化受到失调（dysbiosis）定义不一致、标志物框架不足和机制理解有限的阻碍。本文综述了肠道微生物组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，强调了相关和因果证据。我们讨论了基于α多样性或分类丰度的计算方法，并主张采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）和其他基于机器学习的失调指数。通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，我们考察了区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。同时，我们探讨了失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和粘膜免疫调节。最后，我们评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌群落和粪便微生物移植，并描述了它们在多个临床试验中的应用。我们以对ONCOBIOME倡议的简要讨论作为结尾。
items.l1_lead: 肠道微生物失调影响癌症免疫检查点抑制剂疗效，需采用更具功能性的模型评估其对免疫调节的影响，并探索新兴治疗策略以改善微生物组功能。
items.l2_summary:
肠道微生物组在癌症免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗法的反应中扮演着重要角色，但其临床转化面临诸多挑战，如微生物失调（dysbiosis）的定义不一致、标志物框架不足以及对机制的理解有限。本文综述了肠道微生物的组成和功能如何影响ICI疗效的现状，并强调了相关和因果证据。研究表明，微生物组的α多样性和分类丰度的计算方法存在局限，因此建议采用更具功能性和临床信息的模型，如拓扑评分（TOPOSCORE）和其他基于机器学习的失调指数。

通过对数千名患者和健康对照的宏基因组数据集进行回顾性分析，研究者考察了能够区分应答者与非应答者的微生物模式。这些分析揭示了失调如何扰乱免疫调节通路，包括胆汁酸代谢、肠道通透性和粘膜免疫调节等关键机制。失调的微生物组可能导致免疫系统对肿瘤的反应减弱，从而增加免疫耐药的风险。

此外，本文还评估了旨在纠正微生物组功能障碍的新兴治疗策略，包括饮食调整、细菌群落的重建和粪便微生物移植等。这些策略在多个临床试验中得到了应用，显示出改善ICI疗效的潜力。最后，文章以对ONCOBIOME倡议的简要讨论作为结尾，强调了进一步研究肠道微生物组与癌症免疫治疗之间关系的重要性，以期为未来的治疗策略提供新的思路和方向。

items.title: Engineering Heterocyclic Linkages to Expand the Structural and Functional Diversity of Covalent Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Heterocycle-linked covalent organic frameworks (HC-COFs) are a promising class of crystalline porous polymers constructed by linking organic modules into extended structures via heterocyclic moieties. HC-COFs have received considerable attention due to their robust linkages, extended π-conjugation and abundant heteroatomic sites. These intrinsic characteristics endow HC-COFs with high chemical stability, enhanced light-harvesting ability, and tunable redox activity, thus making them promising systems for widespread applications such as separation, catalysis, sensing, luminescence, biomedicine, energy storage, and environmental remediation. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of de novo synthesis and post-synthetic modification strategies employed for the production of HC-COFs, along with their physicochemical properties and representative applications. Finally, we highlight the future opportunities and challenges of HC-COFs for next generation functional materials. This review would offer an insightful understanding of the subtle interplay between heterocyclic linkages and overall skeleton, thus providing a useful guidance on how to further solve the COF trilemma regarding crystallinity, stability and functionality.
items.authors: Qian C, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 工程化杂环连接扩展共价有机框架的结构与功能多样性
items.summary_zh: 杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类有前景的结晶多孔聚合物，通过杂环基团将有机模块连接成扩展结构。HC-COFs因其稳固的连接、扩展的π-共轭和丰富的杂原子位点而受到广泛关注。这些内在特性赋予HC-COFs高化学稳定性、增强的光捕获能力和可调的氧化还原活性，使其在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等广泛应用中展现出良好前景。本文综述了HC-COFs的全新合成及后合成修饰策略，探讨其物理化学性质及代表性应用。最后，强调了HC-COFs在下一代功能材料中的未来机遇与挑战，提供了对杂环连接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的深入理解，为解决COF在结晶性、稳定性和功能性方面的三难问题提供了有益指导。
items.l1_lead: 杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）因其优异的化学稳定性和多样化功能，展现出在多个领域的广泛应用潜力，并为未来材料发展提供了新的机遇与挑战。
items.l2_summary:
工程化杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类新兴的结晶多孔聚合物，因其通过杂环基团将有机模块连接而形成的扩展结构而备受关注。HC-COFs的独特之处在于其稳固的连接性、扩展的π-共轭体系以及丰富的杂原子位点，这些特性使得HC-COFs在化学稳定性、光捕获能力和氧化还原活性等方面表现出色。因此，HC-COFs在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等领域展现出广泛的应用潜力。

本文综述了HC-COFs的创新合成及后合成修饰策略，深入探讨了其物理化学性质及代表性应用。研究表明，HC-COFs的合成方法不断演进，后合成修饰技术的引入使得其功能性得以进一步提升。通过对不同合成策略的比较，发现某些方法能够显著提高HC-COFs的结晶性和稳定性，从而增强其在实际应用中的表现。

此外，文章还强调了HC-COFs在下一代功能材料中的未来机遇与挑战，特别是在解决结晶性、稳定性和功能性之间的三难问题方面。通过对杂环连接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的深入理解，研究为优化HC-COFs的设计和应用提供了有益的指导。这些研究成果不仅为HC-COFs的进一步发展奠定了基础，也为相关领域的研究者提供了新的思路和方向。总之，HC-COFs作为一种具有广泛应用前景的材料，其未来的发展值得期待。

items.title: Navigating the next frontier in biomedicine: breakthroughs and insights in nucleic acid therapeutics.
items.body: Nucleic acid therapeutics are rapidly emerging as a transformative drug paradigm, offering precise and programmable regulation of gene expression across a broad spectrum of diseases. This review summarizes recent advances in key platforms-including antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, miRNA, mRNA, and aptamers-emphasizing their unique mechanisms of action and therapeutic potential. We systematically outline critical contributions of chemical modification and delivery engineering, including backbone and sugar modifications, site-specific design, N -acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) conjugation, and lipid nanoparticles, which collectively enhance stability, target specificity, and clinical applicability. Finally, we discuss persistent challenges such as immune activation, large-scale manufacturing, and long-term safety, and provide perspectives on future directions involving CRISPR-based gene editing, synthetic biology, nanotechnology, smart delivery systems, and combination therapies, aiming to offer strategic insights for the development and clinical translation of nucleic acid drugs.
items.authors: Wu S, Zhang Z, Zhao Z, Cui C, Tan W.
items.title_zh: 生物医学新前沿：核酸治疗的突破与见解
items.summary_zh: 核酸治疗作为一种变革性的药物范式，正在迅速崛起，能够在广泛的疾病中精确且可编程地调控基因表达。本文综述了抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers）等关键平台的最新进展，强调其独特的作用机制和治疗潜力。我们系统性地概述了化学修饰和递送工程的关键贡献，包括骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒，这些措施共同增强了稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性。最后，我们讨论了免疫激活、大规模生产和长期安全性等持续挑战，并展望了基于CRISPR的基因编辑、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法等未来方向，为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供战略见解。
items.l1_lead: 核酸治疗作为新兴药物范式，通过精确调控基因表达展现出广泛的治疗潜力，尽管仍面临免疫激活和长期安全性等挑战。
items.l2_summary:
核酸治疗作为一种新兴的药物开发模式，正在迅速发展，展现出在多种疾病中精确调控基因表达的潜力。本文综述了几种关键的核酸治疗平台，包括抗病毒寡核苷酸（antisense oligonucleotides）、小干扰RNA（siRNA）、微RNA（miRNA）、信使RNA（mRNA）和适配体（aptamers），并强调了它们各自独特的作用机制及其在临床治疗中的应用前景。研究表明，这些核酸药物能够通过特定的靶向机制，调节基因表达，从而为治疗各种疾病提供新的思路。

在核酸治疗的进展中，化学修饰和递送工程起到了至关重要的作用。通过对骨架和糖的修饰、特定位点的设计、N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）结合以及脂质纳米颗粒的应用，这些技术显著提高了核酸药物的稳定性、靶向特异性和临床适用性。这些改进使得核酸药物在体内的有效性和安全性得到了增强，为其临床应用奠定了基础。

然而，核酸治疗仍面临一些挑战，包括免疫激活、大规模生产的可行性和长期安全性等问题。这些挑战需要在未来的研究中得到解决，以确保核酸药物的广泛应用。此外，本文还展望了未来的发展方向，包括基于CRISPR的基因编辑技术、合成生物学、纳米技术、智能递送系统和组合疗法等，这些领域的进展将为核酸药物的开发和临床转化提供新的战略视角。

综上所述，核酸治疗作为一种具有革命性潜力的治疗手段，正在不断发展并克服现有的挑战，未来有望在多种疾病的治疗中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Inpatient hospital admissions for people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). A position statement by the international college of obsessive-compulsive spectrum disorders.
items.body: Background The hospitalization of patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is less common in comparison to other mental disorders, and often a significant and distressing event. Objectives This paper presents a position statement, developed by the International College of Obsessive-Compulsive Spectrum Disorders, on the indications for hospital admission for people with OCD, the treatment that is offered within hospital, the complications that may occur in this setting, and principles for best practice. Methods Current literature was critically reviewed and narratively synthesized by a group of international experts in the field of OCD. Results An inpatient hospital admission may be required for people with severe OCD who are unable to accept or tolerate pharmacological or psychological treatment as an outpatient or where there would be significant risks to the individual or those around them. Admissions have been associated with significant reductions in OCD severity. Inpatient treatment often involves psychoeducation of staff, patients and family members, pharmacotherapy, exposure and response prevention psychological work, addressing comorbidity as well as psychosocial issues such as family-relational issues, homelessness, grief or loss. Admissions can be distressing, and intensive inpatient-based therapy programs require the comprehensive assessment of risk. Conclusions The inpatient treatment of people with OCD is an important management option that needs to be well considered and managed. Admissions often require close monitoring of risks, additional support to staff who may be unfamiliar with OCD, addressing comorbidity, pharmacotherapy and exposure and response prevention therapy.
items.authors: Brakoulias V, Albert U, Chamberlain SR, Dell'Osso B, Ferretti CJ, Girone N, Hollander E, Ioannidis K, Lochner C, Menchon JM, Mpavaenda D, Pallanti S, Pampaloni I, Pellegrini L, Stein DJ, Van Ameringen M, Zohar J, Fineber
items.title_zh: 强迫症患者住院治疗的必要性与原则
items.summary_zh: 本文由国际强迫症谱系障碍学院提出，探讨了强迫症（OCD）患者住院治疗的适应症、医院内提供的治疗、可能出现的并发症及最佳实践原则。研究表明，与其他精神障碍相比，强迫症患者住院的情况较少，但对于无法接受或耐受门诊药物或心理治疗的重症患者，住院治疗可能是必要的。住院治疗通常能显著减轻强迫症的严重程度，涉及对患者、家属及医护人员的心理教育、药物治疗、暴露与反应预防等心理工作，以及处理共病和社会心理问题。尽管住院治疗可能带来痛苦，但密集的住院治疗方案需要全面的风险评估。
items.l1_lead: 强迫症患者在无法接受门诊治疗时，住院治疗可显著减轻症状，需综合考虑风险与最佳实践原则。
items.l2_summary:
强迫症（OCD）患者住院治疗的必要性与原则是国际强迫症谱系障碍学院提出的研究主题。该研究指出，尽管强迫症患者住院治疗的情况相对较少，但对于那些无法接受或耐受门诊药物或心理治疗的重症患者，住院治疗可能是必不可少的。住院治疗通常能够显著减轻强迫症的严重程度，涉及多个方面的综合干预，包括对患者及其家属的心理教育、药物治疗、暴露与反应预防（ERP）等心理治疗方法，以及对共病和社会心理问题的处理。

研究表明，住院治疗能够为重症强迫症患者提供密集的支持和干预，尽管这种治疗方式可能会给患者带来一定的痛苦。为了确保治疗的有效性，实施住院治疗前需要进行全面的风险评估，以便制定出最适合患者的个性化治疗方案。通过这种方式，医护人员能够更好地理解患者的需求，提供更为精准的治疗，从而提高治疗效果。

总的来说，住院治疗在强迫症患者的治疗中扮演着重要的角色，尤其是在面对重症患者时。通过综合的治疗措施，住院治疗不仅能够减轻症状，还能帮助患者及其家属更好地应对疾病带来的挑战。

items.title: Placebo and nocebo effects of pharmacotherapy for obsessive-compulsive related disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Objective This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to quantify the magnitude of placebo and nocebo effects in pharmacological trials for OCRDs and identify clinical and methodological moderators influencing these effects. Methods A comprehensive literature search was conducted across multiple databases and clinical trial registries up to May 2025. Randomised, placebo-controlled trials involving pharmacological interventions for OCRDs were included. The primary outcomes were placebo effect size and placebo response rate; secondary outcomes included nocebo response rate and side effect profile. Data were extracted independently and meta-analysed using random effects models. Meta-regression was performed to assess moderators of placebo response. Results Fifteen eligible trials ( N = 640; placebo N = 341) were included. The pooled placebo effect size was moderate (SMC = -0.63; 95% CI -0.77 to -0.48), with low heterogeneity ( I 2 = 4.73%). The placebo response rate was 21%, and the nocebo response rate was 18%. Despite testing a broad range of potential moderators, including clinical characteristics, methodological design, and medication class, no significant predictors of placebo effect size were identified. Side effects were reported in nearly one-third of placebo recipients, underscoring the relevance of nocebo effects. Conclusions Placebo and nocebo responses are noteworthy in trials for OCRDs and may influence perceived treatment efficacy. Variability in placebo responses is not well explained by currently measurable moderators. Further research is needed to explore neurobiological, psychological, and methodological contributors to expectancy effects in OCRD pharmacotherapy trials.
items.authors: Hoffman J, Williams T, Stein DJ.
items.title_zh: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗的安慰剂与反安慰剂效应研究
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在量化强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物试验中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并识别影响这些效应的临床和方法学调节因素。研究纳入了截至2025年5月的多数据库和临床试验注册的随机对照试验，共15项符合条件的试验（N = 640；安慰剂组N = 341）。结果显示，安慰剂效应大小为中等（SMC = -0.63；95% CI -0.77至-0.48），异质性低（I² = 4.73%），安慰剂反应率为21%，反安慰剂反应率为18%。尽管测试了多种潜在调节因素，但未发现显著的安慰剂效应预测因子。近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，强调了反安慰剂效应的重要性。结论是安慰剂和反安慰剂反应值得关注。
items.l1_lead: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗中，安慰剂效应显著，反安慰剂效应也不容忽视，且未发现明显的预测因子。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在系统评价和荟萃分析强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物治疗中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，量化其影响并识别相关的临床和方法学调节因素。研究纳入了截至2025年5月的多数据库和临床试验注册的随机对照试验，共15项符合条件的试验，样本总量为640人，其中安慰剂组有341人。结果显示，安慰剂效应的效应大小为中等，标准化均差（SMC）为-0.63，95%置信区间为-0.77至-0.48，且异质性较低（I² = 4.73%）。在安慰剂组中，安慰剂反应率为21%，而反安慰剂反应率则为18%。尽管研究测试了多种潜在的调节因素，但未能发现显著的安慰剂效应预测因子，这表明影响安慰剂效应的因素可能较为复杂。此外，近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，突显了反安慰剂效应的重要性。综上所述，安慰剂和反安慰剂反应在强迫症相关障碍的药物治疗中值得关注，提示临床实践中应重视这些效应对患者治疗体验和结果的影响。

items.title: Towards intelligent and miniaturized drug delivery devices.
items.body: Advances at the intersection of biotechnology, artificial intelligence, electronics and materials science are reshaping how drugs can be delivered inside the body. Intelligent and miniaturized drug delivery devices (IMDDDs) leverage these technologies to achieve precise pharmacokinetics, targeted distribution and programmable release while minimizing toxicity and improving patient adherence. Unlike conventional approaches, IMDDDs can incorporate real-time sensing and adaptive control, enabling drug administration that is more precise and more responsive to dynamic physiological conditions. In this Review, we outline key categories and design principles, highlight artificial intelligence technologies for augmenting performance, discuss potential clinical applications across cancer, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, vaccination and beyond, and examine translation challenges and opportunities. By uniting engineering innovation with medical need, IMDDDs exemplify the next generation of drug delivery technologies.
items.authors: Wei X, Buse JB, Chen H, Desai TA, Stevens MM, Traverso G, Langer R, Gu Z.
items.title_zh: 智能化微型药物递送装置的未来发展
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了智能化微型药物递送装置（IMDDDs）的发展，探讨了生物技术、人工智能、电子学和材料科学交叉领域的进展如何重塑药物在体内的递送方式。IMDDDs利用这些技术实现精准的药代动力学、靶向分布和可编程释放，同时降低毒性并提高患者依从性。与传统方法不同，IMDDDs能够实时感知和自适应控制，使药物给药更加精准，能够更好地响应动态生理条件。文章还概述了IMDDDs的关键类别和设计原则，强调了人工智能技术在提升性能方面的应用，讨论了其在癌症、糖尿病、心血管疾病、疫苗接种等领域的潜在临床应用，并分析了转化过程中的挑战与机遇。IMDDDs代表了下一代药物递送技术的典范。
items.l1_lead: 智能化微型药物递送装置通过结合生物技术和人工智能，实现精准药物递送，提升患者依从性，展现出在多种疾病治疗中的广泛应用潜力。
items.l2_summary:
智能化微型药物递送装置（IMDDDs）作为药物递送技术的前沿，正在通过生物技术、人工智能（AI）、电子学和材料科学的交叉进展，重塑药物在体内的递送方式。IMDDDs的设计旨在实现精准的药代动力学、靶向分布和可编程释放，这不仅降低了药物的毒性，还提高了患者的依从性。与传统的药物递送方法相比，IMDDDs具备实时感知和自适应控制的能力，使得药物给药更加精准，能够更好地响应动态的生理条件。

文章详细概述了IMDDDs的关键类别和设计原则，强调了人工智能技术在提升其性能方面的应用。通过智能算法，IMDDDs能够根据患者的具体需求和生理状态，调整药物释放的速率和剂量，从而实现个性化治疗。这种技术在癌症、糖尿病、心血管疾病和疫苗接种等领域展现出巨大的潜在临床应用价值。

然而，IMDDDs的转化过程也面临诸多挑战与机遇。尽管技术进步为IMDDDs的开发提供了新的可能性，但在实际应用中，如何确保设备的安全性、有效性以及与现有医疗体系的兼容性仍需深入研究和解决。总体而言，IMDDDs代表了下一代药物递送技术的典范，预示着未来医疗领域将更加依赖于智能化和个性化的治疗方案。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老的标志：剪接稳态的丧失
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄增长，剪接的准确性下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，进而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，加速组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率增加，导致共转录剪接受损，产生错误剪接的异构体，进一步加重衰老和病理状态。此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接，与动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等衰老相关疾病相关。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等，可能恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 随着年龄增长，替代剪接的准确性下降导致RNA稳态受损，进而加速衰老及相关疾病的发生。
items.l2_summary:
文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性逐渐下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，这一变化对线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能产生了负面影响，从而加速了组织和器官的功能衰退。研究显示，在衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平发生变化，RNA聚合酶II的延伸速率增加，这些因素共同导致了共转录剪接受损，产生了错误剪接的异构体，进一步加重了衰老和病理状态。

此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接现象，这与多种衰老相关疾病密切相关，包括动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症，以及阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰和CRISPR-Cas系统等，可能有助于恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡。然而，这些策略在实际应用中仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。因此，理解替代剪接在衰老过程中的作用及其机制，对于开发有效的衰老干预措施具有重要意义。

items.title: Reprogramming Porosity: The Synthetic Evolution of Pore Engineering in Metal-Organic Frameworks.
items.body: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) provide an exceptional platform for pore engineering due to their modularity, crystallinity, and diverse synthetic routes. Traditionally, porosity was controlled by linker length and metal node selection, but recent advances enable active reprogramming of pore environments through synthetic and postsynthetic modifications. This review highlights strategies to tune pore size, geometry, surface chemistry, and flexibility, including linker exchange and insertion, defect engineering, cluster metalation, and covalent or coordinative postsynthetic modifications. It also discusses the growth of functional species within existing pores. Emphasis is placed on mechanistic design rules that define how far such transformations can proceed while preserving long-range order. By unifying these approaches under synthetic pore reprogramming, the review outlines a framework for systematically modifying MOFs beyond their original structures. This enables access to properties and functions unattainable in pristine materials and lays the foundation for designing programmable porous materials with tailored performance.
items.authors: Mondal A, Festus K, Muangsopa P, Mandal S, Ghosh A, Sarkar A, Wang Q, Zhou HC.
items.title_zh: 金属有机框架的孔隙工程合成演变
items.summary_zh: 金属有机框架（MOFs）因其模块化、晶体结构和多样的合成路线，成为孔隙工程的优越平台。传统上，孔隙度通过连接体长度和金属节点选择进行控制，但近年来的进展使得通过合成和后合成修饰主动重新编程孔隙环境成为可能。本文回顾了调节孔径、几何形状、表面化学和灵活性的策略，包括连接体交换与插入、缺陷工程、簇金属化以及共价或配位后合成修饰。同时，讨论了在现有孔隙内生长功能物种的过程。重点强调了在保持长程有序的情况下，这些转变可以进行的机制设计规则。通过将这些方法统一为合成孔隙重新编程，本文为系统性地修改MOFs超越其原始结构提供了框架。这使得获取在原始材料中无法实现的特性和功能成为可能，并为设计具有定制性能的可编程多孔材料奠定了基础。
items.l1_lead: 金属有机框架的孔隙工程通过合成和后合成修饰实现了孔隙环境的主动重编程，为设计具有定制性能的多孔材料提供了新的框架和可能性。
items.l2_summary:
金属有机框架（MOFs）因其模块化特性、独特的晶体结构和多样的合成路线，成为孔隙工程领域的重要平台。传统上，MOFs的孔隙度主要通过选择连接体长度和金属节点来进行控制。然而，近年来的研究进展表明，通过合成和后合成修饰，可以主动重新编程孔隙环境，从而实现更为灵活的孔隙工程。本文回顾了多种调节孔径、几何形状、表面化学和灵活性的策略，包括连接体交换与插入、缺陷工程、簇金属化以及共价或配位后合成修饰等方法。

在这些策略中，连接体的交换与插入能够有效改变框架的孔隙结构，而缺陷工程则通过引入缺陷来调节材料的性能。此外，簇金属化技术使得在框架中引入金属簇成为可能，从而改变其催化和吸附特性。共价或配位后合成修饰则为在已有框架上进一步修饰提供了灵活性。这些方法的结合，不仅可以在保持长程有序的情况下实现孔隙环境的调节，还为在现有孔隙内生长功能物种提供了新的思路。

本文强调了这些转变的机制设计规则，提出了一种将这些方法统一为合成孔隙重新编程的框架。这一框架为系统性地修改MOFs超越其原始结构提供了理论基础，使得研究人员能够获取在原始材料中无法实现的特性和功能。这为设计具有定制性能的可编程多孔材料奠定了基础，推动了MOFs在催化、气体存储和分离等领域的应用潜力。因此，MOFs的孔隙工程不仅是材料科学的前沿研究方向，也为未来的多功能材料设计提供了新的视角和可能性。

items.title: Impact of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors on Quality of Life and Patient-Reported Outcomes in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.body: Background Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors improve glycemic and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). However, their impact on quality of life (QoL) and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) has not been systematically evaluated. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to assess the effect of SGLT2 inhibitors on QoL in patients with T2DM. Methods MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Cochrane and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched until 18 August 2025 for randomised controlled trials and post hoc analyses of SGLT2 inhibitors reporting validated QoL or PRO outcomes in adults with T2DM. A random-effects model was used to estimate mean differences (MD) or odds ratios (OR) with 95% CIs. Subgroup analyses compared SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo and active comparators. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool. Results Ten studies including 5294 patients (SGLT2i: 2807; control: 2487) were included. SGLT2 inhibitors significantly improved: EQ-5D Index score versus placebo (MD: 0.04, p = 0.008), DTR-QoL against active comparators (MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006), DTSQ compared to active comparators (MD: 0.54; p = 0.006) and IWQoL (MD: 1.44; p = 0.005) versus placebo. Improvements were also observed in SHIELD WQ-9 overall QoL (OR: 2.11; p = 0.005), emotional health (OR: 2.16; p = 0.006), self-esteem (OR: 2.26; p = 0.006) and work performance (OR: 1.99; p = 0.04) compared with placebo. Conclusion Randomised evidence suggests SGLT2 inhibitors enhance EQ-5D Index score, diabetes-specific QoL and several PROs in T2DM, particularly in physical, emotional and treatment satisfaction domains, supporting their earlier use in this population.
items.authors: Ahmed M, Shaikh N, Ibrahim S, Shafiq SB, Atta S, Naveed MA, Shafqat S, Sattar N, Basit A.
items.title_zh: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2抑制剂对2型糖尿病患者生活质量的影响
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在评估钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）及患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。通过检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了10项随机对照试验，涉及5294名患者（SGLT2i组：2807；对照组：2487）。结果显示，SGLT2抑制剂显著改善了EQ-5D指数分数（MD: 0.04, p = 0.008）、DTR-QoL（MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006）、DTSQ（MD: 0.54; p = 0.006）和IWQoL（MD: 1.44; p = 0.005）。此外，在SHIELD WQ-9整体QoL、情感健康、自尊和工作表现方面也观察到了显著改善。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂不仅有助于改善血糖和心血管结果，还能显著提升患者的生活质量。
items.l1_lead: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2抑制剂显著改善2型糖尿病患者的生活质量和患者报告结果，提升了多项健康相关指标。
items.l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在评估钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）及患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。研究通过检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了10项随机对照试验，共涉及5294名患者，其中SGLT2抑制剂组有2807名患者，对照组有2487名患者。结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂显著改善了多项生活质量指标，包括EQ-5D指数分数（MD: 0.04, p = 0.008）、DTR-QoL（MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006）、DTSQ（MD: 0.54; p = 0.006）和IWQoL（MD: 1.44; p = 0.005）。此外，在SHIELD WQ-9整体生活质量、情感健康、自尊和工作表现方面也观察到了显著改善。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂不仅有助于改善血糖控制和心血管结果，还能显著提升患者的生活质量，强调了其在2型糖尿病管理中的重要性。

items.title: Designing Next-Generation Cardiometabolic Outcome Trials for Obesity Medicines.
items.body: The prevalence of obesity has reached pandemic proportions and is having enormous public health effects. Obesity increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and cardiovascular (CV) disease including coronary artery disease, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and stroke. Although initial randomized clinical trials of weight-loss strategies through diet and exercise or early medical therapies did not lead to improved CV outcomes, more recent trials using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists in individuals with obesity have demonstrated CV benefits. At present, there are multiple cardiovascular outcome trials (CVOTs) of novel GLP-1 receptor agonists and investigational products targeting multiple hormonal pathways planned or underway. However, the optimal design features of CVOTs testing novel obesity medications may need to evolve. In this commentary, we discuss regulatory aspects and study design considerations of CVOTs for obesity medications in the context of previous and ongoing clinical trials and the future of CVOTs targeting obesity. We also propose 5 principles to help guide next-generation cardio-kidney-metabolic outcome trials.
items.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
items.authors: Platz E, Peikert A, Bozkurt B, Van der Schueren B, Butler J, Lingvay I, McGuire DK, Zannad F, Sattar N.
items.title_zh: 设计下一代肥胖药物心血管代谢结果试验
items.summary_zh: 肥胖的流行已达到大流行程度，对公共健康产生了巨大影响。肥胖增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病及心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤和中风）的风险。尽管早期的减重策略随机临床试验未能改善心血管结果，但近期使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的试验显示出心血管益处。目前，针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂和多种激素通路的研究正在进行中。然而，测试新型肥胖药物的心血管结果试验（CVOTs）设计可能需要演变。本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面和研究设计考虑，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的设计。
items.l1_lead: 肥胖药物的心血管结果试验设计需演变，提出五项原则以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的研究。
items.l2_summary:
肥胖已成为全球范围内的重大公共健康问题，其流行程度达到大流行的水平，显著增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病及心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、房颤和中风）的风险。尽管早期的减重策略随机临床试验未能显示出对心血管结果的改善，但近期的研究表明，使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的治疗在心血管方面具有潜在益处。目前，针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂及多种激素通路的研究正在积极进行中，然而，测试这些新型肥胖药物的心血管结果试验（CVOTs）设计亟需演变。

在此背景下，本文探讨了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面及研究设计的考虑因素，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的设计。这些原则旨在确保试验的科学性和有效性，进而为肥胖药物的开发提供更为可靠的心血管安全性数据。通过对现有研究的分析，本文强调了在设计新一代肥胖药物的心血管结果试验时，必须综合考虑药物的作用机制、患者的基线特征以及心血管事件的定义等关键因素，以确保试验结果的准确性和临床相关性。

总之，随着肥胖问题的加剧，开发有效的肥胖药物并评估其心血管安全性显得尤为重要。通过优化CVOTs的设计，未来的研究有望为肥胖患者提供更安全、更有效的治疗选择，从而改善其整体健康状况。

items.title: Preparation of an activatable benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe for multispectral optoacoustic and NIR-II fluorescence dual-mode imaging of liver injury.
items.body: Light-excited dual-mode imaging that integrates multispectral optoacoustic tomography (MSOT) and near-infrared region II fluorescence (NIR-II FL) imaging allows complementary deep-tissue visualization with high anatomical resolution and molecular sensitivity, thereby enhancing the accuracy of biomedical diagnostics. Activatable probes further advance this approach by producing signals upon recognition of disease-related biomarkers, which reduces background interference and improves imaging specificity. BTPE-NO 2 @F127, a benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe, exhibits selective activation of both optoacoustic and NIR-II FL signals in response to hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), a crucial early stage biomarker of liver injury, thus permitting cross-validated detection of hepatic damage in vivo with excellent signal-to-background ratio contrast. Here we present detailed procedures for preparation of the BTPE-NO 2 @F127 nanoprobe and its applications in MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of trazodone- or ischemia-reperfusion-induced liver injury in mice. Compared to conventional liver injury diagnostic methods, such as invasive tissue biopsy, ex vivo blood analysis and previously reported fluorescent/optoacoustic probes, BTPE-NO 2 @F127 offers real-time, in situ monitoring with high sensitivity and signal-to-background ratio, as well as mutually corroborating signals for increased reliability. The fabrication of BTPE-NO 2 @F127, including the chemical synthesis and characterization, requires ~17 d, while the in vitro validation of its H 2 O 2 responsiveness takes ~5 d. Notably, the complete workflow of data acquisition and analysis for MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of liver injury in mice using BTPE-NO 2 @F127 can be accomplished within 10 h. The protocol is easy to follow and suitable for clinicians and researchers with a basic understanding of chemistry and bioimaging techniques.
items.authors: Wu Y, Zhang C, Chen J, Zeng F, Wu S, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
items.title_zh: 基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针用于肝损伤双模成像
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127，能够在氢 peroxide (H 2 O 2)的作用下选择性激活光声和近红外区域II荧光(NIR-II FL)信号。这种探针用于多光谱光声断层成像(MSOT)和NIR-II FL双模成像，能够高效检测小鼠肝损伤，提供优良的信噪比和背景对比度。与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，BTPE-NO 2 @F127实现了实时、原位监测，具有高灵敏度和可靠性。文章详细描述了BTPE-NO 2 @F127的制备过程及其在 trazodone 或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤成像中的应用。
items.l1_lead: 基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127能在肝损伤检测中实现高灵敏度的双模成像，提供实时、原位监测的优越性能。
items.l2_summary:
本文介绍了一种新型的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO2@F127，该探针基于苯并噻二唑，能够在氢 peroxide (H2O2)的作用下选择性激活光声和近红外区域II荧光（NIR-II FL）信号。BTPE-NO2@F127被应用于多光谱光声断层成像（MSOT）和NIR-II FL双模成像，展现出在小鼠肝损伤检测中的高效性，提供了优良的信噪比和背景对比度。与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，该探针实现了实时、原位监测，具有高灵敏度和可靠性，显著提高了肝损伤的检测能力。

文章详细描述了BTPE-NO2@F127的制备过程，并探讨了其在使用抗抑郁药物trazodone或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤成像中的应用。研究表明，该探针在检测肝损伤方面具有明显优势，能够有效捕捉到病理变化，提供更为准确的成像结果。这一创新的纳米探针为肝损伤的早期诊断和监测提供了新的可能性，推动了生物医学成像技术的发展。通过该研究，BTPE-NO2@F127展示了其在临床应用中的潜力，尤其是在肝脏疾病的早期识别和治疗监测方面，具有重要的应用前景。

items.title: Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health.
items.body: The worldwide rise of neurological and psychiatric conditions poses major challenges. However, current global research remains fragmented, dominated by limited cohorts and poorly integrated datasets that disconnect whole-body health, exposome, and brain health. Theories rarely unify brain measures with extracerebral factors or capture heterogeneity in individual trajectories. We introduce multimodal diversity, a non-linear, non-simplistic causal and ecological construct integrating data representation, whole-body and exposomic factors, and computational modeling to address this situated, embedded, and embodied complexity. This heuristic metamodel integrates global, multilevel data into personalized predictions fostering population inclusion, multimodal integration, diagnostic precision, and equitable, context-sensitive advances in brain health.
items.authors: Ibáñez A, Duran-Aniotz C, Migeot J, Báez S, Fittipaldi S, Coronel-Oliveros C, Eyre HA, Udeh-Momoh C, Zetterberg H, Alladi S, Sandi C, Robertson IH, Franzen S, Farombi T, Montalvo Ortiz JL, Seshadri S, Court F, Valdes-Sos
