items.title_zh: Yoshua Bengio谈人工智能的潜在威胁与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了人工智能（AI）在做出恶意行为时所需的三个关键要素：意图、能力和环境。Yoshua Bengio指出，AI的目标、智能水平以及所处环境是决定其行为的核心因素。只有当这三者结合时，AI才可能实施不良行为。因此，确保AI的安全性需要关注这些方面，以防止潜在的灾难性后果。Bengio的观点强调了在开发和应用AI技术时，必须考虑其可能带来的风险和伦理问题。
items.l1_lead: Yoshua Bengio指出，人工智能的恶意行为依赖于意图、能力和环境三要素，因此确保AI安全性需关注这些因素以防止潜在风险。
items.l2_summary:
Yoshua Bengio在其讨论中深入探讨了人工智能（AI）可能带来的潜在威胁与安全性问题。他指出，AI在实施恶意行为时，必须具备三个关键要素：意图、能力和环境。具体而言，AI的目标、智能水平以及所处的环境共同决定了其行为的性质和方向。只有当这三者结合时，AI才有可能表现出不良行为。因此，确保AI的安全性就必须关注这三个方面，以有效防范可能导致的灾难性后果。

Bengio的观点强调，在开发和应用AI技术的过程中，必须充分考虑其可能带来的风险和伦理问题。随着AI技术的迅速发展，其应用范围不断扩大，潜在的威胁也随之增加。因此，研究者和开发者在设计AI系统时，需对其意图进行明确设定，确保其目标符合人类的伦理标准。同时，提升AI的智能水平也意味着要对其能力进行严格控制，以防止其在特定环境中产生不可预知的行为。

总之，Bengio的论述提醒我们，人工智能的安全性不仅仅是技术问题，更是伦理和社会责任的问题。在未来的AI发展中，如何平衡技术进步与安全性、伦理性之间的关系，将是一个亟待解决的重要课题。

items.title: Oxygenaging: A Physiological Framework for Geroscience.
items.body: The stepwise movement of oxygen from the atmosphere to the mitochondria, the "oxygen cascade", is one of the most tightly regulated systems in physiology. Despite decades of mechanistic study, it has remained quite unexplored in Geroscience. This oversight should be reconsidered. In young organisms, hypoxic stress (whether environmental or tissue-specific) activates a complex adaptive response to preserve energetic stability via restraining anabolic pathways, optimizing mitochondrial performance, and reinforcing cellular quality control systems. With advancing age, angiostatic signaling increases, endothelial metabolism becomes dysregulated, and overall alveolar ventilation and pulmonary gas exchange (ventilation-perfusion matching and diffusion capacity) become less efficient. These changes promote microvascular rarefaction and low-grade but persistent mismatches between oxygen delivery and demand at the tissue level, ultimately destabilizing cellular function. In this review, we propose that the gradual erosion of oxygen homeostasis is not simply a byproduct of aging, but also a driver of molecular damage and functional decline. We examine the aging oxygen cascade through the framework of resilience biology, focusing on mechanisms such as mitochondrial electron leaks, oxidative stress amplification, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and epigenetic remodeling. We also discuss interventions that alter oxygen availability, such as intermittent hypoxia, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and hypoxic-hyperoxic training. These approaches demonstrate adaptive potential, but they also highlight the narrow margin between beneficial stress and injury. We propose "Oxygenaging" as a unifying framework in which aging associates with the progressive loss of equilibrium across the oxygen cascade, linking systemic oxygen transport to mitochondrial function, genomic stability, and cellular resilience.
items.authors: Donega S, Fishbein KW, Dominelli P, Herman AB, de Cabo R, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 氧气老化：衰老科学的生理框架
items.summary_zh: 氧气从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”，是生理学中调控最严格的系统之一。然而，在衰老科学（Geroscience）领域，这一机制仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下会激活复杂的适应性反应，以通过抑制合成代谢途径、优化线粒体性能和增强细胞质量控制系统来维持能量稳定。随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号增加，内皮代谢失调，肺泡通气和气体交换效率下降。这些变化导致微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供需不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。本文提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。我们通过韧性生物学的框架审视衰老氧气级联，重点关注线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。
items.l1_lead: 氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是导致分子损伤和功能衰退的重要驱动因素。
items.l2_summary:
氧气的逐步转移过程，即“氧气级联”，在生理学中是一个调控极为严格的系统，但在衰老科学（Geroscience）领域，这一机制尚未得到充分的研究。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下能够激活复杂的适应性反应，通过抑制合成代谢途径、优化线粒体性能以及增强细胞质量控制系统来维持能量的稳定。然而，随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号的增加、内皮代谢的失调、肺泡通气和气体交换效率的下降，导致微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供需的不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。本文提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，更是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。

在这一背景下，研究者通过韧性生物学的框架审视衰老氧气级联，重点关注了多个机制，包括线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等。这些机制在衰老过程中扮演了重要角色，影响着细胞的功能和生理状态。氧气的稳态失衡可能导致细胞内环境的恶化，从而加速衰老过程。因此，理解氧气级联在衰老中的作用，能够为衰老相关疾病的预防和治疗提供新的思路和方向。通过深入探讨氧气在衰老过程中的生理角色，研究者希望能够揭示出更多关于衰老机制的细节，为未来的研究和临床应用奠定基础。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.

items.title_zh: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本文系统评估了初级情感障碍（affective psychotic disorders）患者在早期干预服务（EIS）中的相对流行率。研究纳入了83项观察性研究，涉及30,946名首次发作精神病（FEP）患者，结果显示情感障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），其中情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%。精神分裂症（schizophrenia）是最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。研究还评估了城市化程度、国家收入水平和地理区域等潜在调节因素。该研究强调了情感性精神病在EIS中的重要性，呼吁更多关注这一领域。
items.l1_lead: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例为18.0%，强调了情感性精神病的重要性及其在精神卫生服务中的关注需求。
items.l2_summary: 本文对初级情感障碍（affective psychotic disorders）患者在早期干预服务（EIS）中的相对流行率进行了系统评估与荟萃分析，纳入了83项观察性研究，涉及30,946名首次发作精神病（FEP）患者。研究结果显示，情感障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），其中情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%。在所有诊断中，精神分裂症（schizophrenia）是最常见的，合并比例高达45.5%。此外，研究还探讨了城市化程度、国家收入水平和地理区域等潜在调节因素对结果的影响。这些数据表明，情感性精神病在早期干预服务中占有重要地位，提示我们在精神卫生领域应更加关注这一群体。研究强调了对初级情感障碍患者的早期识别和干预的重要性，以改善其预后和生活质量。

items.title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
items.authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
items.title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过系统评价与荟萃分析，探讨大麻使用对暴力风险的影响。研究依据PRISMA指南，综合了63项经过同行评审的研究（N = 265,079），数据来源于MEDLINE、EMBASE和PsycINFO，截止至2024年11月。结果显示，大麻使用者在实施暴力行为方面的风险显著增加，精神病患者（OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61）和普通人群（OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41）均有此趋势。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一关联均显著。涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中效果尤为明显。此外，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险也显著增加（OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性及混合性别群体的风险更高。此荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加存在显著关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，大麻使用显著增加暴力行为的风险，尤其在精神病患者和女性中更为明显。
items.l2_summary: 本研究通过系统评价与荟萃分析，探讨了大麻使用与暴力风险之间的关系，依据PRISMA指南，综合了63项经过同行评审的研究，样本量达到265,079，数据来源于MEDLINE、EMBASE和PsycINFO，截止至2024年11月。研究结果表明，大麻使用者实施暴力行为的风险显著增加，其中精神病患者的风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的风险比值为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。这一关联在纵向研究中同样显著，风险比值为1.17（95% CI 1.07-1.28），而在横断面研究中则更为明显，风险比值为2.37（95% CI 1.66-3.40）。特别是在涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为中，普通人群的风险比值高达3.75（95% CI 2.54-5.53），而精神病患者的风险比值为4.21（95% CI 2.86-6.22），显示出大麻使用与暴力行为之间的强关联。此外，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险也显著增加，风险比值为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性及混合性别群体的风险更高。综上所述，此荟萃分析清晰地表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加之间存在显著的关联，提示在公共卫生和政策制定中需重视大麻使用的潜在风险。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老的标志：剪接稳态的丧失
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄增长，剪接的准确性下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，进而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，加速组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率增加，导致共转录剪接受损，产生错误剪接的异构体，进一步加重衰老和病理状态。此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接，与动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等衰老相关疾病相关。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等，可能恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 随着年龄增长，替代剪接的准确性下降导致RNA稳态受损，进而加速衰老及相关疾病的发生。
items.l2_summary:
文章探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性逐渐下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，这一变化对线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能产生了负面影响，从而加速了组织和器官的功能衰退。研究显示，在衰老细胞、老化组织及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平发生变化，RNA聚合酶II的延伸速率增加，这些因素共同导致了共转录剪接受损，产生了错误剪接的异构体，进一步加重了衰老和病理状态。

此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也加剧了异常剪接现象，这与多种衰老相关疾病密切相关，包括动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症，以及阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰和CRISPR-Cas系统等，可能有助于恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡。然而，这些策略在实际应用中仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。因此，理解替代剪接在衰老过程中的作用及其机制，对于开发有效的衰老干预措施具有重要意义。

items.title: Ferroptotic propagation: from single-cell execution to tissue-scale death programs.
items.body: Ferroptosis has long been regarded as a cell-autonomous form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation. Recent work, however, suggests that ferroptotic commitment can extend beyond the initiating cell, spreading to neighboring cells and, in some contexts, across tissue-scale distances. Multiple, non-mutually exclusive modes of contagion have now been described, including reactive oxygen species-triggered death waves, direct membrane contact-dependent transfer, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. These findings redefine ferroptosis from a single-cell execution pathway into a spatially coordinated, multicellular process. In this perspective, we integrate mechanistic insights with experimental evidence on ferroptotic contagion and propose a unifying, multiscale framework in which distinct modes of transmission operate over different spatial scales, from short-range membrane transfer to longer-range oxidative and extracellular relay mechanisms. We discuss how nonlinear redox amplification, membrane biophysics, and tissue architecture together determine the dynamics, limits, and patterning of ferroptotic injury in vivo. This emerging framework has important implications for developmental tissue remodeling, the progression of organ injury, and ferroptosis-based cancer therapy. More broadly, defining how ferroptotic contagion is initiated, constrained, and manipulated therapeutically may help establish ferroptosis as a fundamental organizing principle for understanding tissue-level regulation and pathological escalation.
items.authors: Tang D, Kang R, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡传播：从单细胞执行到组织规模死亡程序
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（Ferroptosis）被视为一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期研究表明，铁死亡的承诺不仅限于启动细胞，还可以传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织尺度。研究描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括反应性氧种引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程。文章整合了铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度下的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。讨论了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡不仅是单细胞的死亡机制，还能在组织间传播，涉及多种传播模式，重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，对组织重塑和癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（Ferroptosis）是一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式，近年来的研究揭示了其传播特性，超越了单细胞的死亡机制，能够影响邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织尺度。研究者们描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括反应性氧种（reactive oxygen species, ROS）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，强调了其在组织内的复杂性和动态性。

文章整合了铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，涵盖了不同空间尺度下的传播模式，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。研究表明，非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构共同决定了体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架不仅为理解发育组织重塑和器官损伤进展提供了新的视角，还对基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。

通过对铁死亡传播机制的深入探讨，研究为未来的生物医学研究和临床应用提供了新的思路，强调了在治疗策略中考虑细胞间相互作用和组织环境的重要性。这些发现为我们理解细胞死亡的复杂性以及其在生理和病理状态下的角色提供了重要的理论基础。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 与衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积的组织损伤的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化。通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，我们阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。我们的研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这些损伤并不容易通过不足的韧性机制预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。
items.l1_lead: 炎症在心血管疾病中扮演核心角色，其上游驱动因素为与衰老相关的分子损伤，理解这一机制为疾病的预防和治疗提供新机会。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和因果贡献者。随着组学技术的进步以及对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症的角色逐渐被重新审视，不再被视为孤立的病因，而是对累积的组织损伤所产生的多种生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在应对由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能出现失调，导致适应不良，从而促进病理变化的发生。

通过分析动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白质组学数据来支持这些概念模型。这些研究结果强调了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，而这些损伤往往难以通过不足的韧性机制进行有效的预防或修复。因此，理解这些反应的协调机制为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。

总之，本文的研究强调了衰老过程中分子损伤与心血管疾病相关炎症之间的复杂关系，提示我们在未来的研究和临床实践中，应更加关注如何调节和改善炎症反应，以降低心血管疾病的风险。

items.title: Immune aging biomarkers for clinical trials.
items.body: Aging profoundly remodels the immune system, impairing defense, repair and homeostatic function across tissues. Because the immune system operates in every organ, its deterioration has been proposed to drive or exacerbate systemic dysfunction and accelerate overall biological aging, making it an attractive biomarker and target for geroscience-guided trials. Despite this central role, there is no consensus on how to quantify immune aging, especially in clinical trials. Here, we establish a translational framework to identify immune aging biomarkers for this purpose. We define five evaluation criteria for immune aging biomarkers and apply these to candidate biomarkers, discussing their utility in the context of a major international healthspan competition, XPRIZE Healthspan. Metrics encapsulating multidimensional aspects of immune function, inflammaging scores and functional assays performed best against our selection criteria. Finally, we identify promising emerging measures, together with critical gaps that must be addressed to develop reliable, predictive biomarkers of human immune competence. Our framework provides a coherent path toward actionable and clinically meaningful immune aging biomarkers capable of quantifying immune fitness and resilience, and accelerating the clinical translation of geroscience-guided interventions.
items.authors: Cipriano A, Justice J, Poganik JR, Moqri M, Abudayyeh OO, Gootenberg J, Haynes L, Levin Y, Martin-Herranz DE, Akbar AN, Mannick J, Pawelec G, Shen-Orr SS, Tsang J, Wagner W, Merad M, Gnjatic S, Gellhorn A, Corley MJ, Kuc

items.title_zh: 免疫衰老生物标志物在临床试验中的应用
items.summary_zh: 免疫系统在衰老过程中发生显著重塑，影响防御、修复和稳态功能，进而可能加速整体生物衰老。尽管免疫系统在每个器官中发挥作用，其衰退被认为是系统性功能障碍的驱动因素，但目前尚无统一的免疫衰老量化标准，尤其是在临床试验中。本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，定义了五项评估标准，并将其应用于候选标志物，探讨其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能检测在评估标准中表现最佳。最后，本文识别出有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出开发可靠预测人类免疫能力的生物标志物所需解决的关键问题。该框架为量化免疫适应性和韧性、加速衰老科学指导干预的临床转化提供了清晰路径。
items.l1_lead: 本文建立了免疫衰老生物标志物的评估框架，强调多维指标在临床试验中的应用潜力，为加速衰老科学的干预提供了明确路径。
items.l2_summary:
免疫系统在衰老过程中经历显著的重塑，这种变化不仅影响机体的防御、修复和稳态功能，还可能加速整体生物衰老。尽管免疫系统在各个器官中发挥着重要作用，其衰退被认为是导致系统性功能障碍的主要因素，但目前尚缺乏统一的免疫衰老量化标准，尤其是在临床试验中。为了解决这一问题，本文建立了一个转化框架，旨在识别免疫衰老生物标志物，并定义了五项评估标准，以便于对候选标志物进行系统性分析。该框架的应用在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中得到了验证。

在评估标准中，多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能检测表现出最佳的效果，显示出它们在评估免疫衰老方面的潜力。通过这些指标，研究者能够更好地量化免疫适应性和韧性，从而为加速衰老科学的干预措施提供指导。此外，本文还识别出了一些有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出了在开发可靠预测人类免疫能力的生物标志物过程中需要解决的关键问题。这些问题的解决将为临床转化提供清晰的路径，推动免疫衰老研究的进一步发展。总之，该研究为免疫衰老的量化提供了新的视角，强调了在临床试验中应用生物标志物的重要性，为未来的研究和干预措施奠定了基础。

items.title: Translating ferroptosis into oncology: challenges, opportunities and future directions.
items.body: Ferroptosis is an oxidative, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that occurs when antioxidant and organelle-protective systems are compromised. Increasing evidence implicates ferroptosis as a process that can exert both tumour-suppressive and tumour-promoting effects depending on cellular context at multiple stages of cancer evolution (from tumour initiation to metastatic colonization), sparking substantial interest in therapeutically exploiting this mechanism of cell death. Yet, despite rapid preclinical progress, clinical translation of ferroptosis-based strategies remains nascent. In this Review, we examine the major barriers to translation, including pharmacological limitations, tumour-intrinsic heterogeneity, microenvironmental and immune constraints, and gaps in current preclinical modelling. We also highlight emerging opportunities such as new ferroptosis-inducing agents, biomarker-guided patient selection and rational combinations with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted agents or immunotherapies. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for integrating ferroptosis-based therapies into oncology practice. By defining key challenges and future directions, this Review aims to position ferroptosis as a viable therapeutic paradigm and to accelerate progress towards clinical application.
items.authors: Kang R, Liu J, Wang J, Kroemer G, Tang D.
items.title_zh: 将铁死亡转化为肿瘤学的挑战与机遇
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，发生在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时。越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段（从肿瘤启动到转移性殖民）中，可能发挥抑制肿瘤或促进肿瘤的作用，这引发了对这一细胞死亡机制的治疗性利用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。本文评述了转化过程中的主要障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫约束，以及当前临床前模型的不足。同时，我们强调了新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合等新兴机遇。最后，我们概述了将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图。通过明确关键挑战和未来方向，本文旨在将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，并加速其临床应用的进展。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡在癌症发展中可能既有抑制也有促进作用，尽管临床转化面临挑战，但新型诱导剂和组合疗法为其应用提供了机遇。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，通常在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时发生。近年来，越来越多的研究表明，铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段中可能发挥双重作用，既可以抑制肿瘤的发生，也可能促进肿瘤的转移。这一发现引发了对铁死亡机制在癌症治疗中潜在应用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的治疗策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。

在转化过程中，存在多个主要障碍。首先，药物的限制使得有效诱导铁死亡的治疗手段尚未成熟；其次，肿瘤的内在异质性使得不同患者对铁死亡的反应存在差异，增加了治疗的复杂性；此外，肿瘤微环境和免疫约束也对铁死亡的诱导产生影响，进一步限制了其临床应用。当前的临床前模型在模拟人类肿瘤的复杂性方面也存在不足，这使得研究结果的转化面临挑战。

尽管如此，研究者们也发现了一些新兴的机遇。例如，新型铁死亡诱导剂的开发、基于生物标志物的患者选择策略，以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合，都为铁死亡的临床应用提供了新的可能性。通过这些策略，研究者希望能够克服现有的障碍，推动基于铁死亡的疗法更快地融入肿瘤学实践中。

综上所述，本文旨在明确铁死亡在肿瘤学中的潜在价值，通过识别关键挑战和未来方向，推动其作为一种可行的治疗范式的临床应用进展。随着对铁死亡机制理解的深入，未来有望实现更有效的癌症治疗方案。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露（源于心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老与衰老的多个标志相交。GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的多种代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和更严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。
items.l1_lead: 慢性糖皮质激素信号通过多种机制加速衰老，并与多种年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
糖皮质激素（GCs）作为重要的内分泌因子，调节着压力反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理等多种生理过程。尽管急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续的GC暴露（如因心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗引起）却会引发与生物衰老相关的多重效应。长期的GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制以及促进细胞衰老等机制，与衰老的多个标志相互作用。研究表明，GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，能够放大与衰老表型相关的GC过量所引发的多种代谢和免疫后果。

在临床上，慢性GC水平升高与多种年龄相关疾病的早期和更严重表现密切相关，包括代谢综合征、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等。这些疾病的发生与GC信号的持续激活有着显著的关联，提示我们需要重视GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系。本文回顾了这一领域的研究进展，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露所带来的加速衰老后果的潜在策略。这些策略可能为改善与衰老相关的健康问题提供新的思路和方法。通过深入理解GC信号在衰老过程中的作用，我们或许能够开发出更有效的干预措施，以应对衰老相关疾病的挑战。

items.title: Immunobiological mechanisms of action of oncolytic peptides.
items.body: Oncolytic peptides (OLPs) constitute an emerging class of immunotherapeutics that combine direct cancer cell lysis with immune activation. Indeed, OLPs induce rapid immunogenic cell death by disrupting intracellular membranes, which culminates with the abundant release of malignant cell contents including immunostimulatory danger-associated molecular patterns. This results in the engagement of innate immune sensors that potently activate dendritic cells, leading to the cross-priming of tumor-specific T lymphocytes that mediate systemic anticancer immunity. Through such a dual mechanism, OLPs can remodel the tumor microenvironment and overcome resistance to therapy as promoted by intratumoral heterogeneity, hence representing optimal combinatorial partners for immune checkpoint inhibitors. Some OLPs have also shown remarkable clinical efficacy. For instance, LTX-315 (studied as VP-315 in basal cell carcinoma (BCC)) has recently been shown to enable complete and durable responses in patients with BCC, and emerging evidence points to a significant activity of LTX-315 in immunologically cold tumors. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical advances in OLP development, underscoring their potential as a versatile and powerful modality of cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Kepp O, Deng X, Xue E, Sveinbjørnsson B, Rekdal Ø, Galluzzi L, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽的免疫生物学作用机制
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，结合了直接癌细胞溶解与免疫激活的功能。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，导致恶性细胞内容物的丰富释放，包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式。这一过程激活了先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，进而促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，介导全身抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服由肿瘤内异质性引起的治疗抵抗，因此成为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想联合伙伴。一些OLPs显示出显著的临床疗效，例如LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315），最近显示能够在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全和持久的反应，且新证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也具有显著活性。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调其作为癌症免疫治疗的多功能强大手段的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤溶解肽通过诱导免疫原性细胞死亡和激活免疫系统，展现出作为癌症免疫治疗新型药物的巨大潜力。
items.l2_summary:
肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，具有直接溶解癌细胞与激活免疫系统的双重功能。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜，诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，导致恶性细胞内容物的释放，这些内容物包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式。这一过程能够激活先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，进而促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导全身抗癌免疫。通过这种机制，OLPs不仅能够直接攻击肿瘤细胞，还能重塑肿瘤微环境，克服由肿瘤内异质性引起的治疗抵抗，因此被视为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想联合治疗伙伴。

在临床研究中，一些OLPs展现出了显著的疗效。例如，LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）最近的研究显示其能够在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全和持久的反应。此外，新证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也具有显著的活性。这些发现强调了OLPs作为癌症免疫治疗的多功能强大手段的潜力。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，进一步支持了其在癌症治疗中的应用前景。通过结合直接的细胞溶解与免疫激活，OLPs为癌症患者提供了新的治疗选择，尤其是在面对传统治疗方法难以奏效的情况下。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中涉及的双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）及其相关酶催化反应。研究表明，进化通常导致酶选择性地促进特定异构体的形成，而不是众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象显示了动态对选择性的影响，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多种产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。PTSB的存在使得选择性不能完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的体系中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应中双模态过渡态的最新进展，以及酶如何控制这些反应中的选择性。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了生物合成中双模态过渡态的进展，强调了多重后过渡态分叉现象对产物选择性的影响，挑战了传统过渡态理论的解释。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了生物合成复杂天然分子过程中涉及的双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）及其相关酶催化反应的最新研究进展与面临的挑战。研究表明，酶的进化通常会选择性地促进特定异构体的形成，而非众多其他潜在分子，这一现象在生物合成中具有重要意义。近期的研究发现了多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，揭示了动态因素对选择性的影响。具体而言，单一的双模态过渡态可以生成多种产物，这一发现与传统的能量控制机制相悖，表明选择性不能仅仅通过过渡态理论来解释。

PTSB的存在使得研究者们面临新的挑战，尤其是在理解如何在包含分叉的体系中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性方面。计算化学家们正在积极开发新技术，以深入探讨这些复杂反应机制。通过对酶催化反应中双模态过渡态的研究，科学家们不仅能够更好地理解酶如何控制反应选择性，还可能为天然产物的合成提供新的思路和方法。

综上所述，双模态过渡态及其相关的PTSB现象为生物合成反应的选择性提供了新的视角，推动了对酶催化机制的深入理解，同时也提出了新的研究方向和挑战。

items.title: Hierarchical endpoints and win statistics for geromedicine trials.
items.body: Geroscience has advanced rapidly, yet its clinical translation remains limited. A central barrier is the lack of trial outcomes that capture the multidimensional effects of geroprotective interventions while meeting clinical and regulatory standards. Mortality is objective and regulatorily salient but often impractical. By contrast, surrogate measures of healthspan improve feasibility and may better reflect the quality of extended life, but they are generally considered soft endpoints that require further validation. Here, we propose hierarchical composite endpoints using time-to-worst-event analysis as a pragmatic and scientifically sound compromise. Participant pairs are compared using win statistics according to a prespecified clinical hierarchy, in which more severe and objective clinical events are prioritized, while health surrogates and biomarkers contribute information at lower tiers. When outcome selection, ordering and tie rules are clinically and mechanistically justified and agreed with regulators, this approach may improve geromedicine trial efficiency and allow overall treatment effects to be captured without compromising clinical priorities.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Kim Y, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 老年医学试验的分层终点与胜利统计
items.summary_zh: 老年科学（Geroscience）快速发展，但其临床转化仍受限。主要障碍在于缺乏能够捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时满足临床和监管标准。死亡率作为客观且具有监管意义的指标，往往不切实际。相比之下，健康寿命（healthspan）的替代性指标提高了可行性，可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。本文提出使用时间至最差事件分析的分层复合终点，作为务实且科学合理的折衷方案。根据预先设定的临床层级，比较参与者对，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法可能提高老年医学试验的效率，并在不妥协临床优先事项的情况下捕捉整体治疗效果。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种分层复合终点的方法，以提高老年医学试验的效率，兼顾临床优先事项与健康寿命的多维效果评估。
items.l2_summary:
老年科学（Geroscience）近年来发展迅速，但其临床转化面临诸多挑战，主要障碍在于缺乏能够全面捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时又能满足临床和监管标准。死亡率作为一个客观且具有监管意义的指标，往往在实际应用中显得不够切合。而健康寿命（healthspan）作为一种替代性指标，虽然能够更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。因此，本文提出了一种新的方法，即使用时间至最差事件分析的分层复合终点，作为一种务实且科学合理的折衷方案。

该方法的核心在于根据预先设定的临床层级，对参与者进行比较，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件。在这一框架下，健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供补充信息。这种分层设计不仅能够提高老年医学试验的效率，还能在不妥协临床优先事项的情况下，全面捕捉整体治疗效果。通过合理化结果选择、排序和平局规则，并与监管机构达成一致，该方法有望为老年医学试验提供更为有效的评估手段。

综上所述，本文提出的分层复合终点方法为老年医学试验提供了一种新的思路，旨在克服当前试验设计中的局限性，推动老年科学的临床转化进程。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）将单克隆抗体的靶向特性与小分子药物的细胞毒性结合在一起，近年来已成为现代精准肿瘤学的临床验证组成部分。目前已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤治疗，此外还有多个区域性批准的药物及数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中均显示出临床益处，包括在晚期临床试验中显著改善总体生存率。本文综述了从早期临床开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，如表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性和药物与抗体比率，讨论了这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，本文还讨论了晚期临床试验的结果及已批准药物，以界定未来的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合靶向特性与细胞毒性，已成为精准肿瘤学的重要组成部分，显示出显著的临床益处和生存率改善，未来发展潜力巨大。
items.l2_summary:
抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）是一种将单克隆抗体的靶向特性与小分子药物的细胞毒性相结合的创新治疗方式，近年来已成为现代精准肿瘤学的重要组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的批准用于癌症治疗，此外，还有多个区域性批准的药物以及数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在进行临床开发。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中均显示出显著的临床益处，尤其是在晚期临床试验中，ADCs显著改善了患者的总体生存率。

本文综述了ADCs从早期临床开发到当前临床应用的进展，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则。这些设计原则包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性以及药物与抗体的比率等，这些特征对ADCs的药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性均有重要影响。通过合理的设计，ADCs能够有效地靶向癌细胞，减少对正常细胞的损伤，从而提高治疗的安全性和有效性。

此外，本文还讨论了晚期临床试验的结果及已批准药物的应用情况，以界定未来ADCs的发展方向。随着对ADCs机制的深入理解和技术的不断进步，预计未来将会有更多的ADCs获得批准并应用于临床，为癌症患者提供更为精准和有效的治疗选择。总的来说，ADCs作为一种新兴的抗癌疗法，展现出良好的临床前景，值得在未来的研究和应用中进一步探索和发展。

items.title: Exploring Splicing-Energy Axis Associations to Diet and Longevity.
items.body: There is increasing evidence that nutrient composition, even without lowering total calorie intake, can shape lifespan through mechanisms independent of mitochondrial regulation. Brandon and colleagues recently reported that a low-protein, high-carbohydrate (LPHC) diet enriched with non-digestible cellulose, extends lifespan in mice by shifting the liver proteome through altered RNA splicing, a response different from the mitochondrial improvements typically seen with caloric restriction. The authors' findings support the "energy-splicing resilience axis," which proposes that changes in splicing help cells adapt to energetic and nutritional stress. We discuss how diet influences spliceosomal components such as SRSF1, linking nutrient sensing, AMPK signaling, and tissue-specific resilience pathways. We also consider the splicing paradox in aging, where beneficial isoforms increase despite a concomitant increase in splicing errors. Understanding how dietary and pharmacologic interventions modulate splicing may shed light on strategies to maintain homeostatic proteomes and support healthy longevity.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 探讨剪接-能量轴与饮食及寿命的关系
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，营养成分的变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事最近报道，低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食，结合不可消化的纤维素，能够通过改变RNA剪接，改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命。这一反应与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善不同。作者的研究支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为剪接的变化帮助细胞适应能量和营养压力。文章讨论了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，如SRSF1，连接营养感知、AMPK信号传导和组织特异性韧性通路。同时，文章还考虑了衰老中的剪接悖论，即有益的异构体尽管伴随剪接错误的增加而增加。理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，低蛋白高碳水化合物饮食通过改变RNA剪接，能延长小鼠寿命，支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”理论，揭示饮食对细胞适应能量和营养压力的重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，越来越多的研究表明，饮食中的营养成分变化，即使在不降低总热量摄入的情况下，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事的最新研究发现，低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食结合不可消化的纤维素，能够通过改变RNA剪接，进而改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命。这一发现与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善机制有所不同，提示我们在研究寿命延长的机制时，不能仅仅依赖于线粒体的功能改善。

该研究支持了“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为RNA剪接的变化有助于细胞适应能量和营养的压力。文章深入探讨了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，例如SRSF1，这一过程连接了营养感知、AMPK信号传导以及组织特异性韧性通路。此外，研究还考虑了衰老过程中的剪接悖论，即尽管剪接错误的发生率增加，但一些有益的异构体却随之增加。这一现象提示我们，剪接的变化可能在衰老过程中发挥复杂的作用。

理解饮食和药物干预如何调节RNA剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新的策略。这一研究不仅为我们提供了新的视角去理解饮食与寿命之间的关系，也为未来的营养干预和衰老研究开辟了新的方向。通过进一步探索剪接机制与饮食的相互作用，科学家们或许能够找到更有效的方式来促进健康老龄化。

items.title: Mitochondrial quality control in human ageing and longevity.
items.body: Mitochondria play central roles in cellular metabolism and in key processes such as inflammation, stress response, cell death and signalling. Mitochondrial quality control (MQC) mechanisms continuously monitor organelle integrity and function, and repair or eliminate damaged mitochondria to replace them with newly formed, healthy organelles. MQC is particularly important under metabolic or environmental stress conditions. Failure of MQC paves the way to chronic diseases, such as diabetes, metabolic syndromes and immunosenescence. This Review summarizes our current understanding of MQC biology in the context of healthy human longevity. We explore the regulation of MQC in physiological conditions and explain how the dysregulation of MQC in ageing negatively impacts systemic metabolism and immune function. We discuss emerging therapeutic strategies-such as NAD + , AMPK activators and caloric restriction-that maintain a robust MQC to improve metabolic resilience and illustrate how preclinical and clinical studies can leverage MQC as a potential gerotherapeutic target.
items.authors: Picca A, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 线粒体质量控制在人体衰老与长寿中的作用
items.summary_zh: 线粒体在细胞代谢及炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键过程中发挥核心作用。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，并修复或清除受损线粒体，以用新形成的健康线粒体替代。MQC在代谢或环境压力条件下尤为重要。MQC的失效可能导致糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老等慢性疾病。本文综述了MQC生物学在健康人类长寿中的当前理解，探讨了MQC在生理条件下的调控，并解释了衰老中MQC失调如何对全身代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。我们讨论了新兴的治疗策略，如NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制，这些策略有助于维持强健的MQC以改善代谢韧性，并说明了如何通过临床前和临床研究将MQC作为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体质量控制在衰老与长寿中起关键作用，其失效与多种慢性疾病相关，维持MQC可改善代谢韧性并成为抗衰老治疗的新靶点。
items.l2_summary:
线粒体在细胞的代谢、炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键生理过程中发挥着核心作用。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制通过持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，能够修复或清除受损的线粒体，并用新形成的健康线粒体进行替代。这一机制在代谢或环境压力条件下显得尤为重要，因为MQC的失效可能导致糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老等慢性疾病的发生。近年来的研究表明，MQC在健康人类长寿中的作用日益受到关注。本文综述了MQC生物学的最新理解，探讨了其在生理条件下的调控机制，并解释了衰老过程中MQC失调如何对全身代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。

具体而言，MQC的失调会导致线粒体功能下降，从而影响细胞的能量代谢和应激反应能力，进而加速衰老过程。研究表明，保持强健的MQC能够改善代谢韧性，延缓衰老相关疾病的发生。为此，本文讨论了一些新兴的治疗策略，包括NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制等，这些策略有助于维持线粒体的健康状态，进而改善整体代谢功能。此外，MQC作为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点，正在通过临床前和临床研究不断被验证和探索。

总之，线粒体质量控制在衰老与长寿中的作用不可忽视，维持MQC的正常功能不仅有助于延缓衰老进程，还可能为慢性疾病的预防和治疗提供新的思路。随着对MQC机制的深入研究，未来有望开发出更有效的抗衰老治疗方法，改善人类的健康寿命。

items.title: Trial Watch - bispecific T cell engagers and higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics.
items.body: Over the past decades, cancer immunotherapy has evolved into clinical practice, with bispecific T cell engagers (TCEs) and other higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics emerging as approaches for precision immune modulation. These engineered antibodies redirect immune effector cells toward tumor targets, thereby eliciting coordinated antitumor immune responses. While substantial clinical success has been achieved in hematologic malignancies, major challenges, such as limited activity in solid tumors, continue to constrain broader application. In this Trial Watch, we summarize recent preclinical advances in the design and optimization of TCEs and multispecific immune engager platforms together with available clinical trial data. We further examine key pharmacokinetic, safety, resistance, and manufacturing considerations in immune engager development. Collectively, these findings highlight the increasing versatility of immune cell-redirecting immunotherapies and their pivotal role in shaping the next generation of precision cancer therapy.
items.authors: Xue E, Deng X, Doffe F, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 双特异性T细胞引导剂与多特异性免疫治疗进展
items.summary_zh: 近年来，癌症免疫治疗逐渐应用于临床，双特异性T细胞引导剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法成为精准免疫调节的新途径。这些工程化抗体能够将免疫效应细胞引导至肿瘤靶点，从而激发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤中取得了显著的临床成功，但在实体肿瘤中的活性有限等主要挑战仍然制约着其更广泛的应用。本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫引导平台的设计与优化的最新前临床进展，以及现有的临床试验数据。同时，探讨了免疫引导剂开发中的关键药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产考虑。这些发现凸显了免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的日益多样性及其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的重要作用。
items.l1_lead: 双特异性T细胞引导剂和多特异性免疫治疗在癌症治疗中展现出新的潜力，但在实体肿瘤中的应用仍面临挑战。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，双特异性T细胞引导剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法在癌症免疫治疗领域展现出新的希望，成为精准免疫调节的重要手段。这些工程化抗体的设计旨在将免疫效应细胞精准引导至肿瘤靶点，从而激发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤的治疗中，TCEs已取得显著的临床成功，但在实体肿瘤中的应用仍面临诸多挑战，尤其是其活性有限的问题，制约了其更广泛的临床应用。

本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫引导平台的最新前临床进展，重点关注其设计与优化过程，以及现有的临床试验数据。这些研究表明，免疫引导剂在药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产等方面的关键考虑是其开发过程中的重要因素。通过对这些因素的深入探讨，研究者们希望能够克服当前面临的挑战，提升免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的有效性和安全性。

此外，随着对免疫引导剂的不断优化，研究者们逐渐认识到其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的重要作用。免疫细胞重定向的多样性为癌症治疗提供了新的思路，未来的研究将继续探索如何更好地利用这些技术，以实现更高效的抗肿瘤效果。总之，双特异性T细胞引导剂及多特异性免疫治疗的发展，不仅为癌症患者带来了新的治疗选择，也为精准医学的进步奠定了基础。

items.title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
items.body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
items.authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.

items.title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症的25年回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中的发展历程。该理论最初提出于25年前，旨在解释自闭症的一些未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及与自闭症相关的认知特征（如同理心和系统化）的“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心发展缓慢、对细节的关注度更高、系统化能力更强以及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症相关。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持了产前性激素理论，并为未来的研究开辟了新的方向。
items.l1_lead: 产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中得到进一步验证，强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，并为未来研究提供了新方向。
items.l2_summary:
本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal hormone theory）在自闭症研究中的发展历程，强调了该理论在解释自闭症相关现象方面的重要性。自提出以来的25年间，产前性激素理论旨在解释自闭症患者中男性比例显著高于女性的现象，以及与自闭症相关的认知特征（如同理心和系统化）的“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心的发展缓慢、对细节的关注度更高、系统化能力更强以及更多自闭症特征相关，这些发现为理论提供了初步支持。

随着研究的深入，后续的研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症的发生相关。这一发现进一步拓宽了对性激素在自闭症发病机制中作用的理解。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究则强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，揭示了自闭症中存在的非典型发育模式。这些新发现不仅支持了产前性激素理论的有效性，也为未来的研究开辟了新的方向，提示研究者在探索自闭症的生物学基础时，需考虑性激素的影响。

综上所述，产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中扮演了重要角色，随着科学技术的进步，相关研究不断深入，未来有望为自闭症的早期识别和干预提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: Genomic Perspective on Heterogeneity of Organs and Body Aging.
items.body: Aging is a heterogeneous process, with organ systems and individuals experiencing variable rates of decline that are not fully reflected by chronological age. This variability contributes to the complexity of system morbidity, which poses increasing challenges for clinical care and biomedical research. In this review, we discuss the heterogeneity of organ and whole-body aging and perspectives on genomics as possible mechanisms that relate to such heterogeneity. We discuss how static genomics, including nuclear genetic variants, and dynamic genetics, such as somatic mutations, epigenetic drifts, and mitochondrial DNA changes might explain the variable rate of aging across organ systems and the whole body. We discuss that the use of metrics that capture heterogeneity in organ and body aging is critical to identify genomic biomarkers of aging, clarifying mechanisms of adaptation versus decline.
items.authors: Salimi S, Raftery D, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 从基因组视角看器官与身体衰老的异质性
items.summary_zh: 衰老是一个异质性过程，器官系统和个体的衰退速率各不相同，这种差异并不能完全通过生理年龄来反映。本文评述了器官和全身衰老的异质性，以及基因组学（genomics）作为可能机制的视角。我们探讨了静态基因组学（static genomics），包括核遗传变异，以及动态遗传学（dynamic genetics），如体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化，如何解释器官系统和全身衰老速率的差异。我们认为，使用能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，这有助于阐明适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。
items.l1_lead: 衰老过程的异质性表明，器官和个体的衰退速率受基因组学因素影响，需通过特定指标识别衰老的基因组生物标志物。
items.l2_summary:
衰老是一个复杂且异质性的过程，不同器官系统和个体的衰退速率存在显著差异，这种差异并不能仅通过生理年龄来充分反映。本文从基因组学（genomics）的视角出发，评述了器官和全身衰老的异质性，探讨了静态基因组学（static genomics）和动态遗传学（dynamic genetics）在解释这些差异中的作用。静态基因组学主要关注核遗传变异，而动态遗传学则涉及体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化等因素。这些基因组学的变化可能是导致器官系统和全身衰老速率不同的重要机制。

研究表明，器官衰老的速度和个体的整体衰老状态并不总是呈现一致性，某些器官可能会表现出较快的衰老速率，而其他器官则可能保持相对年轻的状态。通过分析基因组的变化，尤其是体细胞突变和表观遗传的变化，研究人员能够更好地理解衰老过程中的适应机制与衰退机制之间的关系。我们认为，识别能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于发现衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，这将有助于深入阐明衰老的生物学基础。

总之，本文强调了从基因组的角度理解衰老异质性的重要性，指出了静态和动态遗传学在这一过程中的关键作用，并呼吁进一步研究以揭示衰老的复杂机制。这些研究不仅有助于理解衰老的生物学，还可能为衰老相关疾病的预防和治疗提供新的思路。

items.title: AI proteomics: from protein identification to virtual cells.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific research, including proteomics. In this Perspective, we highlight key mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics areas where AI is driving innovation, ranging from protein identification to building AI virtual cells. These include improving peptide and protein identification and quantification; characterizing protein-protein interactions and protein complexes; advancing spatial and perturbation proteomics; integrating multi-omics data; and, ultimately, enabling AI virtual cells. Finally, we call for global collaboration among data producers, data consumers and other stakeholders to establish an AI-friendly ecosystem for MS-based proteomics, laying the foundation for transformative advancements in proteomics driven by AI.
items.authors: Sun Y, A J, Liu Z, Sun R, Qian L, Payne SH, Bittremieux W, Ralser M, Li C, Chen Y, Dong Z, Perez-Riverol Y, Khan A, Sander C, Aebersold R, Vizcaíno JA, Krieger JR, Yao J, Han W, Zhang L, Zhu Y, Xuan Y, Sun BB, Qiao L, He

items.title_zh: 人工智能在蛋白质组学中的应用与发展
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变科学研究，特别是在蛋白质组学领域。本文重点讨论了基于质谱（MS）的蛋白质组学中，AI推动创新的关键领域，包括蛋白质的识别与定量、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征、advancing spatial和扰动蛋白质组学、整合多组学数据，以及最终实现AI虚拟细胞。我们呼吁全球数据生产者、数据消费者及其他利益相关者之间的合作，以建立一个适合AI发展的MS基础蛋白质组学生态系统，为AI驱动的蛋白质组学的变革性进展奠定基础。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能正在推动蛋白质组学的创新发展，特别是在蛋白质识别、相互作用及多组学数据整合等关键领域，呼吁全球合作以建立适合AI发展的生态系统。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）正在深刻改变科学研究的面貌，尤其是在蛋白质组学（proteomics）领域。基于质谱（mass spectrometry, MS）的蛋白质组学中，AI的应用推动了多个关键领域的创新。首先，在蛋白质的识别与定量方面，AI技术能够提高数据处理的效率和准确性，帮助研究人员更快速地分析复杂的蛋白质样本。其次，AI在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征中也发挥了重要作用，通过机器学习算法，能够识别和预测蛋白质之间的相互作用，从而为理解生物过程提供了新的视角。

此外，AI还在推进空间蛋白质组学（spatial proteomics）和扰动蛋白质组学（perturbation proteomics）方面展现出巨大潜力。这些领域的研究能够揭示蛋白质在细胞内的空间分布及其在不同生理或病理状态下的变化，为疾病机制的研究提供了重要信息。AI的整合多组学数据（multi-omics data）能力，使得不同类型的生物数据能够有效结合，进一步提升了对生物系统的理解。

为了实现AI在蛋白质组学中的全面应用，本文呼吁全球的数据生产者、数据消费者及其他利益相关者之间的紧密合作。这种合作将有助于建立一个适合AI发展的MS基础蛋白质组学生态系统，从而为AI驱动的蛋白质组学的变革性进展奠定基础。通过这种协同努力，未来的研究将能够更好地利用AI技术，推动蛋白质组学的深入发展，最终实现AI虚拟细胞的构建，开启生物医学研究的新纪元。

items.title: The tragedy of Jason Arday - The Spectator
items.body:
原话：“He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. He felt he couldn’t go on.” / “at the heart of all this was a man who was diagnosed with autism and language differences…he needed support every step of the way… after the allegations of plagiarism, [the] media didn’t leave him alone.”

items.topic_zh: 对Jason Arday的同情与理解
items.claim_zh: Jason Arday在面对媒体的持续压力和职业生涯的丧失时，感到无法承受，缺乏必要的支持。
items.evidence_zh: 他被持续的审视和嘲笑所困扰，失去了职业和声誉。
items.article_body:
Coffee House Melanie McDonagh The tragedy of Jason Arday Saturday, August 15, 2026, 10:30 AM Jason Arday (Credit: BBC) Text settings Text size Small Medium Large Line Spacing Compact Normal Spacious Comments Share Share Melanie McDonagh
Copied Linkedin Messenger Email Simon Baron-Cohen, the distinguished Cambridge autism specialist, has been speaking movingly about his friend, Jason Arday, in a BBC radio interview. Baron-Cohen said the last contact he had with Arday was hours before he was found dead at an address in south London yesterday afternoon: “He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. He felt he couldn’t go on.”
Jason Arday was a victim, but not in the way that his political champions suggest
Baron-Cohen went on to talk about him as “an incredibly kind and gentle and caring and generous man”. From his own perspective, he observed, “at the heart of all this was a man who was diagnosed with autism and language differences…he needed support every step of the way… after the allegations of plagiarism, [the] media didn’t leave him alone.”
It is good to be reminded of Jason Arday as a friend, by a friend. For in death we all should be remembered in our humanity, even in our flawed humanity. And Jason Arday was very human; he bled. He was not just a totem of DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion), but as the Prof said, a vulnerable man. It’s sometimes hard for pundits, self included, to remember how terrifying it is to be at the heart of a media firestorm. Jason Arday isn’t the first to feel the pressure to be unbearable. We may not feel exactly guilt at participating in the row, but it would be strange if we didn’t feel sober, chastened, by his tragic end.
De mortuis nil nisi bonum is a good motto, but in Arday’s case, the difficulty about speaking no evil of the dead is in disentangling the man, the human being, from the issue. And the issue was quite legitimate: the apparent dearth of scrutiny of his successive appointments, the uncritical and unquestioned acceptance of his work and his claims as, for instance, a fundraiser. His family, in their pain, has talked about him as the victim of misinformation. This isn’t, I would say, the whole case, though this isn’t the time to rehearse the details.
Before his death becomes weaponized – as it already risks being – in the culture wars, we should make one thing clear, as I, in fact, did before he died. It is that the problem was not Jason Arday; it was with the individuals who lionized him, who promoted him beyond his capacities, who raised him up prematurely to stellar heights at an age which would have been remarkable for anyone, regardless of ethnicity. It is the individuals behind the system which created Jason Arday, the poster image of DEI, who should be asking themselves some questions.
Arday can hardly be blamed for not resisting this inexorable trajectory. And, I would say, the fault is with Cambridge for making a dud subject like Education a faculty on the same level as history or natural sciences or classics. Jason Arday was a victim, but not quite in the way that his political champions suggest.
He was also a man, a father, a son, a brother and an uncle, as his family have said, and it is as such he is being mourned. Requiescat in pace.
Melanie McDonagh is an Irish journalist working in London.

items.title_zh: 杰森·阿尔代的悲剧
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了杰森·阿尔代在面对媒体持续压力和职业生涯丧失时的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），在经历抄袭指控后，他感到无法承受来自媒体的无情审视和嘲笑，缺乏必要的支持。他失去了职业和声誉，内心深处感到绝望，认为自己无法继续前行。文章强调了在这种情况下，社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性。
items.l1_lead: 杰森·阿尔代因媒体压力和职业危机感到绝望，突显了社会对特殊需求人士支持与理解的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
杰森·阿尔代的悲剧揭示了在媒体压力和职业生涯丧失的双重打击下，特殊需求人士所面临的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），这使他在面对外界的审视时显得更加脆弱。在经历了抄袭指控后，媒体的持续关注和无情的嘲笑让他感到无所适从，缺乏必要的支持与理解。他的职业生涯因此受到重创，声誉也随之崩塌，内心深处的绝望感愈发加重，令他认为自己无法继续前行。

文章强调了社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性，指出在面对困境时，缺乏适当的帮助和关怀可能会导致更严重的心理和情感问题。阿尔代的经历不仅是个人的悲剧，更是对社会如何对待特殊需求人士的深刻反思。通过他的故事，读者能够感受到在职业生涯和个人生活中，理解与支持的重要性，以及在面对困难时，社会应当提供怎样的帮助。杰森·阿尔代的遭遇提醒我们，只有通过建立一个更具包容性和理解的环境，才能真正帮助那些在逆境中挣扎的人们。

items.topic_zh: 评估夏威夷桉树作为建筑材料的可行性
items.claim_zh: 他认为夏威夷现有的桉树资源可以安全用于建筑，以满足社区的需求。
items.article_body:
August 10, 2026 UH News Reading time: 2 minutes
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa researchers are working to determine whether Hawaiʻi -grown eucalyptus could become a reliable source of lumber for construction, helping reduce the state’s reliance on imported building materials while supporting healthier forests.
The project, led by Jun Wang, an assistant professor in the Department of Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering , received a $300,000 USDA Forest Service Wood Innovation Grant to establish the engineering standards needed for eucalyptus to be used in structural applications.
Although Hawaiʻi has more than 34,000 acres of managed eucalyptus plantations, the wood is rarely used in construction because engineers and builders lack the design data needed to certify it for structural use. If successful, the research could create new opportunities for Hawaiʻi ’s forestry and wood products industries while reducing shipping costs, supply chain risks and carbon emissions associated with importing lumber. Researchers also say putting more eucalyptus to use could encourage better forest management by reducing excess wood that can contribute to wildfire fuel.
The research team will work with state agencies, forest landowners and industry partners to harvest trees, produce lumber and test its strength and durability. The findings will help establish engineering design values needed for commercial construction and could lay the groundwork for future engineered wood products made in Hawaiʻi .
“Our goal is to determine whether a resource that’s already growing in Hawaiʻi can safely be used to build the homes, schools and infrastructure our communities need,” Wang said. “If we can provide the engineering data the construction industry needs, we can help create a more resilient local building supply while giving our students the opportunity to solve real challenges facing Hawaiʻi .”
The research also will benefit students. Wang’s team received an $8,000 American Society for Engineering Education grant to incorporate Hawaiʻi -grown eucalyptus into civil engineering courses. The new curriculum will give students hands-on experience evaluating sustainable building materials by comparing locally grown eucalyptus with conventional construction materials.
Students will examine factors such as structural performance, carbon emissions and local sourcing while participating in research that addresses Hawaiʻi ’s unique environmental and construction challenges. Many members of the research team are UH students from Hawaiʻi who are helping develop solutions that could benefit the state’s future infrastructure and economy.
items.title_zh: 夏威夷桉树森林或成新建筑材料来源
items.summary_zh: 夏威夷大学系统的科学家们正在研究夏威夷现有的桉树资源是否可以安全地用于建筑，以满足社区对住房、学校和基础设施的需求。他们的目标是提供建筑行业所需的工程数据，从而帮助建立更具韧性的本地建筑材料供应。这不仅能解决夏威夷面临的实际挑战，还能为学生提供实践机会，培养他们的解决问题能力。科学家们认为，桉树作为一种可再生资源，具有潜力成为可持续建筑材料的来源。
items.l1_lead: 夏威夷大学的研究表明，桉树可作为可持续建筑材料，满足当地住房和基础设施需求，同时为学生提供实践机会。
items.l2_summary:
夏威夷大学系统的科学家们正在探索夏威夷现有的桉树（Eucalyptus）资源是否可以安全地用于建筑，以满足社区对住房、学校和基础设施的需求。随着夏威夷面临的住房危机和基础设施需求不断增加，寻找可持续的建筑材料显得尤为重要。研究团队的目标是提供建筑行业所需的工程数据，以支持建立更具韧性的本地建筑材料供应。这一研究不仅旨在解决实际的建筑需求，还为学生提供了实践机会，帮助他们培养解决问题的能力。

科学家们认为，桉树作为一种可再生资源，具有成为可持续建筑材料来源的潜力。通过对桉树的特性进行深入研究，团队希望能够确定其在建筑领域的应用安全性和有效性。这一研究不仅关注材料的物理性能，还将考虑环境影响和经济可行性，从而为夏威夷的建筑行业提供全面的支持。

在当前全球对可持续发展和绿色建筑材料需求日益增长的背景下，夏威夷的这一研究具有重要的现实意义。通过利用本地资源，夏威夷不仅可以减少对外部建筑材料的依赖，还能促进地方经济的发展，创造更多就业机会。总之，夏威夷大学的研究团队正在为未来的建筑行业开辟新的方向，推动可持续建筑材料的应用，助力社区建设与发展。

items.title: The monologue is like an actor's first handshake with a casting director - WGCU
items.body:

论据：独白展示了演员的能力，而侧面剧本只能反映他们对特定角色的把握。

items.article_body:
Facebook LinkedIn Email Print Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Artistic Director Robin Murray, Cultural Park Theatre Actor reads monologue for casting director at Cultural Park Theatre. Whether auditioning for a comedy, drama or musical, an actor arrives at an audition equipped with a head shot, resume and a couple of monologues. Cultural Park Theatre Executive Director Robin Murray says the monologue plays a crucial role in her decision about whether or not to use an actor in a show she is casting.
“I consider a monologue the first handshake that you're giving a director,” said Murray. “It kind of shows what your abilities are without having somebody to rely on, another castmate to rely on or a set or a prop. And we can see what your range is, if you are able to move your body and your voice along with the words without relying on other things on a set.”
According to Murray, the best monologues don’t just showcase an actor’s talent and versatility, they tell a story with a beginning, middle and end.
“I like to see like the seasons in a monologue when somebody gives it,” Murray added. “I want to see them start as them and then I want to see an arc and then I want to see almost a resolution and then an ending.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actor, author, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues for kids. Local actor, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues. She knows exactly what casting directors such as Murray want.
“Since a monologue is a chance to show a director what you can do. I try to put more than one emotion in any monologue I write, so that there's a bit of an arc in it, so that you can show you can play different emotions,” Benzing said.
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing in the role of Lee in Charles Busch's 'The Tale of the Allergist's Wife.' Benzing’s experiences auditioning for roles, performing in a wide variety of shows and teaching theater to children and teens informs the way she crafts each monologue. But it was happenstance that led her to publish three compilations of the monologues she’s been writing since 2006.
“My monologue started, of course, with my own son, who was performing at the time, and we could not find a monologue anywhere that was different, that was new,” Benzing explained. “So, I wrote him one. And he entered the Young Artist Competition, and he was only 10. And it was a competition that went all the way up to college. And he won the whole thing. And so, everybody said please write me a monologue.”
Since then, actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe. “I have had a student text me from South Africa. He entered a worldwide monologue competition and he won his category. He's since been cast in all kinds of films,” Benzing noted. “I had a boy who auditioned for a Broadway show and used one of my monologues and he was cast. But my biggest success story was Michael Fatica, who I started teaching in summer camps here at the Cultural Park. And he has become a successful star on Broadway.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing It’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings. But it’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings.
“The thing that makes me the most proud are the kids that text me and say, ‘Hey, I won my student talent show.’ ‘I got second place. I almost won.’” Benzing added. “And they are so happy. And the fact that I could give them something that they love to do and that they did well with and they were happy with, I think that's the thing that makes me the most happy.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing will sign copies of 'Character Monologues for Kids' following the 7:30 p.m. performance of 'Charlie and the Chocolate Factory' on September 19. Cultural Park Theatre will be hosting a book signing for Benzing’s latest book, “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment,” following the 7 p.m. performance of “Charlie and the Chocolate Factory” on Sept. 19 .
The event marks a milestone in Benzing’s career as an author.
“This is my absolute first one and I’m super excited about it.” Benzing noted.
A Chicago native, Robin Murray caught the acting bug in fourth grade. Now living in Southwest Florida, Murray is the producing artistic director of Cultural Park Theatre.
“Cultural Park Theatre is one of the longest running community theaters in Lee County,” Murray noted. “We are now entering into our 64th season. We produce adult plays, children’s plays, comedies, dramas, rom-cons and musicals as well. And our musicals are usually on the lighter side and include children.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre. Actors use sides during an audition at Cultural Park Theatre. Every theater has its own way of announcing auditions.
“At Cultural Park, we put out a call usually on social media and then we will give the breakdown of what each character is and whether or not you need to come in with a 16-bar song, 60 seconds, 90 seconds,” Murray said. “For our regular plays, we will also have the breakdown and we will ask you either to come in with a monologue, be very familiar with the show, and then we will have you read sides.”
The term “sides” refers to excerpts from the script that actors are given to learn for an audition. This excerpt could be an entire scene, or just part of one. Depending on the project, sides can also include more than one section of the script for an actor to learn.
The term dates back to Shakespeare, when actors were only given their lines for rehearsals since scripts had to be written longhand.
Theaters often provide the sides in advance of the audition so that actors can familiarize themselves with the lines prior to arriving.
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre The purpose of a well-chosen monologue is to demonstrate an actor's versatility. While a side will give the casting director a rough idea about how an actor will potentially handle the role they’re auditioning for and fit in with the rest of the cast, sides do not reflect the actor’s overall skill set. That’s the purpose of a well-chosen monologue, Murray said.
“Based on the monologue, we know whether or not you're versatile, and that's the biggest thing we need in an actor, to be versatile,” Murray said. The monologue is going to show us an actor’s range where the sides are going to show us if they can carry a character, the specific character.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch from drama to comedy while reading a monologue. To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch up the tenor of the reading.
“If you are saying a line that’s very comedic, the director might ask you to read it in a more serious tone,” Murray pointed out.
While monologues are important in all genres, Murray noted that for musical auditions, “the voice is weighted the most because, depending on the part the person is auditioning for, if they cannot hit the note ….”
In addition to directing, Murray is an accomplished actor. Her stage credits include the evil nurse Pat Jones in “Four Old Broads” for The Belle Theatre and Mary Jane McMann in “Inspecting Carol.” She also appeared in “Marvin’s Room,” “I Remember Mama,” “Anton in Show Business,” “The Last Days of Judas Iscariot,” “Picasso at the Lapin Agile,” “On Golden Pond,” “Five Kinds of Silence” and “Calendar Girls.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Benzing played the part of Ruth in the Naples Players' production of 'Calendar Girls' in 2021. About Gerrie Benzing
As the creative director of Monologues4kids.com, Gerrie Benzing has written numerous children’s plays and over 500 monologues for clients worldwide. Dozens of children have used Benzing’s monologues to win movie roles, theater auditions, talent shows and pageants and to secure professional representation.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing's new book 'Character Monologues for Kids.' Her new book is “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment.”
“I have a lot of monologues,” noted Benzing, who has been writing monologues for more than 20 years. “A lot of them are straight comedic monologues, but many are character monologues as well, like Goldilocks talking about how she's not a criminal. When I directed kid shows, I loved seeing characters in the monologue selection. So that's what this [latest book] is, a book of character monologues.”
She included nearly 100 for “Character Monologues for Kids.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Kids' is among Benzing's books of monologues. Her previous books are “Duet Acting Scenes for Teens,” “Duet Acting Scenes for Kids,” “Monologues4kids Theater Camp Plays: Broadway Version” and “Commercials for Kids.” She has also contributed original monologues to the book “Active Listening,” by Michael Rost and J.J. Wilson.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Teens' is among Benzing's books of monologues. “I have lots more monologues,” Benzing added. “So there are more books coming. Lots of them.”
A local stage and film actor, director and musical theatre instructor, Benzing has directed six mainstage productions at Cultural Park Theater, including “Chicago” (2019), “Sister Act” in 2018 (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award), “Boeing, Boeing” in 2016 (for which she won as Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award) and “Peter Pan” (for which she garnered a Cultural Park Best Director of a Musical Marquee Award in 2014).
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Ethel Thayer in 'On Golden Pond' at Cultural Park Theatre in 2019 She has also appeared in more than a dozen shows at Cultural Park Theatre, including the iconic role of Ethel Thayer in “On Golden Pond,” “Harvey” (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Actress Marquee Award for her portrayal of Veta), “The Glass Menagerie” (in which she was cast as Amanda), “Dixie Swim Club” (Sharee), Bella Manningham in “Angel Street” (Gaslight) , “Bad Seed” (Christine) and Jack Neary’s “The Porch.”
“We asked Gerrie to do a book signing following Saturday night’s performance of ‘Charlie and the Chocolate Factory’ because she’s been an important staple here at the theater,” Murray noted. “A lot of the kids that are directing shows and working here have worked with Gerrie since they were 5 years old. So, it just is a natural thing to bring her back and have her showcase those monologues that the kids use to start their careers.”
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Frau Blucher in The Belle Theatre's 2025 production of 'Young Frankenstein.' Benzing’s other stage credits include Frau Blucher in “Young Frankenstein” at The Belle Theatre, a Pigeon sister in “The Odd Couple” at Fort Myers Theatre, swing for Mary Meeker in “Unnecessary Farce” at Off Broadway Palm, cigarette-smoking, whiskey-swilling sexpot Elaine Navazio in Neil Simon’s “Last of the Red Hot Lovers” for The Belle Theatre, Julia Budder in “It’s Only a Play” at The Studio Players, Caprice in “A Doublewide, Texas Christmas” at Broadway Palm Dinner Theatre, Mother Superior in “Drinking Habits” (The Belle Theatre), Gertrude in “Save Hamlet” (for Lab Theater), Raven in “Trouble (at the Vista View Mobile Home Estates)” for Florida Rep
items.title_zh: 独白：演员展示多样性的关键
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了独白在演员试镜中的重要性。科学家指出，独白是演员与导演之间的首次接触，能够展示演员的多样性和能力。通过独白，导演可以判断演员是否具备多变的表演能力，这是演员最需要的特质。文章强调，独白不仅展示了演员的情感范围，还能体现他们的表演技巧，而侧面剧本则只能反映演员对特定角色的理解。因此，独白在试镜中起着至关重要的作用，能够帮助导演评估演员的潜力和适应性。
items.l1_lead: 独白在演员试镜中至关重要，它不仅展示了演员的多样性和情感范围，还能帮助导演评估其表演能力和适应性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了独白（monologue）在演员试镜中的重要性，强调其在演员与导演之间首次接触时所发挥的关键作用。科学家指出，独白不仅是演员展示自身多样性和表演能力的机会，也是导演评估演员是否具备多变表演能力的重要依据。这种多变性被认为是演员最需要的特质之一。通过独白，演员能够展现出丰富的情感范围和高超的表演技巧，而侧面剧本（side script）则往往只能反映演员对特定角色的理解，无法全面展示其表演潜力。

文章进一步强调，独白在试镜中的重要性体现在其能够帮助导演更全面地评估演员的适应性和潜力。通过独白，导演可以观察到演员在不同情境下的表现，进而判断其是否适合某个角色。这种评估不仅依赖于演员的情感表达，还包括他们对角色的诠释能力和即兴发挥的能力。因此，独白在演员试镜中扮演着至关重要的角色，是导演选择合适演员的重要依据。

总的来说，独白作为一种表演形式，不仅展示了演员的个人魅力和专业素养，还为导演提供了一个全面评估演员能力的平台。这使得独白在试镜过程中不可或缺，成为演员与导演之间沟通和理解的桥梁。

items.title: Introducing Biomni: Stanford’s AI co-scientist built to accelerate biomedical research - The Brighter Side of News
items.body:
原话：“If you think of an agent as a carpenter, a carpenter without tools is just a carpenter who can talk.” / “The hurdle in biomedical science is not intelligence or ideas; it is mechanics.” / “This difference is not just about efficiency. It changes how research can be done.”

论据：在40分钟内，Biomni清理了数据，结合了数据，创建了可视化，并识别了饮食与体温之间的联系。

items.article_body:
A new AI system called Biomni can design experiments, analyze data, and accelerate biomedical research in minutes. (CREDIT: Shutterstock)
Stanford University researchers developed Biomni, an AI “co-scientist” that can read scientific papers, analyze datasets, write and execute code, form hypotheses, and design experiments in minutes. Biomni uses 150 specialized tools, 105 software packages, and 59 databases across 25 areas of biology, allowing it to complete complex biomedical research tasks at speeds far beyond traditional human workflows. Researchers say Biomni is designed to augment rather than replace scientists, handling labor-intensive research tasks while leaving interpretation, creativity, and final decision-making to humans.
A new kind of scientific partner is beginning to take shape in research labs. It does not wear a lab coat or hold a pipette. Instead, it reads thousands of papers, writes code, analyzes data, and suggests new experiments in minutes. Researchers at Stanford University call it Biomni, an artificial intelligence system designed to act as a “co-scientist.”
The system, described in the journal Science , reflects a growing effort to rethink how research is done. As scientific knowledge expands, the challenge is no longer just having ideas. It is managing the enormous workload required to test them.
“If you think of an agent as a carpenter, a carpenter without tools is just a carpenter who can talk,” said Jure Leskovec, professor of computer science at Stanford. “With Biomni, we give the carpenter a set of tools, so it can build.”
Modern biomedical research moves at a fast pace. New studies appear daily, and datasets grow larger each year. Yet progress often slows under the weight of routine tasks.
Scientists must read literature, organize data, write code, and test ideas before reaching conclusions. Each step takes time. Together, they can delay discovery for weeks or months.
“The hurdle in biomedical science is not intelligence or ideas; it is mechanics,” Leskovec said. “It’s this laborious stuff that slows innovation. Biomni can do this work in minutes.”
This challenge has created a gap between what researchers know and what they can act on. Important patterns may remain hidden simply because there is not enough time to explore them.
Biomni was designed to close that gap. The idea is simple. A scientist should be able to ask a question in plain language and receive a complete research workflow in return.
The system reads scientific papers, forms hypotheses , selects datasets, and chooses the right tools. It writes and runs code, interprets results, and suggests next steps.
“Biomni is able to understand a simple question like, ‘Why are these patients responding differently to the drug?’” said Kexin Huang, who helped lead the project. “Then it digs in, doing a lot of the scientific legwork.”
This process turns a single question into a structured investigation. Instead of handling one task at a time, the system manages the entire pipeline from start to finish.
To achieve this, researchers built a large digital environment for the system. Biomni draws on full-text papers, code repositories, and datasets from across the biomedical field.
It includes 150 specialized tools, 105 software packages, and 59 databases. These resources span 25 areas of biology, from genetics to neuroscience.
The system identifies which tools are needed for a given task. It then combines them into a step-by-step plan. Each step is translated into code that can be executed automatically.
This design allows Biomni to adapt to many types of problems. It does not rely on a fixed workflow . Instead, it builds a new one for each question.
The system’s speed is one of its most striking features. In one real-world example, a researcher uploaded more than 450 files of health data. These included glucose levels, food intake, and physical activity.
The user asked a simple question. Analyze the data and find meaningful patterns.
Within 40 minutes, Biomni cleaned the data, combined it, created visualizations , and identified links between diet and body temperature. Leskovec said the same work could take a human more than 60 hours.
This difference is not just about efficiency. It changes how research can be done. Faster analysis allows scientists to test more ideas and explore more possibilities.
To evaluate performance, researchers tested Biomni on hundreds of biomedical questions. These included tasks such as gene identification and disease analysis.
The system performed well across these areas. In many cases, it matched the accuracy of experienced researchers. It also completed tasks much faster.
In one test involving rare disease diagnosis , Biomni reached 60 percent accuracy. This was similar to experts, who scored between 60 and 70 percent. However, the system finished the task in three minutes, while humans took nearly two hours.
In another test focused on gene detection, it achieved 80 percent accuracy. It reduced analysis time from about 90 minutes to just four minutes.
These results suggest that the system can support experts by handling time-consuming work.
Biomni does more than analyze data. It can also design experiments and guide laboratory work.
In one case, the system generated a complete protocol for DNA cloning . It included detailed steps, materials, and validation methods.
Researchers followed the instructions in the lab. The experiment worked as expected. Colonies grew, and DNA sequencing confirmed the results.
This ability to connect digital analysis with physical experiments is a key strength. It shows that the system can move from theory to practice.
Another advantage lies in how Biomni tracks its work. Every step is recorded and linked to sources.
The system provides full citations for the data and methods it uses. This allows researchers to verify results and reproduce findings.
In science, reproducibility is essential. By documenting its process, Biomni helps strengthen the reliability of research.
Despite its capabilities, researchers stress that Biomni is not meant to replace scientists.
The system can process information quickly and find patterns. However, it does not make final decisions. Human judgment remains central to the scientific process.
“And it always will,” Huang said. “This is not about machines taking over science, but more about machines becoming a powerful new partner to augment human researchers.”
The goal is to free scientists from routine tasks. This allows them to focus on creativity, interpretation, and decision-making .
The system still has limits. It does not cover every area of biology. Some tasks require more detailed input to ensure accuracy.
Researchers are working to expand its capabilities. Future versions may include more data sources and improved reasoning methods.
There are also questions about safety. Tools that can design experiments must be used responsibly. Developers emphasize the importance of transparency and ethical guidelines .
Even with these challenges, early adoption is strong. More than 10,000 labs have begun using the system in academic and industry settings.
The rise of systems like Biomni reflects a broader shift in research. As knowledge grows, collaboration between humans and machines becomes more important.
Instead of working alone, scientists may rely on digital partners that handle complex workflows . This could speed up discovery and open new paths for innovation.
For fields like medicine, the impact could be profound. Faster research may lead to quicker development of treatments and deeper understanding of disease.
This work could transform how biomedical research is conducted. By automating routine tasks, it allows scientists to focus on deeper questions and creative thinking. This may accelerate discoveries in areas such as drug development and disease prevention.
The system also lowers barriers to entry. Researchers with fewer resources can access advanced tools and perform complex analyses. This could expand participation in science and increase global collaboration.
In healthcare, faster data analysis may improve patient outcomes. Researchers can identify patterns more quickly and develop targeted treatments. Over time, this may lead to more personalized medicine.
For the scientific community, improved transparency and reproducibility strengthen trust in research. By documenting every step, the system helps ensure that findings can be verified and built upon.
Research findings are available online in the journal Science .
The original story " Introducing Biomni: Stanford’s AI co-scientist built to accelerate biomedical research " is published in The Brighter Side of News.

items.body:
原话：“At the heart of all of this was a man who’d been diagnosed in childhood with disabilities that included autism and language delay and learning differences.” / “He was a vulnerable child, a vulnerable teenager and a vulnerable adult, so he needed and deserved safeguarding and support and reasonable adjustment every step of the way.”
