items.article_body:
Jason Arday was found dead at his home in south London on Friday. Photograph: Christian Sinibaldi/The Guardian View image in fullscreen Jason Arday was found dead at his home in south London on Friday. Photograph: Christian Sinibaldi/The Guardian Jason Arday This article is more than 1 month old Tributes paid to Jason Arday after former Cambridge professor’s death This article is more than 1 month old Andy Burnham calls for reflection after ‘tragedy on so many levels’ in comments echoed by London mayor Sadiq Khan
Prefer the Guardian on Google Andy Burnham has called the death of Jason Arday , whose body was found at his home in south London on Friday, a “tragedy on so many levels”.
Arday resigned as a professor at the University of Cambridge last week after allegations of plagiarism, which he denied. He was pronounced dead just after 3pm on Friday .
In a statement issued via his publisher, Simon & Schuster UK, the former academic’s family said they were “in shock to have lost this amazing father, partner, brother, uncle and son”.
Speaking to broadcasters during a visit to Cornwall on Saturday, the prime minister said: “It’s a tragedy on so many levels, but particularly just for everybody who knew Jason, his family obviously, his friends. We think of them today.
“It’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this. A really sad, sad and sorry state of affairs and I think we all today think of Jason, his contribution and his family and friends.”
More than £20,000 has been raised for the family of Arday after the Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon launched a fundraising drive via GoFundMe in his memory.
Other leading figures to pay tribute included the London mayor, Sadiq Khan, and the Labour MP Bell Ribeiro-Addy.
Khan said: “I’m devastated for the family and friends of Jason Arday. He faced an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse. I know many Londoners will be angry and upset this evening.
“Jason Arday was the victim of a pernicious public shaming that other people in his position simply wouldn’t have faced. His death was a tragedy, but once again it should be a wake-up call for all of us.”
Speaking on Newsnight, Ribeiro-Addy read out a list of names including William O’Reilly, Ros Holmes, David Latchman, and Nicola Morrison. “These are all people that have actually proven to have been plagiarists, or people that have manipulated their data, and people that have been proven to have lifted whole pages from students’ papers or published work that they had to withdraw,” she said.
Ribeiro-Addy said there had been a media witch-hunt which was cruel because “it didn’t aim to just target him”.
“It aimed to target anybody that supported him, trying to isolate him as much as possible, going after people who had signed up to statements,” she said. “The difference between them and him was they were white, and he was not.”
The Conservative MP James Cleverly expressed his anger over Arday’s death. In a statement on X, he wrote that a number of people at academic institutions “have serious questions to answer”.
“They put him into positions he was clearly not qualified for so they could have a black wunderkind to show off, they pushed him into the spotlight for their own benefit,” they said. “His exposure was inevitable, a case of when, not if. His whole world fell apart.”
Simon Baron-Cohen, a clinical psychologist and the director of the Autism Research Centre, who was a friend of Arday’s, told Radio 4’s Today programme that he contacted him Friday morning and said that he felt he was unable to go on.
“He used those words in voice notes,” Baron-Cohen said. “At the heart of all of this was a man who’d been diagnosed in childhood with disabilities that included autism and language delay and learning differences.
“He was a vulnerable child, a vulnerable teenager and a vulnerable adult, so he needed and deserved safeguarding and support and reasonable adjustment every step of the way.”
Free newsletter | Every weekday Sign up to First Edition
Our morning email breaks down the key stories of the day, telling you what’s happening and why it matters
Arday was initially accused of plagiarising another person’s work in his PhD thesis, but denied all allegations. A review conducted by Liverpool John Moores University, where he completed his doctorate, upheld its decision to award him a PhD earlier this year.
In recent weeks, other elements of his life story were increasingly questioned , including claims of prodigious money-raising for charity and feats of long-distance running. He was also challenged about whether he was nonverbal as a child.
The National Education Union general secretary, Daniel Kebede, said Arday had been subjected to “a public and brutal takedown that unleashed a tirade of racism”.
“I don’t believe this was ever simply about ‘professional conduct’ or ‘plagiarism’,” he said.
“There is a profound difference between scrutiny and a sustained public campaign that turns an individual into a symbol of everything the right believes is wrong with DEI.
“The effect has been chilling. It tells Black people and others from underrepresented backgrounds that entering prominent public positions will make you a target.
“A target not only for criticism of your work, but for a much broader political and cultural backlash.”
The Metropolitan police said his death was being treated as unexpected, but not believed to be suspicious.
In the UK and Ireland, Samaritans can be contacted on freephone 116 123. In the US, you can call or text the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org . In Australia, the crisis support service Lifeline is 13 11 14. Other international helplines can be found at befrienders.org
This article was amended on 16 August 2026 to correct the spelling of the names of Ros Holmes and David Latchman.
items.title_zh: 阿尔代：脆弱个体的保护与支持
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论了已故剑桥大学教授阿尔代的成长经历，强调他在童年时期被诊断出自闭症、语言延迟和学习差异等障碍。作者指出，阿尔代作为一个脆弱的孩子、青少年和成年人，始终需要并应当得到保护、支持和合理的调整。文章的核心论点是，社会应为像阿尔代这样的脆弱个体提供必要的保障，以确保他们在成长过程中能够获得平等的机会和支持。
items.l1_lead: 社会应为脆弱个体提供必要的保护与支持，以确保他们在成长过程中获得平等的机会和合理的调整。
items.l2_summary:
阿尔代（Alday）是已故剑桥大学教授，他的成长经历为我们提供了对脆弱个体保护与支持的重要思考。文章指出，阿尔代在童年时期被诊断出自闭症（Autism）、语言延迟（Language Delay）和学习差异（Learning Differences），这些障碍使他在生活的各个阶段都面临着挑战。作为一个脆弱的孩子、青少年和成年人，阿尔代始终需要保护和支持，这不仅是他个人的需求，也是社会应承担的责任。

文章的核心论点强调，社会应为像阿尔代这样的脆弱个体提供必要的保障，以确保他们在成长过程中能够获得平等的机会和支持。阿尔代的经历表明，缺乏适当的支持和合理的调整，脆弱个体可能会面临更大的困难和孤立。因此，社会各界应当关注这些个体的需求，提供必要的资源和环境，以帮助他们克服障碍，实现自我价值。

通过对阿尔代的成长故事的分析，作者呼吁社会重视脆弱个体的权益，倡导建立一个包容的环境，使每一个人都能在平等的基础上获得发展机会。这样的支持不仅有助于脆弱个体的成长，也将促进整个社会的和谐与进步。总之，阿尔代的经历提醒我们，保护和支持脆弱个体是社会的共同责任，只有通过集体的努力，才能为他们创造一个更加友好的生活和学习环境。

Two weeks ago, following a conversation with Jason Arday, Professor Simon Baron-Cohen posted a message on X.
The psychologist said he was “very concerned” about the impact of media coverage on his friend, who had autism, and linked it to work his Autism Research Centre at Cambridge University had done showing that autistic people were at a greater risk of suicide.
“This is relentless bullying of a vulnerable autistic man and raises safe-guarding issues,” he wrote. “It’s time to stop.” The site’s owner, Elon Musk, responded to the post with one word: “Liar”.
Yesterday, Baron-Cohen said Arday had sent him a voice note via WhatsApp on the morning of his death. “He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny, including ridicule, discrediting absolutely every detail of his life, and he wasn’t coping with… he felt he couldn’t go on,” he told Radio 4’s Today programme.
In 2022, Baron-Cohen and psychologists from other UK universities found that autistic people had an elevated risk of suicide. They examined 372 coroners’ inquest reports over a three-year period to find out whether the person who died had been diagnosed with autism or had autistic traits. They found evidence of autism in more than 10% of those who died, compared with about 1.1% of the population overall.
Jill Aylott, founder of the National Autism and ADHD Assessment Centre, said: “accountability should never require us to abandon humanity.
“When somebody becomes the focus of sustained national criticism, particularly where that person is known to be neurodivergent, institutions should be asking: who is checking that this person is safe?”
Baron-Cohen said that for the last 10 days he had seen Arday’s mental health “getting worse and worse”.
George Brown: the former Post Office boy who unlocked the mystery of depression
Derek Owusu: ‘I’ve never figured out how to live in the world’
“We need to let the investigations proceed. We need to understand how this tragedy has happened, but there has to be accountability at lots of levels.”

items.topic_zh: 应对气候变化的挑战与解决方案
items.claim_zh: 瑞士面临全球变暖带来的主要挑战，需要与社会共同开发气候变化的缓解和适应解决方案。
items.article_body:
Department of Environmental Systems Science Services Student portal Alumni association Staffnet Login Search Search en EN DE Departments ETH Zurich D-USYS Language Selection en English Deutsch You are here Homepage News & Events News Archive 2026 09 NCCR CLIM+: Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland NCCR CLIM+: Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland With the official launch of the National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) CLIM+, researchers, public authorities, businesses and organisations are joining forces to strengthen Switzerland's resilience to climate extremes. Co-led by ETH Zurich and the University of Bern, the NCCR combines climate research with practical solutions for society, the economy and policymaking.
The National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) is jointly directed by Prof. Sonia I. Seneviratne (ETH Zurich) and Prof. Karin Ingold (University of Bern), with Prof. David N. Bresch and Prof. Olivia Romppainen-Martius serving as deputy co-directors. CLIM+ brings together 47 research groups from 13 Swiss institutions and works closely with public authorities, businesses and civil society organisations. "Our vision is to investigate the main challenges Switzerland faces with increasing global warming and to help develop solutions for both climate change mitigation and adaptation," says Sonia Seneviratne. "This is only possible together with society."
A key element of the programme is the development of climate storylines: interdisciplinary narratives that combine scientific knowledge and societal perspectives to explore how extreme events could unfold and how risks can be managed.
CLIM+ strengthens a research area of growing societal importance. The programme combines climate science, risk modelling and decision analysis to support informed decision-making and long-term resilience. "CLIM+ shifts the approach from reacting to isolated extremes to systematically preparing for plausible future risks," explains David N. Bresch.
At the kick-off event, representatives from science, government and practice highlighted the importance of translating research into action, from climate-resilient infrastructure and water management to governance and emergency preparedness. Speakers also stressed that adaptation alone is not enough and must be accompanied by ambitious climate mitigation efforts.
Looking ahead, CLIM+ aims to create lasting bridges between research, policy and society while contributing knowledge that supports Switzerland's climate-risk strategies and strengthens dialogue between science and the public.
The external page NCCR CLIM+ (Climate Extremes and Society: Strengthening Resilience) receives CHF 16.88 million in federal funding and additional support from ETH Zurich and the University of Bern. Researchers from D-USYS involved in the programme include Nicolas Gruber, Andreas Prein, Erich Fischer, Manuela Brunner, Reto Knutti, Tina Schnadt Poberaj, Lukas Gudmundsson and Ulrike Lohmann. external page Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland , Article from Uni Bern, 15.09.2026

items.title_zh: NCCR CLIM+: 启动更具气候韧性的瑞士
items.summary_zh: NCCR CLIM+项目旨在研究瑞士在全球变暖加剧背景下面临的主要挑战，并与社会共同开发应对气候变化的缓解（mitigation）和适应（adaptation）解决方案。项目强调，只有通过社会的共同努力，才能有效应对气候变化带来的影响。
items.l1_lead: NCCR CLIM+项目强调，瑞士应对气候变化的挑战需要社会共同努力，开发有效的缓解和适应解决方案。
items.l2_summary:
NCCR CLIM+项目旨在深入研究瑞士在全球变暖加剧背景下面临的主要挑战，并与社会各界共同开发应对气候变化的缓解（mitigation）和适应（adaptation）解决方案。该项目强调，面对气候变化带来的影响，单靠科学界或政府的努力是远远不够的，必须依靠社会的共同努力，才能有效应对这一全球性问题。通过与社会各界的合作，NCCR CLIM+项目希望能够整合不同领域的知识与资源，推动瑞士在气候韧性方面的提升。

在研究过程中，NCCR CLIM+项目将聚焦于气候变化对瑞士的具体影响，包括生态系统、经济和社会结构等多个方面。项目团队将通过数据收集和分析，识别出瑞士在气候变化背景下的脆弱环节，并提出相应的解决方案。这些解决方案不仅包括技术层面的创新，还涉及政策制定、公众参与和教育等多方面的综合措施，以确保应对气候变化的策略能够被广泛接受和有效实施。

项目的核心论点是，气候变化的影响是复杂且多维的，只有通过跨学科的合作与社会的广泛参与，才能找到切实可行的应对之道。NCCR CLIM+项目的成功实施，将为瑞士在应对气候变化的过程中提供重要的理论支持和实践指导，助力瑞士在全球气候治理中发挥更为积极的作用。通过这一项目，瑞士不仅能够提升自身的气候韧性，还能为其他国家提供宝贵的经验和借鉴，推动全球范围内的气候行动。

items.title: Hawaii to Put Thirty Years of Eucalyptus Through Load Testing - Wood Central
items.body:
原话：“We can help create a more resilient local building supply.”
论点：他认为通过研究可以增强夏威夷的建筑材料供应的韧性。
论据：Wang’s team has $300,000 to produce numbers no one has generated over the three decades those trees have been standing.
items.authors: Jun Wang
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（Wood Central） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: We can help create a more resilient local building supply.
items.topic_zh: 关于增强当地建筑材料供应的观点
items.claim_zh: 他认为通过研究可以增强夏威夷的建筑材料供应的韧性。
items.evidence_zh: Wang’s team has $300,000 to produce numbers no one has generated over the three decades those trees have been standing.
items.article_body:
Eucalyptus stands across more than 34,000 acres of Hawaiʻi’s old sugar land, or 13,760 hectares, and no published data exists to tell a builder what a plank of lumber can hold. However, that could soon change thanks to a new University of Hawaiʻi project , which will see the USDA Forest Service provide US$300,000 to generate structural design values for the species, with the project to fell the trees, saw the boards, and test them.
“We can help create a more resilient local building supply,” said Jun Wang, an assistant professor in the university’s Department of Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering, whose team will run the work with state agencies, forest landowners, and industry partners. Wang has taken an additional $8,000 from the American Society for Engineering Education to incorporate the same material into civil engineering coursework at Mānoa.
Hawaiʻi’s large landowners put those trees into former cane land through the 1990s, holding tens of thousands of Hāmakua Coast acres off the property market , with agreements drawn to sell the crop to Oji Paper and Marubeni , the Japanese consortium that would chip it for paper. Hawaiian authorities rejected a 1997 lease over 4,150 hectares of public land after local opposition. The ventures that followed came and went, and the trees stayed.
Engineers cannot specify a beam without published design values, and no building official approves a species for load-bearing work until those numbers exist, regardless of what the timber does in a test rig. Eucalyptus grandis and E. saligna dominate the Hāmakua stands, which Mālama Hāmakua reports foresters rate suitable for flooring, structural, veneer, and ply work.
Distributors on the islands hold two to four weeks of stock compared with eight to 12 weeks on the mainland, so a West Coast price rise reaches an island invoice inside a fortnight, according to Associated Builders and Contractors Hawaiʻi. The same association puts local sourcing at under 20 per cent of the state’s building material needs, with the balance requiring an ocean crossing before reaching a site.
No mill on Hawaiʻi Island runs at the scale that would put eucalyptus boards alongside imported product on price, and the island’s hardwood mills stay with high-value koa to turn a profit, on Mālama Hāmakua’s account of what foresters told it. The wood that did leave between 2012 and 2016 went to China as veneer material before that market fell away, and a Waiakea mill licensed to peel the species never reached the volumes proposed.
It comes as Australian researchers turned plantation bluegum grown for pulp into structural glulam in February, the same class of timber used for the same purpose, with a Portland hub costing $200 million proposed to make the product at scale. Grading the timber and building the mill are separate bills, and only the first has been funded in Hawaiʻi.
Fire has given the state a second argument for cutting the stands, with the Department of Land and Natural Resources estimating that the 2012 Kōkeʻe wildfires released 72,000 tonnes of carbon, which it compares to the annual emissions of 18,000 cars. Those fires burned more than 3,000 acres of a Timber Management Area that covers 17,092 acres and holds more than 1,600 acres of eucalyptus and pine.
The department built a house from these species eight years ago, with Hale Liʻi framed in Sydney gum, rose gum, and southern yellow pine cut from Kōkeʻe on Kauaʻi and Hāmakua on Hawaiʻi Island. That 2018 grant came from the same federal Wood Innovations programme, and the 400-square-foot result is one nobody can yet repeat at commercial scale.
Wang’s team has $300,000 to produce numbers no one has generated over the three decades those trees have been standing, on an estate the university puts at over 34,000 acres. Design values will settle whether Hawaiʻi’s eucalyptus can be built with, and a mill will settle whether it ever is.

items.article_body:
Jun Wang received a $1.8 million federal grant to make AI data centers more energy efficient.
He is developing a power module called LincolnPak to simplify electricity conversion.
The new system could reduce the power conversion footprint by half.
On the outskirts of America’s booming digital economy, where anonymous warehouses hum with the computations that power artificial intelligence, an invisible problem is growing louder: supplying these data centers with the increasingly large volume of energy they require.
With his latest project, University of Nebraska–Lincoln Researcher Jun Wang is working to create a solution with wide-ranging positive impacts for those businesses and surrounding communities.
Wang is developing a high-voltage semiconductor power module — known as LincolnPak — that improves overall energy efficiency the moment electricity enters a data center. The U.S. Department of Energy, through its Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy recently awarded Wang a three-year, $1.8 million grant to further work on the new technology.
Today’s large AI facilities typically receive power from the grid at medium voltage — often 13.8 kilovolts — before stepping it down to 480-volt alternating current. From there, the electricity passes through multiple additional conversion stages before reaching the chips inside graphics processing units, which operate at about 1.2 volts direct current. Each step adds cost, bulk and energy loss.
“The more stages you have, the more inefficiencies you introduce,” said Wang, Assistant Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
LincolnPak reimagines that entry point. Instead of converting 13.8 kilovolts AC down to 480 volts AC and then repeatedly transforming it again, Wang’s team proposes converting it directly to an 800-volt DC distribution bus. From there, only two additional stages are required to reach chip-level voltage. The result: fewer components, lower losses and a simpler architecture aligned with next-generation data center roadmaps.
At the heart of the innovation is a high-voltage semiconductor packaging technology capable of handling more than 30 kilovolts. That capability enables a new converter circuit that was previously impractical. By integrating the most challenging high-voltage elements into a single advanced module, the LincolnPak design reduces the number of devices and capacitors required in the overall system.
The projected impact is substantial. Wang estimates the system could reduce the footprint of this power-conversion stage by at least 50 percent, cutting construction costs and simplifying cooling since less energy is lost as heat. At the same time, operational efficiency improves, lowering total cost of ownership for companies running massive AI facilities.
Wang said Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy grants are typically awarded to projects that reflect a high-risk, high-reward model focused on disruptive energy technologies.
For everyday electricity users, the payoff of the LincolnPak could be subtle but meaningful: more efficient data centers, reduced grid strain and a digital future that consumes less to compute more.
Wang said he and his collaborators aim not only to demonstrate a working prototype, but to move toward commercialization — potentially launching a startup to license and manufacture the modules.
“We know AI isn’t slowing down,” Wang said. “So, our responsibility as engineers is to make sure the energy infrastructure keeps up: efficiently, sustainably and intelligently. If we can cut losses at the front door of the data center, that impact scales everywhere.”

items.title: Rule-breaking in chemical synthesis.
items.body: Challenging century-old rules of structure, bonding, and reactivity enables the discovery of new synthetic chemistry involving amides and anti-Bredt olefins.
items.authors: Gonzalez JAM, Miseo GA, Houk KN, Garg NK.
items.title_zh: 打破化学合成中的传统规则
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了挑战百年传统结构、键合和反应性规则的重要性，揭示了在合成化学领域的新发现，特别是涉及酰胺（amides）和反Bredt烯烃（anti-Bredt olefins）的合成方法。通过对这些新合成策略的分析，作者指出，打破传统规则不仅推动了化学合成的创新，还为新材料和药物的开发提供了新的可能性。研究结果表明，重新审视和挑战现有的化学规则能够带来意想不到的合成路径和反应性，为未来的化学研究开辟了新的方向。
items.l1_lead: 打破传统化学合成规则能够推动创新，揭示新的合成路径，为新材料和药物开发提供新的可能性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了在合成化学领域中挑战传统结构、键合和反应性规则的重要性，特别是针对酰胺（amides）和反Bredt烯烃（anti-Bredt olefins）的新合成方法。作者指出，打破这些传统规则不仅推动了化学合成的创新，还为新材料和药物的开发提供了新的可能性。通过对新合成策略的深入分析，研究表明，重新审视和挑战现有的化学规则能够带来意想不到的合成路径和反应性，这为未来的化学研究开辟了新的方向。

在过去的百年中，化学合成的许多规则被广泛接受并应用于各种研究和工业实践中。然而，随着科学技术的进步，越来越多的证据表明，这些传统规则并非绝对，且在某些情况下可能限制了创新的可能性。通过对酰胺和反Bredt烯烃的合成研究，作者展示了如何通过打破这些规则，探索新的反应机制和合成途径，从而实现更高效的化学合成。

例如，研究中提到的新合成策略不仅提高了反应的选择性和产率，还为合成复杂分子提供了新的思路。这些发现强调了在化学研究中保持开放心态的重要性，鼓励科学家们质疑和重新思考已有的理论和方法。通过这种方式，研究者们能够发现新的反应性和合成路径，从而推动化学合成领域的进步。

总之，本文强调了打破传统化学合成规则的重要性，指出这种挑战不仅能够促进科学创新，还可能为新材料和药物的开发开辟新的可能性。研究结果表明，未来的化学研究应更加注重对现有规则的审视与挑战，以实现更大的突破和进步。

items.title: Warnings about Jason Arday’s mental health were ignored by the press - Good Law Project
items.body:
原话：“I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Jason Arday who is autistic.”
论点：媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能产生负面影响。
items.authors: Simon Baron‐Cohen
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（Good Law Project） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Jason Arday who is autistic.
items.topic_zh: 媒体报道对自闭症人士的影响
items.claim_zh: 媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能产生负面影响。
items.article_body:
We use cookies where necessary to allow us to understand how people interact with our website and content, so that we can continue to improve our service.
Dr Arday’s death was the direct result of media harassment – we’re demanding a public inquiry to prevent this from ever happening again
Before his death on Friday, Dr Jason Arday was subject to a barrage of racist, ableist and cruel media attention, which continued to escalate even after his resignation on August 5th.
The press attention was unrelenting. 249 articles were published in 22 days, mostly led by the broadsheets. This wasn’t a tabloid scandal – the journalists involved were often public figures in their own right.
A resignation normally causes the media to back off, but they only produced more content. Stories about Jason were driving clicks – with outlets like The Times even putting out paid adverts for their articles .
In his resignation letter, Dr Jason Arday said to his supporters “you have carried me through some of the darkest moments of my life”; “I need time to heal”; “space to begin again” and that he had “reached the limits of what any person should reasonably be expected to endure.”
Jason wasn’t the only one asking the press to stop.
Professor Simon Baron Cohen released a statement on July 31st, leaning on his expertise in autism, stating:
“I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Professor Jason Arday who is autistic.
He has been accused of plagiarism and he was cleared of any academic misconduct following a rigorous investigation by Liverpool John Moores University.
And yet he continues to be systematically discredited over every detail of his life, daily. We should of course always investigate plagiarism to protect academic standards.
However, I cannot stand by and watch when an autistic man is on the ground and the kicking continues. This is relentless bullying of a vulnerable autistic man and raises safe-guarding issues. It’s time to stop.”
The day afterwards, the Guardian published an article titled “Playbooks, plagiarism and a pig’s head: new claims surrounding a star Cambridge professor”.
Before this article was published, details of it were sent to Jason to give him an opportunity to respond. His supporters contacted The Guardian about this piece. A letter was sent to Katharine Viner, the Editor-in-Chief of the Guardian, and separate contact was made with the journalist writing the piece.
This article dissected Jason’s claims about his personal life, and the Guardian featured it on their podcast, Today In Focus. A reel the Guardian posted of that podcast, where the claims within the article were played for laughs, has since been deleted.
The Guardian’s coverage continued after Arday’s resignation, interviewing people who knew Jason as a child to question whether he was really non-verbal. The intense focus on Jason’s background and disability was widespread, with The Daily Mail even carrying a piece from a psychiatrist pondering a diagnosis for Jason, tempered only by the context that “I should say that I’ve never met Jason Arday, and so have no idea what has been going on in his mind, or how much truth there may or may not be in his life story.”
During the escalating coverage, those who supported Arday received countless requests for interviews and quotes.
These journalists were often warned about Jason’s wellbeing, and were still not dissuaded from chasing the story.
The writer and broadcaster Nels Abbey and Lord Simon Woolley , the Principal of Homerton College, both expressed their concerns.
Nels shared an example of this type of correspondence from the 3rd of August with a journalist during the firestorm, explicitly making clear his concern for Jason’s wellbeing.
Despite warnings from those around Jason trying to safeguard him from the onslaught, the stories kept coming.
Hours after Jason died, The Times ran a (now deleted) story headlined “Jason Arday may want to get himself a nice pair of orange trousers”.
Whilst this continued, the racist and eugenist academic Nathan Cofnas, who instigated the story, gave a little remarked upon interview to a right-wing youtuber, joking: “ After the revolution, I’ll be the head of the dept of eugenics & race science at Harvard.”
We believe that the press must be held accountable for their racist, profit-motivated conduct that led to Jason’s death. We’re calling for a public inquiry into how to ensure a responsible press given its contribution to Dr Arday’s tragic death.
By completing this form, I agree to receive occasional emails per the terms of the Good Law Project’s privacy notice .

items.title_zh: 媒体忽视Jason Arday心理健康警告的影响
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能带来的负面影响。文章引用了对Arday心理健康的担忧，指出媒体在报道中未能充分考虑其自闭症（autism）背景，可能加剧了对其的误解和偏见。专家强调，媒体的关注应更加谨慎，以避免对Arday及其他自闭症人士造成伤害。整体而言，文章呼吁媒体在报道此类敏感话题时，需更加关注受影响者的心理健康和社会影响。
items.l1_lead: 媒体在报道自闭症人士Jason Arday时忽视其心理健康背景，可能加剧误解与偏见，呼吁更谨慎的报道以保护受影响者。

本文探讨了媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能带来的负面影响，特别是对其心理健康的潜在威胁。文章指出，媒体在报道中未能充分考虑Arday的自闭症背景，导致对他的误解和偏见加剧。专家们强调，媒体在关注此类敏感话题时，应更加谨慎，以避免对Arday及其他自闭症人士造成进一步的伤害。报道中提到的心理健康担忧，反映了社会对自闭症人士的普遍误解，这种误解不仅影响了公众对他们的看法，也可能对他们的心理健康产生负面影响。

items.title: Cambridge professor says university should continue Jason Arday investigation - The Independent
items.body:
原话：“They have announced an investigation, and we should let that proceed.”
论点：大学应该让对Jason Arday的调查继续进行。
items.authors: Simon Baron‐Cohen
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（The Independent） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: They have announced an investigation, and we should let that proceed.
items.topic_zh: 关于大学对Jason Arday事件的调查
items.claim_zh: 大学应该让对Jason Arday的调查继续进行。
items.article_body:
A fundraiser for Prof Arday’s family, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £60,000
Bookmark Bookmark popover Removed from bookmarks
Want to bookmark your favourite articles and stories to read or reference later? Start your Independent Membership today.
From reproductive rights to climate change to Big Tech, The Independent is on the ground when the story is developing. Whether it's investigating the financials of Elon Musk's pro-Trump PAC or producing our latest documentary, 'The A Word', which shines a light on the American women fighting for reproductive rights, we know how important it is to parse out the facts from the messaging.
At such a critical moment in US history, we need reporters on the ground. Your donation allows us to keep sending journalists to speak to both sides of the story.
The Independent is trusted by Americans across the entire political spectrum. And unlike many other quality news outlets, we choose not to lock Americans out of our reporting and analysis with paywalls. We believe quality journalism should be available to everyone, paid for by those who can afford it.
The University of Cambridge ought to proceed with its probe into how Professor Jason Arday was recruited and his period teaching at the institution, according to a friend and former colleague.
Prof Arday, who was found dead on Friday, stepped down from his post as professor of sociology of education last week following allegations of plagiarism made against him.
Prior to his death, the university stated that it would look into the circumstances surrounding his "appointment and tenure", with the conclusions feeding into a wider review of senior recruitment processes.
It is understood that the university currently feels it would not be right to decide whether to continue the inquiry while Prof Arday’s family is grieving.
Sir Simon Baron-Cohen, a friend and former colleague of Prof Arday, told Times Radio that the university should "always be reflecting on how it’s operating and whether it can do better".
The Cambridge professor and director of the Autism Research Centre said: “They have announced an investigation, and we should let that proceed.
“We should we should see what we learn from it. This is the whole purpose of investigations.
“When you’re talking about what’s in the public interest, when you’ve got public bodies like universities or, arguably, the media, political institutions, whatever, when we have investigations, it’s all about how can we improve them.”
Sir Simon said the professor’s mental health had been left “in tatters”, adding there were questions about whether the media failed in its duty of care towards him as a vulnerable person with disabilities.
He said the professor faced racist abuse and was used as a “lightning rod for a culture war on DEI (diversity, equity and inclusion)”.
“(Prof Arday) started reporting racism within weeks of him being at Cambridge,” Sir Simon said.
“It included things like threats of physical assault to himself and his family, racist hate speech, and racist actions, hate actions.”
Lord Simon Woolley, principal of Homerton College, Cambridge, and a former mentor of Prof Arday, told BBC Radio 4’s Broadcasting House programme that his friend felt “hounded to death”.
Lord Woolley said: “In a conversation I had with Jason on the Monday – we met on Monday, with a few dear friends – he said he felt hounded to death, his words, that he couldn’t see a way out.”
He added: “On that day, we saw a man half his body weight and desperate beyond belief.”
The crossbench peer said Prof Arday had been subjected to “the most horrendous, toxic, vicious witch hunt”, and called for an investigation into the “vicious media onslaught”.
“The whole of the black community and black academics have been brought into this debate as though we don’t belong in these positions, because we are collectively the diversity, equity and inclusion hires,” Lord Woolley added.
A fundraiser for Prof Arday’s family, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £60,000.
The organisation Stand Up To Racism has announced plans for a vigil for Prof Arday to be held on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, central London, at 6pm on Monday.
On Saturday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham described the professor’s death as a “tragedy on so many levels”, adding: “It’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this.”
In a statement issued by his publisher Simon & Schuster UK on Friday, Prof Arday’s family said he had been subjected to a “campaign of sustained abuse” since he accepted the role of professor at Cambridge.
They said: “The campaign of misinformation was too much for Jason, who was a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone.”

items.title: You Can Buy a Test to Find Your Biological Age. But What Does the Number Really Mean? - Yahoo Lifestyle Canada
items.body:
原话：“At this point, if you want to do it, it must be based on curiosity.”
论点：目前进行生物年龄测试的动机应仅基于好奇心。
items.authors: Luigi Ferrucci
items.attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（Yahoo Lifestyle Canada） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: At this point, if you want to do it, it must be based on curiosity.
items.topic_zh: 生物年龄测试的意义
items.claim_zh: 目前进行生物年龄测试的动机应仅基于好奇心。
items.article_body:
Thinking about taking a biological age test? Here’s what it can and can’t tell you. If you've scrolled Instagram lately, you've probably seen the pitch. Spit in a tube, mail it off, get back a number that supposedly reveals how fast your body is actually aging. Katy Perry recently told her followers hers came back at 33, and she's far from the only celebrity turning the results into content.
The science behind biological age testing is real. What the number can actually tell you about your health is more complicated than the marketing lets on.
Chronological age is just birthday math. Biological age tries to estimate how fast or slow your body is aging compared with other people your age. A 60-year-old who tests at 55 is, in theory, aging like an average 55-year-old.
"Biological age is real. There's a difference between your chronological age and your biology, that's for sure, and we can measure it by various means," David Furman, a professor at the Buck Institute for Research on Aging, told Forbes .
Geriatrician Luigi Ferrucci, scientific director at the National Institute on Aging, was more restrained when he spoke to NPR . "At this point, if you want to do it, it must be based on curiosity," he said.
Most biological aging clocks rely on a process called DNA methylation. As we age, chemical tags known as methyl groups latch onto DNA, and the pattern of those tags can indicate biological age. Methylation changes the C, or cytosine, in the four-letter alphabet of DNA.
Steve Horvath, the scientist who pioneered the aging clock and developed the GrimAge test, told NPR that "you can use methylation to measure time in all cells that contain DNA." Some of those changes are protective, he said, while others can lead to adverse consequences. A higher proportion of methylated DNA in certain locations tends to correspond with a more accelerated biological age.
Horvath spent more than a decade as a UCLA professor studying the molecular biomarker. "We spent over 10 years trying to understand what factors accelerate your epigenetic clock," he told NPR. Smoking, unhealthy eating, a sedentary lifestyle and "pretty much any lifestyle factor that is bad for you" all push the clock forward, he said.
Not every test measures the same thing, which matters if you're deciding where to spend your money. GrimAge, named after the Grim Reaper, measures DNA methylation in blood and predicts higher risk of cognitive decline. iAge tracks chronic inflammation and predicts greater vulnerability to heart disease and frailty. GlycanAge measures biomarkers reflecting immune function, and microbiome clocks estimate the aging of the gut.
Each test captures one facet of aging rather than the full picture.
You get back a tidy number , but researchers say don't build your whole wellness identity around it. No test can predict how long you'll live. What it can do is estimate how fast or slow you appear to be aging compared with your peers.
Bradley Elliott, a researcher at the University of Westminster and a trustee of the British Society for Research on Ageing, put the limits bluntly to Forbes. "Aging is something that happens to all of us. Even if we optimize everything, it's [only] the rate of change which is modifiable," he said. A 50-year-old's immune system or gut health might be better than expected, but the body is still changing and losing function.
Results also swing more than you'd think. Biological age estimates can fluctuate throughout the day, so if you retest, do it at the same time. Exercise moves the number too. A 2025 study of professional German soccer players found they appeared biologically much younger when tested right after a match, possibly because of intense exercise. Hours later, their measurements returned to normal.

items.title_zh: 生物年龄测试：数字背后的真实含义
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了生物年龄测试的动机和意义。科学家指出，目前进行生物年龄测试的主要原因应仅基于好奇心，而非其他目的。尽管这些测试可以提供关于个体生物状态的信息，但其结果的解读和实际应用仍需谨慎。文章强调，生物年龄（biological age）并不总能准确反映健康状况或预期寿命，因此在使用这些测试时，消费者应保持理性和批判性思维。
items.l1_lead: 生物年龄测试主要出于好奇心，其结果需谨慎解读，不能准确反映健康状况或预期寿命，消费者应保持理性。
items.l2_summary:
生物年龄测试（biological age）近年来引起了广泛关注，本文探讨了其背后的动机和意义。科学家们指出，目前进行生物年龄测试的主要原因应仅基于好奇心，而非其他目的。尽管这些测试能够提供个体生物状态的信息，但其结果的解读和实际应用仍需谨慎。生物年龄并不总能准确反映一个人的健康状况或预期寿命，这一点在研究中得到了强调。因此，消费者在使用这些测试时应保持理性和批判性思维，以避免对结果的误解或过度解读。

生物年龄测试的结果可能会让人感到惊讶，甚至引发焦虑，但科学家提醒我们，这些测试的结果并不是绝对的健康指标。生物年龄的计算通常基于多种生物标志物的评估，这些标志物可能受到遗传、环境和生活方式等多种因素的影响。因此，单一的生物年龄测试结果并不能全面反映一个人的健康状况。

在实际应用中，生物年龄测试的结果可能会被误用，导致消费者对自身健康的错误判断。文章强调，尽管生物年龄测试可以作为了解自身生物状态的一种工具，但它并不是评估健康的唯一标准。科学家建议，消费者在解读这些测试结果时，应该结合其他健康指标和专业医疗建议，以获得更全面的健康评估。

总之，生物年龄测试的确提供了一种新的视角来理解个体的生物状态，但其结果的解读需要谨慎。保持理性和批判性思维是消费者在面对这些测试时应有的态度，以确保对自身健康的正确理解和管理。

items.title: Wildfires are reversing America’s progress on ozone pollution, the main ingredient in smog
items.authors: Jun Wang
items.attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/jun-wang-2419399（名+姓双命中）
items.title_zh: 野火逆转美国臭氧污染治理进展
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了野火对美国臭氧污染（Ozone Pollution）进展的影响，指出近年来频繁的野火导致臭氧水平上升，进而加剧了雾霾问题。研究表明，野火释放的烟雾和污染物使得空气质量恶化，尤其是在西部地区。根据数据，2020年和2021年野火季节的臭氧浓度显著高于往年，影响了数百万人的健康。文章强调，若不采取有效措施应对野火及其带来的污染，可能会使美国在改善空气质量方面的努力付诸东流。
items.l1_lead: 野火的频繁发生导致美国臭氧污染加剧，严重影响空气质量和公众健康，亟需采取有效措施应对。
items.l2_summary: 近年来，野火对美国臭氧污染治理的进展产生了显著影响，尤其是在西部地区。研究表明，频繁的野火导致臭氧水平上升，进而加剧了雾霾问题。根据数据，2020年和2021年野火季节的臭氧浓度显著高于往年，影响了数百万人的健康。野火释放的烟雾和污染物使得空气质量恶化，给公众健康带来了严重威胁。文章强调，如果不采取有效措施应对野火及其带来的污染，可能会使美国在改善空气质量方面的努力付诸东流。这一现象不仅反映了气候变化对环境的深远影响，也提示政策制定者需要更加重视野火管理与空气质量的关系，以确保公众的健康和环境的可持续发展。
items.l3_translation:
数十年来，美国在减少地面臭氧污染（雾霾的主要成分）方面取得了稳步进展。但这一进展——随着车辆、工业和电源变得更加清洁而实现——正日益被一个不同且日益增长的臭氧污染源所掩盖：野火。

我们的气象和野火科学家团队分析了2003年至2024年间美国野火对地面臭氧水平的贡献。

我们发现，野火烟雾中的气体逆转了全国臭氧趋势，迫使臭氧水平在2015年之前的下降转变为2015年之后的上升。我们还发现，自那时以来，由于野火导致的与臭氧相关的过早死亡人数每年增加约300人。

大多数人知道臭氧是位于地球高空的保护层，能够屏蔽有害的紫外线辐射。但臭氧有两个截然不同的面貌。

在高空，臭氧是有益的。在地面附近，它是一种有害的空气污染物，可能刺激肺部并加重呼吸系统疾病。

洛杉矶在1940年代和1950年代使臭氧对全国可见，因为厚厚的、刺眼的雾霾常常笼罩着这座城市。它将一个看不见的化学问题转变为人们可以看到和感受到的公共卫生危机。这场危机激励了加利福尼亚州及后来整个美国数十年的空气污染控制努力。

在1970年代《清洁空气法》及其修正案通过后，美国在清理地面臭氧方面取得了稳步进展。对车辆、电厂和工业源的监管减少了氮氧化物和其他臭氧形成化学物质的排放。

为了监测进展，美国环境保护局在全国设有超过1000个测量臭氧的站点。它们覆盖了许多地方，但主要是城市地区，并未在每个社区的邻里尺度上测量地面臭氧。

我们通过将这些监测站的测量数据与卫星获取的空气污染和人类活动信息、以及天气和空气质量模型模拟相结合，填补了这些空白。然后，我们利用人工智能估算过去22年间美国本土各地的每日地面臭氧水平，数据覆盖每平方公里。

结果显示，随着北美开始面临更严重的野火，减少地面臭氧的国家进展在2015年左右逆转。在许多地区，臭氧水平现在正在上升，尤其是在美国西部和中西部，野火的烟雾和气体在空气中传播变得越来越普遍。

总体而言，从2003年到2015年，地面臭氧水平每年下降约0.65个十亿分之一，但此后每年增加约0.13个十亿分之一。如果没有野火的影响，我们发现，地面臭氧水平下降的趋势本应继续。

人们常常认为野火是美国西部的问题，但它们排放的烟雾和气体污染物可以传播数千英里，影响远离火灾本身的社区。

2023年的加拿大野火提供了一个生动的例子。在中西部的许多地方，臭氧水平在一周内达到了不健康的水平。野火烟雾的影响甚至扩展到乔治亚州和纽约州。那一年，由于野火排放增加，额外4300万美国人生活在臭氧超过健康标准的地区。

随着地球及其大气变暖，北美许多地区的野火季节变得更长、更严重，预计这一趋势将继续。根据预测，加拿大在2023年和2025年经历了有记录以来最具破坏性的野火季节。在2025年1月，毁灭性的火灾在洛杉矶及其周边地区烧毁了超过16000栋房屋和企业，而在历史上，这一时期通常是此类事件不常见的。

向更多火灾的转变表明，未来臭氧问题可能会变得更加严重。这对人类健康构成了问题。

人们可以通过查看空气质量预报并在野火向空气中排放烟雾时限制户外活动来减少对臭氧污染的暴露。但从长远来看，保护公共健康需要更广泛的行动来减少地面臭氧本身。

这包括通过改善野火管理来减轻火灾风险的努力，例如减少可以助长火灾的灌木和其他干燥的下层植被，同时也要减少导致全球气温上升的原因，例如化石燃料的燃烧。随着气温上升，地面失去水分，创造了更极端火灾的条件。

保护公共健康还意味着加强空气质量预报系统，以提供准确的早期预警，使人们能够采取预防措施，并维护空气污染监测网络，投资卫星传感器以继续测量进展，从而能够识别和解决问题。

items.title: Timing of Antiplatelet and Anticoagulant Therapy Resumption Following Gastrointestinal Bleeding: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.body: Background & aims Gastrointestinal bleeding is a major complication in patients receiving antithrombotic therapy. Following gastrointestinal bleeding, clinicians face a critical dilemma: resuming therapy risks rebleeding, whereas discontinuation increases thrombotic events and mortality. This meta-analysis aimed to quantify the risks and benefits of antithrombotic therapy resumption vs discontinuation following gastrointestinal bleeding, and to evaluate the impact of resumption timing on recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding, major vascular events, and all-cause mortality. Methods We searched Embase, Scopus, PubMed, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library from inception to September 2025 for studies comparing antithrombotic therapy resumption vs delayed resumption or discontinuation after gastrointestinal bleeding. This review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251141360). Results Twenty-one studies were included. Antiplatelet therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval, 0.60-0.83; absolute risk difference, -3.6%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.44; 95% confidence interval, 0.26-0.76; absolute risk difference, -10.0%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.42; 95% confidence interval, 1.09-1.84; absolute risk difference, +2.2%). Similarly, anticoagulant therapy resumption reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.45; 95% confidence interval, 0.34-0.58; absolute risk difference, -7.0%) and mortality (hazard ratio, 0.53; 95% confidence interval, 0.43-0.65; absolute risk difference, -11.1%), but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.59; 95% confidence interval, 1.38-1.83; absolute risk difference, +2.6%). Notably, early resumption of both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy within 7 days significantly reduced major vascular events (hazard ratio, 0.39; 95% confidence interval, 0.19-0.78; absolute risk difference, -11.4%) but increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding (hazard ratio, 1.49; 95% confidence interval, 1.18-1.89; absolute risk difference, +2.7%), with no significant difference in mortality (hazard ratio, 0.78; 95% confidence interval, 0.29-2.10; absolute risk difference, -4.7%). Conclusions Both antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulant therapy resumption after gastrointestinal bleeding provide substantial clinical benefits despite increased recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding risk. Early resumption (≤7 days) offers favorable benefit-risk balance.

items.authors: Liu Y, Hu Y, Song S, Goh WWB, Tsoi KKF, Sung JJY.
items.title_zh: 抗血小板与抗凝治疗在消化道出血后的恢复时机研究
items.summary_zh: 消化道出血是接受抗血栓治疗患者的主要并发症。本文系统评估了抗血小板和抗凝治疗在消化道出血后恢复与不恢复的风险与收益，特别关注恢复时机对复发性消化道出血、重大血管事件及全因死亡率的影响。通过对Embase、Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Cochrane Library的文献检索，共纳入21项研究。结果显示，抗血小板治疗的恢复显著降低了重大血管事件（风险比0.70，95%置信区间0.60-0.83，绝对风险差-3.6%）和死亡率（风险比0.44，95%置信区间0.26-0.76，绝对风险差-10.0%），但复发性消化道出血风险增加（风险比1.42，95%置信区间1.09-1.84，绝对风险差+2.2%）。抗凝治疗的恢复同样降低了重大血管事件的发生。
items.l1_lead: 抗血小板和抗凝治疗在消化道出血后的恢复时机对重大血管事件和死亡率有显著影响，但抗血小板治疗会增加复发性消化道出血的风险。
items.l2_summary:
消化道出血是接受抗血栓治疗患者常见的并发症，本文对抗血小板（antiplatelet）和抗凝（anticoagulant）治疗在消化道出血后恢复的时机进行了系统评估，重点分析了恢复时机对复发性消化道出血、重大血管事件及全因死亡率的影响。研究通过对Embase、Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Cochrane Library的文献检索，共纳入21项相关研究，提供了重要的实证数据。

结果显示，抗血小板治疗的恢复显著降低了重大血管事件的发生，风险比为0.70（95%置信区间0.60-0.83），绝对风险差为-3.6%。此外，抗血小板治疗的恢复还显著降低了死亡率，风险比为0.44（95%置信区间0.26-0.76），绝对风险差为-10.0%。然而，恢复抗血小板治疗后，复发性消化道出血的风险却有所增加，风险比为1.42（95%置信区间1.09-1.84），绝对风险差为+2.2%。同样，抗凝治疗的恢复也显示出降低重大血管事件发生的趋势。

综上所述，尽管抗血小板和抗凝治疗的恢复在降低重大血管事件和死亡率方面具有明显的益处，但也伴随着复发性消化道出血风险的增加。因此，在临床实践中，医生需要综合考虑患者的具体情况，权衡抗血小板和抗凝治疗的恢复时机，以实现最佳的治疗效果。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.

items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）产生耐药性。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出潜力，通常采用每周五天、每天一次的“标准”方案。主要使用的两种方法是高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），作用于左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果实现，从而使更多患者受益。本系统文献综述分析了比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的23篇文章，重点关注aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及各种刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未发现aTMS与标准或假刺激方案之间的显著差异，但也有研究指出aTMS可能具有潜在优势。
items.l1_lead: 加速TMS（aTMS）在抑郁症治疗中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准或假刺激rTMS之间的显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康面临的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗产生耐药性（TRD），因此寻找有效的替代治疗方法显得尤为重要。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗手段，在MDD和TRD的治疗中展现出良好的潜力。传统的rTMS治疗通常采用每周五天、每天一次的“标准”方案，主要包括高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），其主要作用于左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果实现，加速TMS（aTMS）方案应运而生，旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多的刺激，使更多患者能够从中受益。

本研究对23篇相关文献进行了系统的综述，重点分析了aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及各种刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未能发现aTMS与标准或假刺激方案之间存在显著差异，但也有研究指出，aTMS可能在某些方面具有潜在的优势。这些研究为aTMS的应用提供了初步的支持，提示其在临床实践中可能成为一种有效的治疗选择。

综上所述，尽管目前的研究结果尚不完全一致，但aTMS作为一种新兴的治疗方法，仍然值得进一步探索，以期为重度抑郁障碍患者提供更多的治疗选择和希望。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），在青少年中常见。本系统评估旨在探讨青少年INTs与执行功能（EF）之间的关联。研究通过对2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章进行分析，发现22项研究报告了EF的表现差异，尤其在DD青少年中最为明显。任务基础的抑制能力在DD中表现出较低的得分（n = 5），而在强迫症（OCD）和AD中则有改善的抑制表现（n = 3）。此外，6项研究显示自评或父母评定的EF在各个领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现正常的结果相矛盾。整体而言，INTs与EF之间的关系复杂，需进一步研究以明确其机制。
items.l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间存在复杂关系，尤其抑郁障碍患者在执行功能表现上明显低于其他群体，需进一步研究其机制。
items.l2_summary: 青少年内化障碍（INTs），如焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），在青少年群体中普遍存在。本系统评估的目的是探讨青少年INTs与执行功能（EF）之间的关系。研究分析了自2014年以来符合条件的32篇相关文献，结果显示22项研究报告了EF表现的差异，尤其是在DD青少年中，这种差异最为明显。具体而言，任务基础的抑制能力在DD青少年中得分较低（n = 5），而在强迫症（OCD）和AD的青少年中则表现出改善的抑制能力（n = 3）。此外，有6项研究指出，自评或父母评定的EF在多个领域存在显著困难，其中3项研究的结果与任务表现正常的结果存在矛盾。这表明，尽管在某些任务中青少年可能表现正常，但在自我评估或他人评估中却显示出明显的EF困难。整体而言，INTs与EF之间的关系相当复杂，提示需要进一步的研究来明确其机制，以便更好地理解青少年心理健康问题的影响及其背后的执行功能障碍。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: PTSD患者脑结构异常的全脑体素分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学分析。研究表明，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的脑区（如杏仁核和海马体）中，灰质（GM）体积显著减小，尤其是在左小脑（Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001）。此外，小脑的白质（WM）体积也较小（峰值Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008）。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，发现这些结构异常可能特异于PTSD患者。研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的脑区存在显著的灰质和白质体积减少，提示这些结构异常可能特异于PTSD。
items.l2_summary: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素（voxel-based）基础的形态学分析，旨在揭示PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征性变化。研究结果显示，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的脑区，特别是杏仁核和海马体的灰质（GM）体积显著减小，左小脑的灰质体积减少尤为明显，Hedges' g值为0.22，经过校正后p值为0.001。此外，小脑的白质（WM）体积也表现出显著减小，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。通过与经历过创伤的对照组进行比较，研究发现这些脑结构的异常变化可能是PTSD患者特有的。研究使用了来自36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像数据，系统分析了PTSD患者与对照组在灰质和白质体积上的差异，并探讨了区域脑体积与临床变量（如PTSD和抑郁严重程度）之间的关联。这些发现为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了重要的形态学证据，提示PTSD患者在特定脑区的结构异常可能与其症状的严重程度相关，进一步强调了对PTSD患者进行早期干预和治疗的重要性。

items.title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
items.body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
items.authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
items.summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制尚不明确，这限制了针对性的治疗干预的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话。我们将情绪崩溃视为慢性过度警觉（chronic hypervigilance）和对客观良性压力源的急性过度反应（acute hyperreactivity）的结果，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。首先，从神经生理学角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内低连接性导致自闭症中的迷走神经撤退和交感神经过度兴奋，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低自闭症个体对压力源的耐受阈值。接着，从神经心理学角度提供证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是社交线索的整合差异，称为神经感知（neuroception）。
items.l1_lead: 自闭症情绪崩溃源于感官和认知压力引发的过度反应，涉及岛叶皮层的神经机制差异，需跨学科探讨以推动治疗进展。
items.l2_summary:
自闭症情绪崩溃是一种由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现，尽管在自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制尚不明确，这限制了针对性治疗干预的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，认为情绪崩溃是慢性过度警觉（chronic hypervigilance）和对客观良性压力源的急性过度反应（acute hyperreactivity）的结果，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。

从神经生理学的角度来看，情绪崩溃的发生与岛叶内低连接性有关，这种低连接性导致自闭症个体出现迷走神经撤退和交感神经过度兴奋的现象，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低了自闭症个体对压力源的耐受阈值。换言之，自闭症个体在面对压力时，往往表现出更高的敏感性和反应性，导致情绪崩溃的发生。

此外，从神经心理学的角度，情绪崩溃反映了自闭症个体在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是在整合社交线索方面的差异，这种现象被称为神经感知（neuroception）。自闭症个体在社交情境中可能无法有效识别和解读他人的情绪和意图，从而增加了其情绪崩溃的风险。

综上所述，自闭症情绪崩溃的机制涉及复杂的神经生理和神经心理因素，理解这些机制对于制定有效的干预措施至关重要。通过跨学科的探讨，可以为自闭症个体提供更具针对性的支持，帮助他们更好地应对情绪崩溃带来的挑战。

items.title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
items.body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
items.authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
items.title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
items.summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制的本质在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时可以从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复到深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性失效的问题，本文引入了一种新型的层次主动推理，其中较低层负责行为控制，而较高层（或元认知层）观察较低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层能够形成和暂停习惯，通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数。此外，本文还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节与规范、未来结果的模拟等。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新的认知控制理论，通过优化精度参数平衡深思与习惯，解决了在环境变化时主动推理模型无法恢复深思控制的问题。
items.l2_summary:
本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论，强调认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，旨在平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的作用。通过模拟驾驶场景的实验，研究发现标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时，个体能够从深思转向习惯控制。然而，当环境发生变化时，个体通常无法有效地恢复到深思控制状态，这揭示了上下文敏感性失效的问题。

为了解决这一问题，本文引入了一种新型的层次主动推理模型，其中较低层负责具体的行为控制，而较高层（或称元认知层）则负责观察较低层的信念更新并进行认知控制。元认知层的关键作用在于能够形成和暂停习惯，通过调节精度参数来优先考虑深思选择。这一机制使得个体在面对变化的环境时，能够更灵活地调整其认知策略，从而提升适应性。

此外，本文还探讨了与认知控制相关的多个过程，包括惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号的调节与规范，以及未来结果的模拟等。这些过程共同构成了认知控制的复杂网络，进一步支持了层次主动推理模型的有效性。通过这些研究，本文不仅为理解认知控制提供了新的视角，也为未来在动态环境中优化决策过程提供了理论基础。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.
